nodes.name: Act 1
nodes.summary: Exile washes up on the Twilight Strand, reaches Lioneye's Watch, defeats Brutus in Axiom Prison and Merveil in her lair; monster levels 1-13.

nodes.name: Act 10: Return to Oriath
nodes.summary: Tenth and final act. With Lilly Roth's help the exile returns to ruined Oriath, finds Bannon, awakens Innocence and kills Kitava in the Feeding Trough. Monster levels 64-67.

nodes.name: Act 2 - Phrecia
nodes.summary: Forest Encampment act: the exile deals with three bandit lords, follows Piety's Blackguards, and ends the act by killing the Vaal Oversoul; levels 13-23.

nodes.name: Act 3 - Sarn
nodes.summary: The ruined Eternal capital Sarn, infested with undead and Blackguards; Dominus and Piety experiment with virtue gems; ends with Dominus in the Sceptre of God; levels 23-33.

nodes.name: Act 4 - Highgate
nodes.summary: Maraketh-held Highgate mining town; with Lady Dialla's help the exile enters the Beast and kills Malachai; levels 33-40.

nodes.name: Act 5 - Oriath
nodes.summary: The Fall of Oriath: slave rebellion against the Templars, Avarius and Innocence fall, Utula summons Kitava; levels 41-45.

nodes.name: Act 6: The Rising Tide
nodes.summary: Sixth act and start of Part Two. After failing to stop Kitava's reawakening the exile flees Oriath and returns to Wraeclast, guided by Sin, who plans to harvest souls for a Dark Ember; the exile faces Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha and the Brine King. Town: Lioneye's Watch; monster levels 45-50.

nodes.name: Act 7: Lord and Legion
nodes.summary: Seventh act. The exile lands at the Broken Bridge (Bridge Encampment); Sin asks for Maligaro's soul while Ralakesh possesses Greust and Silk consorts with Arakaali. Monster levels 51-54.

nodes.name: Act 8: Eclipse
nodes.summary: Eighth act. The exile returns to the Sarn Encampment to find Doedre in the sewers while the sun and moon goddesses Solaris and Lunaris awaken and battle. Monster levels 55-60.

nodes.name: Act 9: Reunion
nodes.summary: Ninth act. The exile returns to Highgate, whose waters run red with the dead Beast's blood; Sin's plan is to wake a Dark Ember from the Beast's corpse. Kira/Garukhan, Shakari and the Depraved Trinity are faced. Monster levels 61-64.

nodes.name: Epilogue
nodes.summary: The post-campaign epilogue: after Kitava's death Lilly Roth offers to sail the exile away ('Toward the Future'); the exile arrives in Karui Shores, where Helena and Commander Kirac introduce the Atlas of Worlds. Earlier versions of the Epilogue were set in rebuilding Oriath.
sources: Overview: 'transition directly into the Epilogue, leading to Karui Shores and The Atlas of Worlds'

nodes.name: Act 1 (Ogham)
nodes.summary: First PoE2 act, in the forests of Ogham and Clearfell. The Exile escapes execution, helps Una and Renly, frees the Hooded One, and ends by defeating Count Geonor; the Seed of Corruption flees east with the Countess.

nodes.name: Act 2 (Vastiri)
nodes.summary: Second PoE2 act, in the Vastiri Desert and Keth. The Exile joins the Ardura Maraketh caravan, recreates the Horn of the Vastiri to dispel Jamanra's sandstorm, pursues the Countess to the Dreadnought, and learns the Hooded One is Sin.

nodes.name: Act 3 (Utzaal)
nodes.summary: Third PoE2 act, in the jungles and drowned city of Utzaal. The Exile lowers the lake, enters the Vaal sites, is sent back in time via a gateway to Utzaal's past, and brings Doryani to the present.

nodes.name: Act 4 (Ngamakanui)
nodes.summary: Fourth act of Path of Exile 2 (added in 0.3.0 The Third Edict). The Exile, the Hooded One and Doryani sail from Kingsmarch around the Karui archipelago Ngamakanui to recover three Precursor weapon pieces, find a forge, and reforge the Weapon meant to destroy the Beast, clashing with the Twilight Order and the Tukohama chieftain Tavakai.

alt_summaries.summary: PoE2's fourth act, set in the Karui archipelago of Ngamakanui, where the player searches for three pieces of the Precursor Weapon (and a way to assemble it) to subdue the Beast.

nodes.name: Act 5 (Oriath)
nodes.summary: Announced/datamined fifth act, not released as of 2026-11-05 (planned for the 1.0 release, 2026-12-11). Wiki text: set in Oriath, secretly rebuilt by the Twilight Order after Sirus destroyed it, where the player arrives in search of the Beast. Datamined listings name Slums, Grand Arena, Gardens, Den of Pleasure, Pantheon of the Forsaken Gods and bosses incl. Lumerius and the Countess; treat all details as unconfirmed.

nodes.name: Act 6 (final act)
nodes.summary: Announced sixth and final act of the PoE2 campaign, not released as of 2026-11-05. The PoE2 wiki only calls it the 'sixth and final storyline act'; no story content is confirmed. Rumours of its setting (e.g. inside the Beast) are unverified fan speculation.

nodes.name: Epilogue / Endgame (Legacy of the Precursors)
nodes.summary: Endgame container (0.5.0) opened when the attempt to sail on Oriath ends at the Ziggurat Refuge: the Hooded One sleeps in corruption, Doryani builds a Waygate and the hunt for the Edicts begins. Distinct from PoE1's Epilogue.

nodes.name: Interlude 1: Curse of Holten (Ezomytes)
nodes.summary: First Interlude after Act 4: the Hooded One takes the Exile to Ogham where Renly's Ezomytes are being abducted by Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth of Holten. Defeating them wins the Ezomytes for the war on Oriath. GGG reportedly intends Interludes to go away when Acts 5-6 arrive (non-canon status unverified).
sources: Act list: Interlude 1 - The Curse of Holten / 2 - The Stolen Barya / 3 - Doryani's Contingency

nodes.name: Interlude 2: The Stolen Barya (Maraketh)
nodes.summary: Second Interlude: in the Vastiri, Sekhema Asala needs the Maraketh unified for war; the Sel Khari guardians of the First Barya are lost to a Faridun/Serpent Clan attack led by Prince Azmadi, whom the Exile defeats so the Gifting of Water can proceed.
sources: Act list: Interlude 1 - The Curse of Holten / 2 - The Stolen Barya / 3 - Doryani's Contingency

nodes.name: Interlude 3: Doryani's Contingency (Vaal)
nodes.summary: Third Interlude: Doryani's reserves, the Cuachic Vault on Mount Kriar, are woken with the code phrase 'the time of the sparrow has come'; the Exile subdues Zolin and Zelina and the Cuachic Vaal pledge to the war.
sources: Act list: Interlude 1 - The Curse of Holten / 2 - The Stolen Barya / 3 - Doryani's Contingency

nodes.name: The Allflame
nodes.summary: Mysterious flame whose Embers (Necropolis) transform monsters via the Lantern; its light returns in Allflame league as a growing, hungry power that Vesper says differs from the light of the pit below the sea.

alt_summaries.summary: A mythical flame in a silver lantern found by Fairgraves in a shattered Empire cathedral; it must be kindled with life.

nodes.name: An Audience With The King
nodes.summary: Map fragment that grants access to The King in the Mists boss fight at the Crux of Nothingness; it can appear as a reward from Ritual encounters and was added in 3.25.0.

nodes.name: Ankh of Eternity
nodes.summary: Resurrection artefact used by Veruso to revive Chiara; per Clarissa the ritual produced a monster. Later hidden in the Quay.

alt_summaries.summary: Artefact said to have power over life and death, placed in a shrine in the Quay by Veruso, Prima Imperialus, at the dawn of the Empire. Clarissa's ritual with it fails; she realises Veruso hid it out of fear over what it did to his wife Chiara and decides to destroy it.

nodes.name: Atlas Book of Skill
nodes.summary: Consumable reward item that grants one or more Atlas passive skill points and Atlas passive respec points when used. It is obtained from Commander Kirac or Eagon Caeserius after defeating specific pinnacle bosses. An 'Eldritch' variant is the reward of The Searing Exarch and The Eater of Worlds quests.
sources: intro: 'obtained from either Kirac or Eagon after defeating specific pinnacle bosses'; Eldritch variant named in The Searing Exarch and The Eater of Worlds walkthroughs

nodes.name: Balbala's Barya
nodes.summary: Djinn barya holding Balbala's soul; placed in the Relic Altar at the Trial of the Sekhemas so that she can serve as a mentor Djinn.
sources: Quest 'Place your Barya into the Relic Altar'

nodes.name: Baleful Gem
nodes.summary: Maligaro's creation of calibric extantia guarded in the Chamber of Sins, used to poison Lorrata; Piety wanted it.

nodes.name: Black Elixir
nodes.summary: Poison from the Baleful Gem and Black Death venom, used by Ondar to kill Chitus.

nodes.name: Blood Crucible
nodes.summary: Device that lets the player shift into the Nightmare and corrupt items; per The Last to Die it represents a pact between Chaos and the bloodlines of Vaal High Priests, functioning only while the last bloodline lives.

nodes.name: Breachstone
nodes.summary: Item combined from Breach splinters (5 types, one per Breachlord) to open the Breachlord's Domain via map device; Flawless variant added 3.16; removed with Breach rework in 3.28.
sources: lead: splinters combine into a Breachstone to challenge the Breachlord

nodes.name: Brutal Restraint
nodes.summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Maraketh variant. Conquers passives in radius with service of dekhara in the akhara of Asenath, Balbala or Nasima; transforms keystones into exclusive ones. Drops from the Maraketh legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.
sources: Infobox: explicit1_text 'Denoted service of (500-8000) dekhara in the akhara of <Asenath • Balbala • Nasima>'; drop_text 'Maraketh legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

nodes.name: Chitus' master gem
nodes.summary: Large gem in Chitus' chest linking each gemling's heartbeat to his.
sources: Issue 4 The Black Heart, p. 11 (cited by wiki)

nodes.name: Citaqualotl's Thesis
nodes.summary: PoE2 Ancient Soul Core (introduced 0.4.0 with Fate of the Vaal). Its socket effects for Body Armour, Gloves and Boots concern Offerings, Sacrifice and Guard. Flavour text frames it as research into altering reality: 'Let us start not with ourselves, but with willing subjects.'
sources: flavour_text: 'Altering reality, even locally, is no simple matter. Let us start not with ourselves, but with willing subjects.'; version history 0.4.0 'Introduced to the game.'

nodes.name: Cosmic Arcana
nodes.summary: Weapon Valdo designed against the Elder; Zana found his key and used it to expel the Elder from the Atlas.

nodes.name: Count Lachlann's Ring
nodes.summary: Signet ring of Count Lachlann bearing his rune of Authority, needed by Una to heal the Hooded One's runic wound.
sources: Quest 'Bring Count Lachlann's Ring to Una'

nodes.name: The Dark Ember
nodes.summary: The seed from which Sin grew the Beast beneath Highgate. After the Beast's death Sin plans to rekindle a residue of it from the souls of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre to give the exile a chance against Kitava.
sources: dialogue 'The Dark Ember' / 'Shavronne': "The very seed that brought my Beast into existence. The Dark Ember."
'The Beast': Sin planted the Dark Ember beneath Highgate
Sin: "The very seed that brought my Beast into existence. The Dark Ember."

alt_summaries.summary: Seed Sin planted beneath Highgate; the Beast grew from it.
Seed from which the Beast grew; its residue after the Beast's death is extracted by the Exile and Sin from the Beast's core using the souls of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre, and used against Kitava.

nodes.name: Deshret's Banner
nodes.summary: Key to opening the seal on the Highgate mines; taken by Voll after killing Deshret, retrieved in Act 4.

alt_summaries.summary: Banner taken by Voll from Deshret; breaks her Seal on the Mines.

nodes.name: Elegant Hubris
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire Timeless Jewel (Legion 3.7.0) naming Cadiro, Victario and Caspiro (the last per wiki list of historical figures: Bust of Emperor Caspiro).

nodes.name: The Essence of Water
nodes.summary: Quest item from the Buried Shrines of Keth, one of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.
sources: Quest 'Pick up the Essence of Water'

nodes.name: Eye of Desire
nodes.summary: Taken from Daresso's spirit, used to power the Rapture Device.

alt_summaries.summary: Gem held by Daresso, needed for the Rapture Device.

nodes.name: Eye of Fury
nodes.summary: Taken from Kaom at Highgate, used to power the Rapture Device.

alt_summaries.summary: Gem held by Kaom, needed for the Rapture Device.

nodes.name: Eyes of Zeal
nodes.summary: Casticus's faithful eyes, the key to the Templar Courts.

nodes.name: The Flame Ruby
nodes.summary: Quest item dropped by Zalmarath in the Titan Grotto; one of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.

nodes.name: Flame Seed
nodes.summary: Object guarded by the Arbiter of Ash (Precursor-made guardian); after the Arbiter dies a mysterious wyrm-rider, later revealed as Tecrod, takes it saying 'This power serves a new master...'.
sources: Precursor civilization: 'create the Arbiter of Ash to guard the Flame Seed'
A Mysterious Entity riding a wyrm that steals the Flame Seed ... 'This power serves a new master...'
Lore: 'steals the Flame Seed after the Arbiter of Ash is defeated'
Precursor section: Arbiter of Ash created to guard the Flame Seed

alt_summaries.summary: Precursor object guarded by the Arbiter of Ash; very little is known.
Precursor object guarded by the Arbiter of Ash; stolen by a mysterious wyrm rider (Tecrod) after the Arbiter's defeat. Possibly linked to the Fourth Edict (unconfirmed).

nodes.name: The Genesis Tree
nodes.summary: Living tree at the Monastery of the Keepers that consumes Hiveborn remains and hiveblood to birth wombgifts.
sources: Allocate a Womb; Quest Complete bonded with the Genesis Tree

alt_summaries.summary: Tree in the Monastery that consumes Graftblood and births rewards (wombgifts); Exile bonds with it to complete Into the Breach.

nodes.name: Glorious Vanity
nodes.summary: Vaal Timeless Jewel (Legion 3.7.0); its mods name Doryani ('bathed in the blood of ... sacrificed in the name of Doryani'); other variants name Xibaqua and Ahuatotli.

nodes.name: Golden Pages
nodes.summary: Vaal artefacts describing the Vaal Cataclysm that Malachai had Icius Perandus translate (wiki: 'possibly the Golden Pages'); the translation inspired the Reverie Device.

nodes.name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
nodes.summary: PoE2 lineage support gem (introduced 0.4.0) for Offering skills: supported skills Sacrifice 25% of Life on use, and the Offerings they create grant Power Charges. Drops from the Lineage Gems Vault (Hall of Reverence) in Atziri's Temple. Its flavour text describes young Guatelitzi preparing prisoners for sacrifice.
sources: flavour_text: 'Young Guatelitzi was found moving among the prisoners, preparing their living bodies for sacrifice. The High Priests recognised his inclinations, and gave him a higher calling.'; drop_text: 'Drops from a Lineage Gems Vault (Hall of Reverence) in Atziri's Temple.'; version history 0.4.0

nodes.name: Guatelitzi's Thesis
nodes.summary: PoE2 Ancient Soul Core (introduced 0.4.0 with Fate of the Vaal). Helmet, Body Armour and Boots effects concern Life lost from hits, Recoup and Sprinting. Flavour text: 'We are nothing but flesh. Blood. If we are to ascend, we must empower that flesh.'
sources: flavour_text: 'We are nothing but flesh. Blood. If we are to ascend, we must empower that flesh.'; version history 0.4.0 'Introduced to the game.'

nodes.name: The Hammer of Kamasa
nodes.summary: Quest item dropped by Mektul, the Forgemaster; delivered to Oswald in the Ziggurat Encampment to complete Treasures of Utzaal and unlock the Reforging Bench.
sources: Quest log '===Pick up The Hammer of Kamasa===' and '===Quest Complete===' (Reforging Bench unlock)

nodes.name: Hayoxi's Fulmination
nodes.summary: PoE2 lineage support gem (introduced 0.4.0) for Curse skills: supported Curses create cursed ground that, after 7 seconds of persistence, triggers the Annihilation column. Drops from the Lineage Gems Vault (Hall of Reverence) in Atziri's Temple. Flavour text names an 'Architect of Destruction' who laid explosive powder under the royal temple.
sources: flavour_text: 'The Architect of Destruction slipped explosive powder under the royal temple one pinch at a time.'; drop_text: 'Drops from a Lineage Gems Vault (Hall of Reverence) in Atziri's Temple.'; version history 0.4.0

nodes.name: Horn of the Vastiri
nodes.summary: Ancient horn that controls the winds; recreated from three items and sounded to dispel Jamanra's sandstorm.
sources: Quest log 'Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri' / 'Use the Horn of the Vastiri'

nodes.name: Horns of Kulamac
nodes.summary: Artifact guarded by the Order of the Djinn in the Forbidden Vaults, described by Jun as able to shift the energies of life freely; its origin is unknown even to Jun. Catarina, helped by Janus Perandus, took it; Jun believes it grants the Syndicate immortality (her belief only).
sources: 20:19 horns of Kulamac; 21:41 theory they grant immortality

nodes.name: Jiquani's Thesis
nodes.summary: PoE2 Ancient Soul Core (introduced 0.4.0 with Fate of the Vaal). Helmet, Gloves and Boots effects concern maximum Mana, Energy Shield recharge and movement speed. Flavour text: 'The soul carries the truth of what we are. That is where we should focus our efforts.'
sources: flavour_text: 'The soul carries the truth of what we are. That is where we should focus our efforts.'; version history 0.4.0 'Introduced to the game.'

nodes.name: Kalguuran Map Device
nodes.summary: Isla's portal-based device by which Atlas Runners map and loot the Atlas while the Exile is away; Sasan the Bandit Lord can hold them hostage.

nodes.name: Kamasa's Orb of Sacrifice
nodes.summary: PoE2 currency orb (introduced 0.5.4) that removes a random explicit modifier to upgrade a Corruption enchantment on a Rare Amulet, Ring or Belt. Drops from the Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen. Its name matches the deity deity_kamasa; the item page does not state a naming origin.
sources: title and description: 'Kamasa's Orb of Sacrifice' - 'Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Amulet, Ring or Belt and removes a Random Modifier'; drop_text: 'Can drop from Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen.'

nodes.name: Kishara's Star
nodes.summary: Vaal navigational relic found at the Causeway; Weylam wants to give it to Lilly.

nodes.name: Kitava's Horns
nodes.summary: Two huge black gates in the Ravaged Square that block the way to the Canals and Kitava's Feeding Trough; impenetrable to men, they are broken by the resurrected Innocence.
sources: Bannon: 'two large black gates... Kitava's Horns'

nodes.name: Kitava's Torments
nodes.summary: Three Karui relics taken by Templars: Hinekora's Hair (whip), Tukohama's Tooth, and Valako's Jaw (fish hook). Lani asks the Exile to recover them in Act 5 for the Karui defence of Ngamakanui. Optional quest (Act 5, 'required: no').

alt_summaries.summary: Three Karui artefacts: Hinekora's Hair, Tukohama's Tooth, Valako's Jaw; kept in the Reliquary.

nodes.name: Kopec's Orb of Sacrifice
nodes.summary: PoE2 currency orb (introduced 0.5.4) that removes a random explicit modifier to upgrade a Corruption enchantment on a Rare Armour. Drops from the Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen. Its name matches the deity deity_kopec; the item page does not state a naming origin.
sources: title and description: 'Kopec's Orb of Sacrifice' - 'Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Armour and removes a Random Modifier'; drop_text: 'Can drop from Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen.'

nodes.name: The Lantern of Arimor
nodes.summary: Heirloom lantern revealing and rearranging the haunting modifiers of monsters before a zone is entered.

nodes.name: Large Soul Core
nodes.summary: Charged soul core powering the Matlan Waterways mechanism that drains the Utzaal lake.
sources: Quest 'Retrieve the Large Soul Core' / 'Enter The Matlan Waterways'

nodes.name: Lethal Pride
nodes.summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Karui variant. Conquers passives in radius with Karui leadership over warriors under Akoya, Kaom or Rakiata (seed-dependent); adds Strength to small passives. Drops from the Karui legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.
sources: Infobox: base_item = Timeless Jewel; explicit1_text 'Commanded leadership over (10000-18000) warriors under <Akoya • Kaom • Rakiata>'; drop_text 'Karui legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

nodes.name: Maligaro's Spike
nodes.summary: Maligaro's device that injects calibric extantia into living flesh; stuck in the Weaver's eye as 'Silk's spear'.

nodes.name: Map Device
nodes.summary: Ancient device of golden instruments that opens portals to the worlds of the Atlas. Per Valdo's Book of Memories it was built by the Watchers of Decay to travel to and lock the Elder's dreamland; Templar expeditions under High Templar Venarius found a broken one in Wraeclast's ruins and Valdo Caeserius (with the Shade's help) assembled it in the Oriath academy. Zana later found another in ruined Oriath; in the legacy epilogue Kirac rebuilt one from parts in the Vault of Venarius; Isla later reimagined it with Kalguuran runes. Different peoples are said to have built their own versions. No source in the corpus ties it to the Precursors.
sources: Memory of Intrigue: 'The intricate golden instruments ... a hundred times more intricate'
Machinist's Vault Aberration quote: 'Different peoples created their own map devices'
lead + Book of Memories Page 9: 'The Watchers, they built the device'
Walkthrough: 'components to rebuild the Map Device' in the Vault of Venarius

nodes.name: The Teardrop
nodes.summary: Pearl carved with the location of Tsoatha, retrieved from the Reliquary for Lilly.

nodes.name: Mastodon Tusks
nodes.summary: Tusks from the Bone Pits that Jamanra sought for lightning abilities; one of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.

nodes.name: The Maven's Beacon
nodes.summary: Map Device upgrade from the first Maven-witnessed boss kill enabling witnessing.

nodes.name: Miasmeter
nodes.summary: Device sensing the corrupt murmurs of Wraeclast.

nodes.name: Militant Faith
nodes.summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Templar variant. Conquers passives in radius with new faithful converted by High Templar Avarius, Dominus or Maxarius; adds Devotion to small and notable passives. Drops from the Templar legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.
sources: Infobox: explicit1_text 'Carved to glorify (2000-10000) new faithful converted by High Templar <Avarius • Dominus • Maxarius>'; drop_text 'Templar legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

nodes.name: Mirror of Delirium
nodes.summary: Mirror found in each area during Delirium league; passing through creates the Delirium fog. Still appears in story maps and league-modifier maps after the league.

nodes.name: Mirror of Kalandra
nodes.summary: One of the rarest and most valuable currency items in the game, named after Kalandra; the Path of Exile logo resembles it. Kalandra's Touch, a league item, was added to the core drop pool after the league.

alt_summaries.summary: Rarest currency item, named after Kalandra and tied to mirrored items; the PoE logo resembles it.

nodes.name: O' Eternal
nodes.summary: First-edition book written by the Eternal Empire poet Victario. Victario gave a signed copy to Queen Hyrri of Ngamakanui after the battle against General Lioneye; the book later sat in an Oriathan nobleman's vault (the Vox family), was stolen under Kurai's contract 'Hyrri's Gift' for a client, and became the object of the Negotiation and the Vox vendetta.
sources: 'Hyrri's Gift' and 'The Negotiation' sections; Lore paragraph

nodes.name: Origin Core
nodes.summary: 0.5 key item assembled from the Origin Cradle and Origin Spark; placed into the Origin Tower to open the way to the Arbiter of Divinity.
sources: Matriarch and Patriarch Halls drop Origin Cradle and Origin Spark; combine into Origin Core
places the Origin Core into the Origin Tower

nodes.name: Precursor Weapon
aliases: The Weapon (instrument of the Third Edict)
nodes.summary: Device built by the Precursors against corruption; Doryani sought to harness it (a lore video says it was scattered by 400 BIC, Doryani holding one piece and three in the Karui archipelago). In PoE2 Act 4 the Exile hunts its three pieces in Ngamakanui; in the endgame only the Hooded One is said able to wield it against the Beast.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Doryani in Ziggurat Encampment' / Hooded One follow-up
Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon; Return to Kingsmarch
Speak to The Hooded One; Return to Kingsmarch
intro: 'search for three parts of the precursor weapon'

alt_summaries.summary: Ancient anti-Corruption weapon of a lost civilisation, in pieces: Doryani holds one, the others are scattered in Ngamakanui.

Three Precursor weapon pieces (rotating on Act 4 islands) are reforged by the Hooded One in the Excavated Site; the inscription reads 'The instrument of the Third Edict', made for cleansing Corruption and destroying the Beast. Radiates intense Corruption and drives Tavakai mad.

Three-piece Precursor device assembled in Act 4 on Arastas/Excavated Site; the instrument of the Third Edict, built to cleanse Corruption and destroy the Beast. Radiates intense Corruption, maddening those near it; Tavakai takes it, falls to blood fever, and is cured when the Hooded One uses it.
Ancient weapon from a lost civilisation designed against corruption; four pieces: Doryani holds one, three are scattered in Ngamakanui.

nodes.name: Primeval Remnant
nodes.summary: Currency-like item that opens a portal to the Forge of the Titans; its text recounts the near-extinction of the Titans after the rising darkness (Lightless) of the Winter of the World.

nodes.name: Purification Pump
nodes.summary: Portable purifying-pumping unit that Sister Cassia places on Blight fungal growths; Blight towers, powered by the fungus's toxic fluid, defend it.

nodes.name: Quipolatl's Thesis
nodes.summary: PoE2 Ancient Soul Core (introduced 0.4.0 with Fate of the Vaal). Flavour text presents the research as altering the fundamental laws of existence through focused Corruption: 'With enough focused Corruption, we can alter the fundamental laws of existence in a small area'.
sources: flavour_text: 'The results prove it. With enough focused Corruption, we can alter the fundamental laws of existence in a small area... the question now: what do we try first?'; version history 0.4.0 'Introduced to the game.'

nodes.name: Rapture Device
nodes.summary: Device Malachai built in the Solaris Temple, claimed able to kill the Beast. Powered by the Eyes of Fury and Desire and Dialla's life force, it tore into the Beast so Malachai could enter.

alt_summaries.summary: Malachai's machine in the Crystal Veins; powered by Eyes and Dialla; drills into the Beast.

nodes.name: Recombinator
nodes.summary: Isla's prototype that breaks down two matching items and reintegrates them into one new piece.

nodes.name: Reverie Device
nodes.summary: Malachai's map-using precursor of the Map Device used to enter the Nightmare.

nodes.name: Sacred Blossom
nodes.summary: Map fragment that opens a portal to The Sacred Grove, where Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove can be encountered. Usable once in a personal Map Device. Drops from tier 4 Harvest bosses (Ersi, Janaar, Namharim); the Heart of the Grove atlas passive stopped always dropping it in 3.19.0.
sources: lead: 'must use a Sacred Blossom in the map device'

nodes.name: Templar Relics (Sanctum)
nodes.summary: Relics placed on the Sanctum altar to strengthen the Exile across runs; unique relics carry Lycia's written account of Innocence. Aureus is the Templars' coin.

nodes.name: Seed of Corruption
nodes.summary: Essence found by Sin in a Precursor ruin and used to create the Beast; in PoE2 a seed is stolen by Count Geonor from Sin and grows into a new Beast.
sources: Doryani: 'the instrument of a Second Edict'
Sin found a Precursor ruin containing the Seed of Corruption
Path of Exile 2 section: Sin took the Seed of Corruption into hiding; Geonor binds him and steals it

alt_summaries.summary: A metallic sphere that Count Geonor takes from the Hooded One. It opens and releases corruption across Wraeclast and the Atlas; the PoE2 Exile chases it.
Metallic sphere holding the Seed of Corruption, which Count Geonor took from the Hooded One; it feeds the Beast's growth.
Precursor essence from which Sin grew the Beast; stolen by Count Geonor in Act 1 and carried off by Oriana. Doryani guesses it was the instrument of a Second Edict.

Precursor-made essence from which Sin created the Beast; stolen by Count Geonor at the start of PoE2, then carried by the Countess on the Dreadnought. Doryani speculates it was the instrument of a Second Edict.

nodes.name: Sekhema Feather
nodes.summary: Symbol of Maraketh leadership; its recipient (Tasuni or Irasha) rules Highgate.

nodes.name: Sentinels
nodes.summary: Sentinel drones of the Sentinel league (Stalker, Apex and Pandemonium types) that empower monsters. Sentinel Power Cores charge filaments; Recombinators are a separate item. The wiki gives no in-world narrator.

nodes.name: Sign of Purity
nodes.summary: Weapon forged by Innocence from his own blood, kept in the Templar Ossuary; destroyed by Kitava's beam in Act 5.
sources: Act 5 dialogue: The Sign of Purity
Act 5: beam destroys the Sign of Purity

alt_summaries.summary: Weapon forged from Innocence's blood, gifted to the first High Templar; used by the exile in Act 5-10.
Item from the Ossuary used to fight Kitava; Kitava's beam destroys it.

nodes.name: Staff of Avarius
nodes.summary: Holy staff of High Templar Avarius lying in the desecrated Chamber of Innocence; Bannon says it can break Kitava's Horns but its real power is to revive Innocence, using Bannon as host.

nodes.name: Star of Wraeclast
nodes.summary: Necklace with a virtue gem from Kalisa Maas that turned Merveil into a siren.

alt_summaries.summary: Cursed ruby necklace Daresso gave Merveil; it turned her into a monster.

nodes.name: Starforge
nodes.summary: Sealing blade that bound the Elder's physical form (leaving its spirit, the Shade, free). History of Wraeclast says the Watchers of Decay forged it; scarab flavour text instead credits the Order of the Djinn (Egrin forged it, Qianga delivered it to the Watchers, Betucia bore it to imprison the Elder and sacrificed themselves). Winged Cartography Scarab: 'The Sealing Blade has been removed'.
sources: The Watchers of Decay: 'forge a weapon capable of subduing it - Starforge'

nodes.name: The Storm Blade
nodes.summary: Crystal sword of Garukhan capturing storms; its storm is bottled to disperse Shakari's sandstorm.

nodes.name: Temple Door Idol
nodes.summary: Idol dropped by the Queen of Filth that opens the Temple of Kopec door.
sources: Quest 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'

nodes.name: The Apex
nodes.summary: Capstone formed by combining the three bandit amulets, used on the Dark Altar to summon the Vaal Oversoul and lift the darkness.

nodes.name: The Sovereign
nodes.summary: Ship built in an underground pit-laboratory by masked men working for the Templars using a tortured prisoner, Vesper, as its heart; fuelled by Dead Man's Sulphur and the Allflame.

nodes.name: Timeless Jewel
nodes.summary: Jewels introduced in Legion league (3.7.0) that rewrite nearby passives by legion faction; variants include Glorious Vanity (Vaal: Doryani/Xibaqua/Ahuatotli) and Elegant Hubris (Eternal: Cadiro/Victario/Caspiro). Other jewels (Lethal Pride, Brutal Restraint, Militant Faith) exist but their figure lists were not verified.

nodes.name: Tolman's Bracelet
nodes.summary: Bracelet Clarissa made for Tolman.

nodes.name: Tower Key
nodes.summary: Royal key dropped by Piety allowing entry to the Sceptre of God.

nodes.name: Transmutia Device
nodes.summary: Device given by Malachai to Maligaro to manipulate virtue gems; later the exile's crafting bench.

nodes.name: Triskelion Flame
nodes.summary: Rune-forged Kalguuran relic honouring Aldur; made a symbol of royal authority under Cadigan I; carried on the first Wraeclast expedition to purify poisoned rain/fish and raise a starlight barrier; stolen by Olroth and later destroyed in the exile's fight with him.

alt_summaries.summary: Sacred flame whose starlight barrier protected the Kalguuran colony; destroyed by the Exile in the Olroth fight.

Kalguuran relic forged by the Runefathers in honour of Aldur; purifies corrupted food and projects a starlight barrier. Stolen by Olroth, who used it to keep himself alive; destroyed in the encounter with Dannig and the Exile.

nodes.name: Utzaal time gateway
nodes.summary: Device hidden beneath the Ziggurat Encampment requiring Vaal blood that opens a gate into Utzaal's past.

nodes.name: Vaal artifacts sought by the King
nodes.summary: Unspecified Vaal artifacts that the Kalguuran King ordered brought back to Kalguur (most went missing en route).

nodes.name: Voidstones
nodes.summary: Atlas upgrades unlocked by defeating pinnacle bosses and talking to Kirac: Decayed (Elder), Ceremonial (Maven), Omniscient/Grasping (Searing Exarch / Eater quests, 3.17), Originator Voidstone (Incarnation of Dread). In 3.28.0 the Exarch and Eater together give one Voidstone and the Incarnation of Dread gives the extra one.

nodes.name: Watchstones
nodes.summary: Crystallised memories of the Elder's past victims, expelled when it was defeated by the Cosmic Arcana; Baran left one behind (Zana dialogue). As game items, Watchstones were socketed into Citadels in the legacy 3.9-3.16 Atlas. Their relation to Voidstones is not stated in the corpus.

nodes.name: Waygate (Map Device)
nodes.summary: Machine at the Ziggurat Refuge that Doryani calls a 'Waygate': built over underground leylines, it can take the Exile anywhere the leylines reach; a Waystone placed in it opens a Map. The wiki quest text does not say who built it (the earlier draft's 'Precursor-built' is unsupported).
sources: Doryani: 'The machine you see here... I call it... a Waygate. Using the leylines, the Waygate can take us anywhere they reach.'

nodes.name: Waystone
nodes.summary: Item Doryani gives the Exile to mark coordinates and place in the Waygate to open a Map; the key mechanic of the PoE2 Atlas.
sources: Doryani: 'Take this Waystone. Mark your desired coordinates on it. Place it in the Waygate.'

nodes.name: Wings of Vastiri
nodes.summary: Highest symbol of office of the Maraketh Sekhema of Sekhemas, last worn by Asenath before Hector Titucius murdered her; recovered from Hector in the Bath House for Hargan, who plans to sell it back to the Maraketh.

alt_summaries.summary: Maraketh symbol of office taken by Titucius, retrieved from his undead remains in Act 4.

nodes.name: Yaomac's Orb of Sacrifice
nodes.summary: PoE2 currency orb (introduced 0.5.4) that removes a random explicit modifier to upgrade a Corruption enchantment on a Rare Weapon or Quiver. Drops from the Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen. Its name matches the deity deity_yaomac; the item page does not state a naming origin.
sources: title and description: 'Yaomac's Orb of Sacrifice' - 'Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Weapon or Quiver and removes a Random Modifier'; drop_text: 'Can drop from Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen.'

nodes.name: Yugul's Orb of Sacrifice
nodes.summary: PoE2 currency orb (introduced 0.5.4) that removes a random explicit modifier to upgrade a Corruption enchantment on a Rare Jewel. Drops from the Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen. Its name matches the deity deity_yugul; the item page does not state a naming origin.
sources: title and description: 'Yugul's Orb of Sacrifice' - 'Upgrades a Corruption Enchantment on a Rare Jewel and removes a Random Modifier'; drop_text: 'Can drop from Royal Trove in Atziri's Temple after defeating Atziri, the Red Queen.'

nodes.name: Abaxoth, the End of All That Is
nodes.summary: Unique Beyond demon that dual-wields two Edges of Madness and uses Ice Spear with Greater Multiple Projectiles, Vaal Storm Call and Summon Skeletons; it was introduced in 1.2.0 with the Beyond demons and removed in 3.19.0, when Beyond demons were replaced by Scourge monsters.
sources: Intro: 'is a unique Beyond Demon'; header '3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with monsters from Scourge'; Version history 1.2.0 'Introduced' / 3.19.0 'Removed from the game'
infobox and lead; Version History (1.2.0 introduced, 3.19.0 removed)
lead: 'Rampage league ... ran concurrently with Beyond league' (1.2.0)

alt_summaries.summary: Unique Beyond demon, seen dual-wielding two Edges of Madness, with Berserk Fury and a Chaos damage-over-time aura. The wiki states that 3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with Scourge monsters and removed Abaxoth.

nodes.name: Adiyah, the Wayfinder
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior and Wayfinder of the Rogue Harbour who opens Heist and Grand Heist portals for the exile. Her sister Nashta the Usurper tried to incite a civil war in the Maraketh; Adiyah and the exile stop her in the questline's final contract.
sources: Walkthrough: "Open portal to the contract zone by interacting with Adiyah"

nodes.name: Administrator Qotra
nodes.summary: Figure named on flavour text of replica uniques and as a Heist contract client; Kalandra says she 'meddles with forces she does not understand'. Item Qotra's Regulator (Ritual league) may refer to her.

nodes.name: Admiral Valerius
nodes.summary: Pirate boss fought in Sailor's Folly when a shipment is commandeered; can drop Admiral's Arrogance.

nodes.name: General Adus
nodes.summary: Commander of Highgate who joined Voll; sheltered in Highgate Refinery; killed in Act 9.

nodes.name: Ahkeli, the Clayshaper
nodes.summary: Descendant of the primeval civilisation, 'Honoured Founder' of the Order of the Djinn who, with the surviving Maraketh, repelled Lightless invasions during the Winter of the World; central figure of late primeval history (Ahkeli's rings).
sources: Primeval civilization: Ahkeli; The Order of the Djinn

alt_summaries.summary: Primeval survivor whose home and family were destroyed, who sought refuge in the ash clouds and joined a Maraketh akhara to found the Order of the Djinn and defeat the Lightless; died before Solerai and Lundara ended the Winter.
Honoured founder of the Order of the Djinn, descendant of the primeval civilization that protected the Maraketh; per Kalandra took refuge at the Lake for a time.

nodes.name: Ahuana
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Ramako tribe who believes Ramako was impersonated by a deceiver; her text covers the Cataclysm as experienced in Ngamakanui.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

alt_summaries.summary: Minimal node: Karui chieftain, daughter of Hyrri Ngamaku who succeeded her as ruler; encountered in the Halls of the Dead.

nodes.name: Ahuatotli, the Blind
nodes.summary: Vaal figure fought as a Delve boss in the Vaal Nexus (Grand Architect's Temple); also a Timeless Jewel (Glorious Vanity) name.

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal-themed Delve boss in The Grand Architect's Temple.

nodes.name: Ailith, First of the Keepers
nodes.summary: Founder/leader of the Keepers of the Flame (Order of the Purple Flame) in the Monastery; in PoE1 3.27/3.28 she enlists the Exile against the Hiveborn at the Coast (Act 6), gives the Exile the flame to burn Hiveborn barriers and destroys Fortified Breaches. Author of The Word of the Dreamer. Revealed (Keepers league) to have died long ago: the Dreamer preserved her essence and keeps copies of her, burning and replacing her when she learns this. Also in PoE2.
sources: Talk to Ailith; summon Ailith to destroy Fortified Breach
written by Ailith, First of the Keepers
Dialogue "Enter Back Room": "you died, long ago. I preserved your essence."
Lore: Ailith founded the Order after visions; clone/preserved essence
Lore: Ailith founded the Order; she is a copy the Dreamer keeps; PoE2 version aware of her nature
Sky Hives: defend Ailith while she closes the domain

alt_summaries.summary: Leader of the Keepers; tends the Genesis Tree at the Monastery, receives dream warnings, and guides the Exile to graft Breach flesh onto themselves.

Founder of the Order of the Purple Flame / Keepers of the Flame after visions of the Dreamer (PoE1 Keepers); in PoE2 0.5 she leads the Breach questline against the Hiveborn, defends the Sky Hive domain closure and is a preserved essence/copy kept by the Dreamer, who has become somewhat self-aware. 'Alith' is a guide misspelling.

nodes.name: Aisling Laffrey
nodes.summary: Syndicate member without established background. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Akoya
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Tukohama tribe, resident of the Halls of the Dead and an opponent in the Trial of the Ancestors.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: Akthi, the Final Sting
nodes.summary: Corrupted scorpion boss at the far end of the Khari Crossing, killed in the Clearing the Way quest (PoE2 Interlude 2).
sources: Objective 'Defeat Akthi, the Final Sting and Anundr, the Sandworm'; quest log '===Find the Scorpion and Sandworm==='

nodes.name: Al-Hezmin, the Hunter
nodes.summary: Competitive hunter elderslayer of Redblade clan origin who keeps a journal of rivalries and plots to kill Drox.

nodes.name: Alano Phrecia
nodes.summary: General who defeated the dark being in 35 IC, sealed it away and was crowned Emperor, founding the Phrecian line.

nodes.name: Aldur
nodes.summary: First King of Kalguur and first Runefather, inventor of runesmithing (Verisium runes capturing starlight); his Runefathers forged the Triskelion Flame after his death.

alt_summaries.summary: First Runefather and first king of Kalguur; by legend crafted the first runes.

nodes.name: Alira
nodes.summary: Bandit lord of the Western Forest who uses corpse-detonation magic (Detonate Dead) and a cauldron; wears Alira's Amulet, one of three pieces of the Apex.

nodes.name: Alva Valai
nodes.summary: Treasure hunter and archaeologist of Vaal descent; PoE1 Incursion Master who creates temporal incursions into Atzoatl; PoE2 Act 3 companion at the Ziggurat Encampment whose Vaal blood activates the time gateway.

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal-descended treasure hunter who guides the Exile through Utzaal, activates the time gateway and is rescued from Doryani.
PoE1 (Incursion) explorer who travels with the Exile and the Hooded One to Kingsmarch, goes ahead to her contact Rog in Kingsmarch and then departs to study a tome. Continuity link to PoE1.

nodes.name: Amanamu, Liege of the Lightless
nodes.summary: Abyssal Lich, commander of the Lightless and servant of Kulemak. Boss of the Abyssal Depths (Abyss league 3.1.0).
sources: Lich Lords who serve under Kulemak - Amanamu, Kurgal, and Ulaman

alt_summaries.summary: Amanamu is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.
Lich Lord under Kulemak; boss of the Abyssal Depths.

nodes.name: High Templar Andronicus
nodes.summary: High Templar backing Tyndarus Phrecius c. 870 IC.

nodes.name: Ange
nodes.summary: Kingsmarch marketeer (Hostile Takeover) who learnt from Rog and Faustus ('rest his soul' - Faustus is dead) and sets up the Shoreline Hideout.

alt_summaries.summary: Marketeer in PoE2 Kingsmarch who learned from Rog and Faustus ('rest his soul'); gives Hostile Takeover.

nodes.name: Anundr, the Sandworm
nodes.summary: Corrupted sandworm boss at the far end of the Khari Crossing, killed in the Clearing the Way quest (PoE2 Interlude 2).
sources: Objective 'Defeat Akthi, the Final Sting and Anundr, the Sandworm'; quest log '===Defeat Akthi and Anundr==='

nodes.name: Aoife
nodes.summary: Spirit of a woman killed by the King in the Mists (the 'King of the Nameless'), who once drew her and the Druid in as a supposed Maji; she appears near a Ritual Altar in a map, bound to the Wildwood/Caer Tarth area, and asks the Exile to destroy the King's effigies. She is the Druid's lost love (Druid dialogue: 'Aoife? You return to me once more!'). She is laid to rest after the Bodach falls.
sources: Aoife: 'Killed by the King of the Nameless... The King in the Mists'; Quest Complete
Aoife lingers as a restless spirit, bound to the Wildwood

nodes.name: Archbishop Geofri the Abashed
nodes.summary: Archbishop Geofri the Abashed, a supporter of Voll's Purity Rebellion; boss of the Crypt (Fellshrine) tied to the Golden Hand of Through Sacred Ground.

nodes.name: Sekhema Asala
nodes.summary: Sekhema of the Ardura akhara; leads the Maraketh against the Faridun and executes Jamanra the Abomination.
sources: Quest log 'Consult with Asala' / 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'

alt_summaries.summary: Ardura Sekhema in PoE2 who opens the Halani Gates and kills Jamanra, accepting Faridun warriors.
Maraketh Sekhema of the Ardura who unifies the akharas for war; officiates the Gifting of Water at Qimah.

nodes.name: Sekhema Asenath
nodes.summary: Maraketh Sekhema of Sekhemas ('the Golden Sekhema') who last wore the Wings of Vastiri and was murdered by Hector Titucius.
sources: Hargan: last worn by Sekhema Asenath, the Golden Sekhema

nodes.name: Asinia, the Praetor's Consort
nodes.summary: Draven's consort in the Tomb of the Consort; the Exile destroys her to obtain her Memorial Key piece.

alt_summaries.summary: Draven's consort, boss in Tomb of the Consort in PoE2 Act 1.

nodes.name: Atalui, Vaal Priestess
nodes.summary: Vaal priestess mentioned only in flavour text of Bloodseeker (not to be confused with PoE2's Atalui).

nodes.name: Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
nodes.summary: Last Queen of the Vaal: vain, narcissistic ruler obsessed with eternal youth and beauty who demanded ever more sacrifice. Her pursuit of immortality with Doryani led to the Vaal Cataclysm; she ended trapped in a crimson nightmare realm. Boss in PoE1 (Apex of Sacrifice, Alluring Abyss/Uber, Throne of Atziri) and pinnacle boss (Atziri, the Red Queen) of PoE2's Fate of the Vaal.
sources: Quest log 'Capture Doryani' (quote 'Atziri will soon commune with the Beast')

alt_summaries.summary: Queen of the Vaal, whose planned communion with the Beast in Utzaal's past led to the Vaal Cataclysm.
Name for Atziri when fought in the Alluring Abyss (assembled from the four Mortal fragments): mechanically the same boss as at the Apex of Sacrifice but with area modifiers that make it far harder.

nodes.name: Aukuna, the Black Sekhema
nodes.summary: Sekhema (leader) of the Maraketh; general of the Maraketh legion.

nodes.name: Aul, the Crystal King
nodes.summary: Slave who led an uprising against Putembo, became Ahn and a tyrant, bargained with Kulemak, and as possessed golems destroyed his realm enacted a final ritual encasing his citadel in azurite crystal. Delve boss.

alt_summaries.summary: Also Ahn; former slave who led an uprising and became the last king of the primeval civilisation; deceived by Kulemak (golem for power), which ended his civilisation; he sealed himself and his citadel in azurite crystal. Delve boss at depth 130+.

nodes.name: High Templar Avarius
nodes.summary: High Templar who ordered the Templar Courts and Chamber of Innocence built shortly before PoE1. In Act 5 the Exile defeats him in the Templar Courts; he then becomes a vessel for Innocence.
sources: section 'Lore' (exile enters the Templar Courts and defeats High Templar Avarius in Act 5)
Staff of Avarius in the Chamber of Innocence

alt_summaries.summary: Replaced Dominus in Oriath; vessel of Innocence; built the Templar Courts; killed by exile Act 5.
Dominus's successor as High Templar, secret vessel of the god Innocence; Act 5 boss in the Chamber of Innocence.
High Templar who served as Innocence's vessel in Act 5; his Staff of Purity is recovered in Act 10 to break Kitava's Horns and revive Innocence in a new host.

nodes.name: Azarian, the Forsaken Son
nodes.summary: Unique guardian of the Buried Shrines of Keth, defeated to reach the Essence of Water.

alt_summaries.summary: Son of Halani, abandoned and raised among the Faridun; Act 2 boss in Buried Shrines.

nodes.name: Azmadi, the Faridun Prince
nodes.summary: Self-styled Faridun prince leading a rogue sect, allied with the Serpent Clan, who attacked the Gifting of Water; defeated at Qimah Reservoir.

nodes.name: Balbala, the Traitor
nodes.summary: Act 2 boss in Traitor's Passage whose barya (Balbala's Barya) holds her soul and is the quest key to the Trial of the Sekhemas.
sources: Shambrin: Her barya contains her soul

alt_summaries.summary: Former Maraketh traitor sealed as an undying Djinn in Traitor's Passage; released by the Exile and becomes a mentor Djinn.

nodes.name: Bannon
nodes.summary: Former Oriath soldier who asks the Exile to stop Utula; vendor after Avarius.
sources: quest Death and Rebirth: Bannon used the Staff of Purity and sacrificed himself to resurrect Innocence
Bannon: 'I will become his host in the fullest sense'

alt_summaries.summary: Templar commander and Act 10 ally who uses the Staff of Purity to resurrect Innocence, sacrificing himself; Lani says he went to Hinekora's home. Minimal node (owned by campaign domain).

Act 5 vendor and ally of Lani who bears the fire of Ngamahu; rescued by the exile on the Cathedral Rooftop in Act 10, he uses the Staff of Avarius and sacrifices himself to become the host of the resurrected Innocence.

nodes.name: Baran, the Crusader
nodes.summary: Templar elderslayer who hears 'God's whispers', blames Zana for sealing the device and plans an Atlas nation; brother of Kirac. Kirac says the Maven resurrects him to watch his fights with the Exile.

nodes.name: Beidat
nodes.summary: Leader of the 'pale demons', one of the three Scourge factions; unlike the headless-drone demon and flesh factions he can speak and bargain with humans, and gave Lycia immortality.

alt_summaries.summary: Scourge boss (Archangel of Death) that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats and no individual lore.

nodes.name: Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia
nodes.summary: Twilight Order herald and boss of The Excavation in Act 4. Demands the weapon pieces from the Exile and Kanu, tries to bury them to cover the Countess's retreat.
sources: Confront Kanu and the First Herald
Defeat Benedictus: 'My lady... you must take your leave! ... For the Saviourrr!'

alt_summaries.summary: Twilight Order herald, boss of the Excavation; left by the Countess to bury the Exile.

nodes.name: Bestel
nodes.summary: Lioneye's Watch merchant and amateur poet who asks the exile to kill Abberath.

alt_summaries.summary: Sailor-poet at Lioneye's Watch whose ship the Merry Gull ran aground; his epic and rewards follow Act 1 quests (also Act 6).

nodes.name: Betucia
nodes.summary: Named on a Gilded Cartography Scarab as 'Bearer of the Sealing Blade' who sacrificed themselves to imprison the Elder; the Order of the Djinn 'will be forever wounded by your loss'.

nodes.name: The Black Star
nodes.summary: Champion of the Cleansing Fire met in the Polaric Void; precedes the Exarch.

nodes.name: Brutus, Lord Incarcerator
nodes.summary: Legendary warden of Axiom Prison who had himself transformed by thaumaturges (Shavronne of Umbra) into a hulking monster; killed in The Caged Brute.

alt_summaries.summary: Warden of Axiom Prison; his transformation by Shavronne drove him mad; Act 1 boss.

nodes.name: King Cadigan the First
nodes.summary: Kalguuran king under whom the Triskelion Flame was a symbol of authority; the Flame had earlier been taken by a self-proclaimed descendant of Aldur who had challengers killed.

nodes.name: Cadiro Perandus
nodes.summary: Perandus family member and uncle of Emperor Chitus Perandus, who used his wealth to rig the Lord's Labyrinth in Chitus's favour. NPC of Perandus league (2.2.0) selling items for Perandus Coins from caches he hid after the Cataclysm; later available as Syndicate Research-safehouse/hideout NPC; named on the Elegant Hubris timeless jewel.
sources: lead: Cadiro hid the family treasures in secret caches

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus' uncle, patron of Prospero; engineered Perandus' win, surrendered Sarn to Voll, and hid the treasury, binding debtors in undeath to guard it.

nodes.name: Cameria the Coldblooded
nodes.summary: Assassin/murderer Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Captain Arteri
nodes.summary: Boss on the Western Forest road carrying the Thaumetic Emblem for the Thaumetic Seal.

nodes.name: Captain Fairgraves
nodes.summary: Marooned sea captain in the Ship Graveyard who found the Allflame, tried to kindle it with the Exile's life and was killed; reappears as an in-between spirit at the Act 3 Docks.

nodes.name: Captain Hartlin
nodes.summary: Freya Hartlin's son; he died and became the undead boss of Journey's End. His last words, 'Do not... believe his lies...', implicitly warn against Tangmazu (inference).

nodes.name: The Cardinal of Fear
nodes.summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Fear; Eagon siphons its kernel.

nodes.name: Caspiro
nodes.summary: Second Emperor, a low-born legionnaire who survived a labyrinth trial; dismembered by a dark being five years after Veruso's death.

nodes.name: Catarina, Master of Undeath
nodes.summary: Necromancer forsaken master who became leader of the Immortal Syndicate (the Mastermind); wanted to become eternal queen; killed the Order of the Djinn for the Horns of Kulamac; boss in Mastermind's Lair. Writer of the Lifegiver's Manifesto.

nodes.name: Cavas
nodes.summary: Amnesiac 'forgotten spirit' NPC of Synthesis who opens memory zones for the exile; he recovers his memories in the Atlas and is revealed to be High Templar Venarius, thereafter an antagonist while Zana takes over his guide role.

alt_summaries.summary: Memoryless spirit/old man in Synthesis who seeks his lost memories in the Memory Nexus; fragments suggest a beach childhood. Exact identity not resolved in sources read.

nodes.name: Chiara
nodes.summary: Wife of Veruso; died in childbirth; Ankh ritual reportedly made her a monster.

nodes.name: Chitus Perandus
nodes.summary: Perandus who rigged the Lord's Labyrinth, poisoned the Ezomyte slave Weylin, and became Emperor in 1319 IC. Brutal, vain, ruled with Malachai's gemling thaumatocracy; killed by Ondar at the Night of a Thousand Ribbons in 1334 IC.
sources: section 'Reign of Chitus' and 'The Lord's Labyrinth'

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus Perandus, crowned Emperor in 1319 IC. He wins the Lord's Labyrinth by betraying Weylin, then seals Izaro inside it. Overthrown by the Purity Rebellion.
Minimal node: Eternal Empire emperor of the Perandus family, nephew of Cadiro; assassinated during the Purity Rebellion by Ondar. Full entry owned by the Eternal Empire domain.
Emperor of the Eternal Empire.

nodes.name: Clarissa
nodes.summary: Exile woman rescued from Blackguards in Sarn; becomes Sarn Encampment accessory vendor; lover of Tolman.

alt_summaries.summary: Sarn survivor (captured with Tolman in Act 3, she escaped) who in Act 8 tries to revive her dead lover Tolman with the Ankh of Eternity; the ritual fails, and she resolves to destroy the Ankh.

nodes.name: Druid (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Strength/Intelligence class (primal and shapeshifting specialist). A former Druid of Skothe, the last of his kind, searching Wraeclast for his wife Aoife. Ascendancies: Shaman, Oracle.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Strength/Intelligence' / 'Druid': 'The Druid specializes in primal skills, which include shapeshifting, animal minions, and nature spells. His ascendancy classes are the Shaman and Oracle.'
page 'Lore': 'The Druids were wiped out by the King in the Mists and his cultists, who deceived them by disguising himself as a Maji of the old.'

nodes.name: Duelist (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class. Dominus: "Welcome to the greatest of arenas, Duelist. God is watching."; Gravicius: "Your soul was lost long ago!" Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Duelist (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Strength/Dexterity class (sword specialist). Unreleased in the corpus: ascendancies marked TBA, no lore section. The wiki notes it was once intended to be renamed Gladiator, a decision reversed before Early Access.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Strength/Dexterity' / 'Duelist': 'The Duelist specializes in sword skills.'
section 'Trivia': 'none of the player characters are exiles, as that refers to criminals exiled from Oriath.'
section 'Ascendancy classes': 'Duelists can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:' (followed by TBA entries); page carries {{unreleased}}

nodes.name: Huntress (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Dexterity class (spear specialist), an Azmeri who once lived among the Maji and was banished after using a virtue gem to protect her village. Ascendancies: Ritualist, Amazon, Spirit Walker.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Dexterity' / 'Huntress': 'The Huntress specializes in spear skills. Her ascendancy classes are the Ritualist, Amazon, and Spirit Walker.'
page 'Lore': 'One day, she used a virtue gem to protect her village against invaders, and was banished for doing so.'

nodes.name: Marauder (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Karui-descended Exile class. Dominus's boss line to the Marauder: "I exiled an animal. Now you almost resemble a man, Karui."; General Gravicius: "You've forgotten your place, Karui slave!" Specific crime not given in the sources read.

nodes.name: Marauder (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Strength class (axe specialist). Unreleased in the corpus: its ascendancy list is marked TBA and it has no lore section.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Strength' / 'Marauder': 'The Marauder specializes in axe skills.'
section 'Trivia': 'none of the player characters are exiles, as that refers to criminals exiled from Oriath.'
section 'Ascendancy classes': 'Marauder can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:' (followed by TBA entries); page carries {{unreleased}}

nodes.name: Mercenary (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Strength/Dexterity class (crossbow and grenade specialist), described as a seasoned mercenary from Trarthus. The artbook calls the Mercenary a veteran of Oriathan military; in-game the Mercenary is Trarthan. Ascendancies: Witchhunter, Gemling Legionnaire, Tactician.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Strength/Dexterity' / 'Mercenary': 'The Mercenary specializes in crossbow and grenade skills. His ascendancy classes are the Witchhunter, Gemling Legionnaire, and Tactician.'
page 'Lore': 'The Mercenary is a seasoned mercenary from the land of Trarthus, a place infamous for its crime and degeneracy.'

nodes.name: Monk (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Dexterity/Intelligence class (unarmed and quarterstaff specialist), a Keepers of the Flame monk of Ezomyte heritage devoted to the Dreamer. Ascendancies: Invoker, Acolyte of Chayula, Martial Artist.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Dexterity/Intelligence' / 'Monk': 'The Monk specializes in unarmed and quarterstaff skills. His ascendancy classes are the Invoker, Acolyte of Chayula, and Martial Artist.'
page 'Lore': 'The Monk is a member of the Keepers of the Flame, a monastic cult dedicated to the worship of the being known as the Dreamer'

nodes.name: Ranger (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class (female). Dominus: "It is woman's purpose to tempt and try the will of man."; Gravicius: "little girl". Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Ranger (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Dexterity class (bow specialist), a reclusive Ezomyte who once lived in The Grelwood. Ascendancies: Deadeye, Pathfinder.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Dexterity' / 'Ranger': 'The Ranger specializes in bow skills. Her ascendancy classes are the Deadeye and Pathfinder.'
page 'Lore': 'The Ranger is a reclusive Ezomyte who once lived in The Grelwood.'

nodes.name: Scion (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Seventh Exile class, available only after reaching Act 3 (unlock details not re-verified). Dominus: "I offered you the gift of exile and you used it to reinvent yourself." No further heritage lore verified.

nodes.name: Shadow (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class. Dominus: "I've dealt with far darker shadows than you, exile."; Gravicius: "You're not the only one who wields death as a weapon, boy!" Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Shadow (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Dexterity/Intelligence class (dagger and trap specialist). Unreleased in the corpus: ascendancies marked TBA, no lore section. It was intended to be renamed Assassin, a decision reversed before Early Access.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Dexterity/Intelligence' / 'Shadow': 'The Shadow specializes in dagger and trap skills.'
section 'Trivia': 'none of the player characters are exiles, as that refers to criminals exiled from Oriath.'
section 'Ascendancy classes': 'Shadows can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:' (followed by TBA entries); page carries {{unreleased}}

nodes.name: Sorceress (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Intelligence class (elemental spells), a Maraketh from the Vastiri Deserts, banished from her akhara for unspecified reasons. Ascendancies: Stormweaver, Chronomancer, Disciple of Varashta.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Intelligence' / 'Sorceress': 'The Sorceress specializes in elemental spells. Her ascendancy classes are the Stormweaver, Chronomancer, and Disciple of Varashta.'
page 'Lore': 'She was banished from her akhara for unspecified reasons; on her accord, she had left the Maraketh before taking an oath'

nodes.name: Templar (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class belonging to the Templar faith: Dominus addresses the Templar as "my brother" ("Exile has tested you, my brother"); Gravicius: "You're god's greatest disappointment." Specific crime not documented in the sources read.
sources: intro: 'The character class Templar is a former member of the Order prior to his exile before the start of Act 1'

alt_summaries.summary: The Templar class: a former member of the Order of the Templar who was exiled before the start of Act 1 and is a playable PoE1 class. The Exile's backstory as a Templar is given by the wiki only for this class.

nodes.name: Templar (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Strength/Intelligence class (flail and holy spell specialist). Unreleased in the corpus: ascendancies marked TBA, no lore section.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Strength/Intelligence' / 'Templar': 'The Templar specializes in flail skills and holy spells.'
section 'Trivia': 'none of the player characters are exiles, as that refers to criminals exiled from Oriath.'
section 'Ascendancy classes': 'Templars can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:' (followed by TBA entries); page carries {{unreleased}}

nodes.name: Warrior (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Strength class (mace, warcry and shield specialist). An orphan born into a family of Karui slaves, raised as an Ezomyte in Clearfell by the blacksmith Renly. Ascendancies: Titan, Warbringer, Smith of Kitava.

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Strength' / 'Warrior': 'The Warrior specializes in mace, warcry, and shield skills. His ascendancy classes are the Titan, Warbringer, and Smith of Kitava.'
page 'Lore': 'found by the blacksmith Renly, who adopted and raised him in Clearfell as an Ezomyte.'

nodes.name: Witch (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class. Dominus: "You'd bite the master that called you here, Witch?"; Gravicius: "whore of nightmare"; Piety addresses the Witch as 'sister' in Act 4. A developer-interview reason for the Witch's exile (PC Gamer) could NOT be re-verified in this check and has been removed.

nodes.name: Witch (PoE2 class)
nodes.summary: PoE2 Intelligence class (occult and chaos spells). Heritage unknown; the wiki says she was born to a swamp coven, likely the Black Fen. Ascendancies: Infernalist, Blood Mage, Lich (plus the alternate Abyssal Lich).

chronology.relative: PoE2 campaign (class chosen at character creation)

sources: section 'Intelligence' / 'Witch': 'The Witch specializes in occult spells, which includes undead minions and chaos spells. Her Ascendancy classes are the Infernalist, Blood Mage, and Lich.'
page 'Lore': 'she was born to a swamp coven, likely the Black Fen.'

nodes.name: Cnaeus
nodes.summary: Priest 'of the Order' listed as a Twilight Order member under Torvian, Hand of the Saviour. No further detail in sources read.

nodes.name: The Cortex
nodes.summary: Synthesis memory boss in a Distant Memory in the Nexus (arena forms listed as Fractal Gargantuan, Synthete Masterpiece, Fractal Titan, Synthete Nightmare).

nodes.name: Count Geonor
nodes.summary: Count of Ogham who imprisoned the Hooded One in the Prelude, about 20 years after Kitava's defeat,, took the Seed of Corruption, and ruled Ogham through terror. Killed by the Exile in Ogham Manor at the end of Act 1.

alt_summaries.summary: Count of Ogham who captures the Hooded One about 20 years after Kitava's death and extracts the Seed of Corruption. He then sentences the Exile to hang for questioning him.

nodes.name: Dannig, Warrior Skald
nodes.summary: Kalguuran blacksmith and Warrior Skald whose goal is to recover the Triskelion Flame; runesmith, game-night friend of Rog, Tujen and Gwennen; in PoE2 manages Verisium/Runeforging in Kingsmarch.
sources: Act 4 quest: bring Torn Map Pieces to Dannig

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran blacksmith and skald; Expedition NPC who starts The Lost Expedition quest (Act 6). He asks the exile to keep the Flame's fate from the settlers. In PoE2 he crafts Verisium Spikes at Kingsmarch.
Kalguuran warrior skald and smith in Kingsmarch who forges the Verisium Spikes freeing Freya Hartlin and later runes; sings tales the Karui like.
Kalguuran NPC met in Act 4 (The Runeseeker brings Torn Map Pieces to him) and at the Ruins of Kingsmarch in The Grand Expedition.

nodes.name: Daresso
nodes.summary: King of Swords of Theopolis' Grand Arena; left Oriath c. 1450 IC to cure Merveil; spirit used by Malachai; defeated in Act 4. Chronology caveat: the wiki dates his departure c. 1450 IC yet says his spirit was already used by Malachai (Eye of Desire, 1336 IC) and had been dead ~100 years; the wiki itself calls this 'inexplicable'.

alt_summaries.summary: Former slave gladiator and Sword King of the Grand Arena of Theopolis/Sarn, husband of Merveil; he abandoned her and sailed from Wraeclast seeking a cure, and later perished; boss of Daresso's Dream / Grand Arena in Act 4 who holds the Eye of Desire.

nodes.name: Davaro of Theopolis
nodes.summary: Templar thaumaturge who heard Vaal relics 'sing', saw visions of Atziri and sacrificed Karui slaves and Oriathan children to her altar.

nodes.name: Dawn
nodes.summary: Insane exile who calls himself 'The Dawn', devotee of Solaris who guards the Sun Orb in the Solaris Temple as the boss Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris.
sources: Lore: once an exile, became insane and a devotee of Solaris

alt_summaries.summary: Act 8 unique boss in the Solaris Temple Level 2 (quest Solar Eclipse). Per Maramoa 'the Dawn' was an exile who went insane and became a devotee of Solaris. Despite the title 'Harbinger' he is unrelated to Harbinger league.

nodes.name: The Deceitful God
nodes.summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Dread; Eagon siphons its kernel.

nodes.name: Delwyn
nodes.summary: Azmeri hunter in the Hunting Grounds who introduces the Azmerian wisp hunts; recognises the Huntress.

nodes.name: The Depraved Trinity
nodes.summary: Combined spirit of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre, manifested by Sin in the Rotting Core; final boss of Act 9.

nodes.name: Sekhema Deshret
nodes.summary: Ancient Maraketh Red Sekhema who sealed the Mines with the Beast and Kaom inside; fell to Voll, and her spirit was trapped in the Mines until freed.

alt_summaries.summary: Red Sekhema who destroyed Titucius' legion, sealed the Highgate mines, and was killed by Voll; spirit rescued in Act 9.

nodes.name: Dhunan
nodes.summary: Historical Order of the Djinn member, 'Blightmaster', a castaway who knew how to contain the Blight and theorised the Blightheart.

nodes.name: Lady Dialla
nodes.summary: Malachai's concubine and promised Gemling Queen; jewels set along her spine. Refused to sacrifice herself in the Rapture Device and survived centuries. Met in Act 3.

alt_summaries.summary: The Gemling Queen, Malachai's former lover and the Rapture Device's intended power source who chose not to sacrifice herself; guides the Exile in Acts 3-4.

nodes.name: Diamora, Song of Death
nodes.summary: Siren boss in the Singing Caverns of Whakapanu Island, behind the vanishing Karui settlers.

nodes.name: Divinia
nodes.summary: Templar archivist and relic enthusiast met at the Oriath Docks in Act 10 (quest 'Aiding an Archivist'); she sends the Exile for the Mortinomicon Exitio Immortalis and later sells relics inside the Sanctum. She knows far more about Lycia and the Scourge than she lets on; her true motives are left ambiguous.
sources: 'Talk to Divinia in Oriath Docks'; Mortinomicon dialogue
[1:24]-[1:50], [12:24]-[13:20], [36:38]-[37:15] (video places her meeting in Act 2 camp; wiki says Oriath Docks Act 10)

alt_summaries.summary: Templar archivist at the Oriath docks who seeks the Mortinomicon.

nodes.name: Doedre
nodes.summary: Doedre Darktongue (Stamatis), curse-obsessed pupil of Maligaro/member of the Godless Three; burned by Voll; revived by Malachai; fought in Act 4 (Harvest), Act 8 (Doedre's Cesspool) and Act 9 (Rotting Core).
sources: 'until the player character defeats her in Act 8'; 'In-game encounters'

alt_summaries.summary: Thaumaturge of the Godless Three burned at the stake by Voll; Act 4 boss in the Harvest, drops Malachai's Lungs.
Third of Malachai's Godless Three; her undead spirit lurks in the Sarn sewers and is killed in Act 8.

nodes.name: Dominus
nodes.summary: High Templar in PoE1's era who exiled criminals to Wraeclast; killed by the exile atop the Sceptre of God in Act 3.
sources: section 'Lore' (Dominus exiles criminals; killed atop the Sceptre of God in Act 3)

alt_summaries.summary: High Templar who orders criminals of Oriath exiled to Wraeclast, including the Exile. The Exile kills him atop the Sceptre of God in Act 3.
Highest-ranking High Templar of Oriath, controls Ebony Legion; pardoned Piety; final boss of Act 3 in the Sceptre of God; Ascendant form with blood magic.
Successor of Venarius as High Templar and exiler of the PoE1 protagonist.
Templar who brought Vaal relics to Oriath.

nodes.name: Doryani
nodes.summary: Vaal Royal Thaumaturgist to Queen Atziri (PoE1 wiki: Queen's Thaumaturgist); in PoE2 he is captured in Utzaal's past, agrees to help contain the Beast, and joins the present-day effort with a weapon fragment.
sources: Quest logs 'Capture Doryani' / 'Speak to Doryani in Ziggurat Encampment'
The Dark Ember: 'ancient wound wrought by that Vaalish overreacher, Doryani'

alt_summaries.summary: Minimal node (owned by Vaal domain): Vaal thaumaturgist under Atziri whose innovations and sacrifices contributed to the Fall of the Vaal; also appears in PoE2; named on Glorious Vanity.
Vaal Royal Thaumaturge (PoE1) companion of the PoE2 Exile: drives the Weapon search, prepares contingency Vaal reserves and in the endgame builds the Waygate.

Atziri's Royal Thaumaturge ('Queen's Thaumaturgist'), the most capable and ruthless mind of her court, whose gem, technology and Beast experiments brought the Vaal prosperity and, per PoE1, ruined them; Sin calls him a 'Vaalish overreacher' who wounded the Beast. PoE2 reframes the Cataclysm as Atziri's doing: Doryani secretly opposed her communion, was captured by the Exile in Act 3 (Utzaal's past) and brought to the present as an ally seeking to contain the Beast. Claims that he built 2,000-year contingencies come only from fan analysis.

nodes.name: Praetor Draven
nodes.summary: Eternal praetor entombed in the Cemetery of the Eternals; PoE2 Act 1 Memorial key.

alt_summaries.summary: Praetor of the Mausoleum; the Exile destroys him to obtain his Memorial Key piece.

nodes.name: Drox, the Warlord
nodes.summary: Warrior elderslayer who strives to found a just kingdom in the Atlas through force.

nodes.name: Dusk
nodes.summary: Insane exile ('exile-turned-sycophant', in Maramoa's words) who devotes himself to Lunaris and guards the Moon Orb in the Lunaris Temple as the boss Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris.
sources: Lore: according to Maramoa, "The Dusk" is an exile-turned-sycophant

alt_summaries.summary: Act 8 unique boss in the Lunaris Temple Level 2 (quest Lunar Eclipse). Per Maramoa 'the Dusk' is an exile-turned-sycophant who carried the Moon Orb into the Lunaris Temple. Unrelated to Harbinger league.

nodes.name: Dying Exile
nodes.summary: Wounded fellow exile on the beach who points the player toward smoke at ruins.

nodes.name: Eagon Caeserius
nodes.summary: Scholar and Atlas researcher who claims Zana as his sister and Valdo as father; chases the Originator's memory threads with the exile via Memory Tears and Astrolabes. Hints that his parentage is uncertain ('If I am not Valdo's bastard...'); his identity is a community mystery.
sources: Speak to Eagon quest log; Memory Vault dialogue
dev commentary: Eagon's situation remains complicated

alt_summaries.summary: Caeserius family member who recruits the Exile to follow Memory Threads to the Originator.

nodes.name: Eber, the Plaguemaw
nodes.summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0; the wiki marks the Pale Council fight as removed from the game in 3.17.0.
sources: Infobox: location = The Pale Court; header 'The prophecy system was removed ... in version 3.17.0. The Pale Council fight no longer exists'; Version history 2.3.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: Egrin
nodes.summary: Young Azmeri whose visions may have led the descent; later cast out and taken in by the Order of the Djinn.

nodes.name: Einhar Frey
nodes.summary: Master-NPC beastmaster who teaches the Exile to capture beasts and runs the Menagerie; appears in Act 2 (Forest Encampment, Einhar's Hunt).

nodes.name: Ekbab, Ancient Steed
nodes.summary: Guardian of the Mastodon Tusks in the Bone Pits, assisted by Iktab; defeated to obtain the Tusks for Zarka.
sources: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab'

nodes.name: The Elder
nodes.summary: Entity of malignant madness and servant of the Decay that preyed on children, feeding on their nightmares and later on Valdo's memories. Released by Venarius, it hunted the Atlas until the exile and Zana expelled it with the Cosmic Arcana; a memory of it remains as a pinnacle boss (Uber Elder).

alt_summaries.summary: Harder memory-version of the Elder met in the Shaper's Realm; Elder is a memory defeated 'with aid of a certain rogue cartographer' (Zana).

nodes.name: Elder Guardian: Constrictor
nodes.summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Constriction, part of the Key to Decay.
sources: The Elder section: Fragment of Constriction

nodes.name: Elder Guardian: Enslaver
nodes.summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Enslavement, part of the Key to Decay.
sources: The Elder section: Fragment of Enslavement

nodes.name: Elder Guardian: Eradicator
nodes.summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Eradication, part of the Key to Decay.
sources: The Elder section: Fragment of Eradication

nodes.name: Elder Guardian: Purifier
nodes.summary: One of the Elder's four guardians; defeating it yields the Fragment of Purification, part of the Key to Decay.
sources: The Elder section: Fragment of Purification

nodes.name: Elder Madox
nodes.summary: Elder of the Azmeri of Mount Kriar, found trapped by a Delirium mirror in a map; freed, he says the Winter Owl spoke to him of the Raven Trickster's return and asks the Exile to retrace the tale 'The Raven and the Hare' to the Withered Willow.
sources: Elder Madox: 'I am Elder Madox of the Azmeri of Mount Kriar. The Winter Owl spoke to me. His enemy returns. The Raven Trickster...'
Elder Maddox trapped in a Trickster trance (guide spelling)

nodes.name: Elreon, Loremaster
nodes.summary: Exiled Templar who believed thaumaturgy a divine gift; forsaken master (jewellery). Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord
nodes.summary: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord is a boss the Exile defeats in the Sel Khari Sanctuary during the Recruit the Maraketh interlude.
sources: Quest log, 'Defeat Elzarah, the Cobra Lord.'

nodes.name: The Empty-Eyed Fiend
nodes.summary: Entity Olroth could not defeat with blade or flame, prompting him to use gems; the Kalguur page links it to The Elder (identification inferred).

alt_summaries.summary: Horror Olroth could not harm with mortal blade or flame until a gem's starlight beheaded it.

nodes.name: The Envoy
nodes.summary: Messenger NPC met in T6+ maps who introduces the Maven and the Eldritch Horrors, speaking of the Struggle over the Atlas; speaks of Cleansing Fire's blindness to 'the lightkeeper'. Also gives the Flesh Compass and Luminous Astrolabe that let the Exile hunt the Tangle's and Cleansing Fire's footholds.
sources: Walkthrough: Envoy gives Flesh Compass / Luminous Astrolabe

nodes.name: Eramir
nodes.summary: Scholar from Theopolis (he looked after its museum) living at the Bridge Encampment; he translates the Vaal inscriptions on the relic that washed ashore, identifies the god Ralakesh and asks the exile to end Greust's possession. He fears another theocratic dictatorship.
sources: Valdo: 'until Eramir sent in ancient parchments'

alt_summaries.summary: Scholar-like resident of the Forest Encampment who holds theories on the Vaal ruin and Apex; starts Deal with the Bandits.
Scholar who sent Valdo the ancient parchments on the Watchers of Decay.

nodes.name: Essie and Paulius
nodes.summary: Paired Act 5 boss in datamine. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: Evilandra
nodes.summary: Hostile 'evil' reflection of Kalandra (ArbiterWildEvil in game files). She rarely appears in the Lake and has her own tile dialogue.

alt_summaries.summary: Rare hostile reflection of Kalandra in the Lake (game id ArbiterWildEvil) with glowing red eyes who duplicates map bosses.

nodes.name: The Exile (PoE1)
nodes.summary: The player's character in PoE1: a convict sentenced to Wraeclast by High Templar Dominus in 1599-1600 IC. The character washes up on the Twilight Strand, escapes a Templar boat, and fights through Acts 1-10 (defeating Dominus in Act 3, Voll's remains in Act 4, High Templar Avarius and Innocence in Act 5, and Kitava in Act 10 with Sin) and the Atlas storylines.
sources: section 'Lore' (exile escapes Templar boat; defeats Dominus, Avarius, Kitava)

alt_summaries.summary: The PoE1 protagonist, one of seven classes.
The PoE1 protagonist.

nodes.name: The Exile (PoE2)
