nodes.summary: The PoE2 protagonist: an Exile in Ogham, sentenced to death by Count Geonor. After escaping the Executioner by jumping into the ocean, the Exile chases the Seed of Corruption released by Geonor across Wraeclast about 20 years after Kitava's death.

chronology.relative: about 20 years after Kitava's defeat (PoE2 campaign)

alt_summaries.summary: The PoE2 protagonist.

nodes.name: Farrow
nodes.summary: PoE2 NPC who studies runes on Verisium Remnants (Runes of Aldur) and worries about Kingsmarch, sending the Exile in The Grand Expedition.

alt_summaries.summary: Ezomyte Runeseeker in PoE2 Kingsmarch investigating the origins of runes; hands out the Runeseeker quest.
Ezomyte runesmith in Kingsmarch researching rune origins and powerful Verisium; The Runeseeker quest leads to Plunder's Point; the Runes of Aldur league character.
Young blacksmith rescued in Clearfell in 0.5; studies Ezomyte runesmithing with Kalguuran origins and joins Expeditions.

nodes.name: Faustus, the Financier
nodes.summary: Former Heist captain turned Kingsmarch financier running the Currency Exchange, respec and Black Market; writes of waiting and watching the King; reported dead in PoE2 ('rest his soul').

alt_summaries.summary: Rogue Harbour fence who buys Heist targets in exchange for Rogue's Markers. The Kalguur page says Faustus, like Johan, has his sights set on Wraeclast.

nodes.name: Fidelitas, the Mourning
nodes.summary: Former slave Raulo, Maligaro's loyal lover/servant, deformed into a monster that guards the Baleful Gem.

nodes.name: Gaius Sentari
nodes.summary: Ezomyte slavemaster and governor beaten at Glarryn; ran Highgate 'civilization camps'.

nodes.name: General Gravicius
nodes.summary: Dominus's assistant in artifact gathering, Ebony Barracks boss; fire-damage specialist.

nodes.name: Archbishop Geofri
nodes.summary: Archbishop of Phrecia Cathedral killed by Maligaro; undead guardian in Act 2.

nodes.name: Count Geonor (Enigma Chamber)
nodes.summary: Count Geonor returns as an endgame challenge fight in the Precursor Enigma Chambers of Legacy of the Precursors.

nodes.name: Ghorr, the Grasping Maw
nodes.summary: Scourge boss that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats and no individual lore.

nodes.name: Gianna
nodes.summary: Deception rogue (the Master of Disguise). Backstory: she worked at the Theopolis Thespian Society in Oriath, and her early contracts involve Templar uniforms. Unlocked by a Vinderi contract.
sources: Lead and Lore: Theopolis Thespian Society; "To unlock Gianna, run a contract with Vinderi"

nodes.name: Gravicius Reborn
nodes.summary: Former Act 3 general, resurrected Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Greust
nodes.summary: Azmeri-friendly villager of the Forest Encampment (his shrine and necklace follow Azmeri custom) who becomes the avatar of Ralakesh through a washed-up Vaal relic in Act 7; the exile must kill him to force Ralakesh back into the relic. Helena asks that his necklace be laid at the Azmeri shrine in the Northern Forest.

alt_summaries.summary: Forest Encampment weapon/armour vendor and hunter, hostile to Oriathans; gives Intruders in Black. (Helena calls the village Azmeri; Greust's own ethnicity is not stated in the sources read.)

nodes.name: Grigor
nodes.summary: Poet-scholar of the Sarn Encampment who knows the ode 'Of Jewels and Eternity', sends the Exile to the Gemling Queen, then after Piety and Dominus; Maramoa says to 'look upon Grigor to see what life entails under Piety's influence'.

nodes.name: Guardian of the Void: Chimera
nodes.summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Chimera, part of the Key to the Crucible.
sources: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Chimera'

nodes.name: Guardian of the Void: Hydra
nodes.summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Hydra, part of the Key to the Crucible.
sources: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Hydra'

nodes.name: Guardian of the Void: Minotaur
nodes.summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Minotaur, part of the Key to the Crucible.
sources: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Minotaur'

nodes.name: Guardian of the Void: Phoenix
nodes.summary: One of the Shaper's four Guardians of the Void; defeating it yields the Fragment of the Phoenix, part of the Key to the Crucible.
sources: The Shaper section: 'Fragment of the Phoenix'

nodes.name: Guatelitzi
nodes.summary: Figure known only from the flavour text of Guatelitzi's Ablation (drop location Atziri's Temple): as a young man he was found among prisoners 'preparing their living bodies for sacrifice', and the High Priests recognised his inclinations and gave him a higher calling. Vaal placement is inferred from the Atziri's Temple drop location, not stated.

chronology.relative: Vaal era (inferred from Atziri's Temple drop location; no date stated)

sources: flavour_text: 'Young Guatelitzi was found moving among the prisoners, preparing their living bodies for sacrifice. The High Priests recognised his inclinations, and gave him a higher calling.'

nodes.name: Guff "Tiny" Grenn
nodes.summary: Syndicate member from the Brinerot warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Gwennen, the Gambler
nodes.summary: Kalguuran gambler and former rebel who avoids Kingsmarch because Johan, scarred by her, could recognise her and expose surviving rebels.

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran gambler and Expedition NPC who sells unidentified equipment and takes Broken Circle artifacts.
Kalguuran missing in the islands; rescued in The Grand Expedition; wife of Rog per 0.5.

nodes.name: Hailrake
nodes.summary: Boss of the Tidal Island holding Doctor Opden's Medicine Chest.

nodes.name: Haku, Armourmaster
nodes.summary: Karui forsaken master (armour); Syndicate member. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Hargan
nodes.summary: Sarn Encampment weapon/armour vendor; fence who seeks Victario's busts for his 'return to Oriath' fund.

alt_summaries.summary: Sarn Encampment trader who points out Doedre and sends the exile after the Wings of Vastiri.

nodes.name: Hayoxi
nodes.summary: Figure called 'The Architect of Destruction' in the flavour text of Hayoxi's Fulmination, who laid explosive powder under the royal temple 'one pinch at a time' and never found the courage to light it. Identity beyond the flavour text is not recorded in the corpus. Placement in the Vaal era is inferred from the royal-temple setting.

chronology.relative: Vaal era (inferred from royal-temple setting; no date stated)

sources: flavour_text: 'The Architect of Destruction slipped explosive powder under the royal temple one pinch at a time. For years, he clung to that, never finding the courage to light it.'

nodes.name: Hector Titucius, Eternal Servant
nodes.summary: One of the Undying: murderer of the Maraketh Sekhema Asenath (the Golden Sekhema), who again guards her Wings of Vastiri in the Bath House; Hargan wants the Wings to ransom back to the Maraketh.

alt_summaries.summary: Ezomyte-born gemling general, 'Scourge of the Maraketh', destroyed by Deshret's storm trap in 1333 IC.

nodes.name: Heldra of the Black Pyre
nodes.summary: Heldra of the Black Pyre is a foe the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands alongside Isolde of the White Shroud during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.
sources: Quest log, 'Defeat Isolde and Heldra' ('Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.')

nodes.name: Helena
nodes.summary: Young Oriathan Ebony Legion woman rescued from the Chamber of Sins; joins the Forest Encampment and directs the Lorrata plan.

alt_summaries.summary: Former Piety expedition member at the Bridge Encampment; tells of Maligaro's secret passage and Greust's memorial.

nodes.name: Herius
nodes.summary: Priest 'of the Order' listed as a Twilight Order member under Torvian, Hand of the Saviour. No further detail in sources read.

nodes.name: Hilda
nodes.summary: Monster hunter and Atlas Master (Hilda's Campsite); her endgame quest Hilda's Hunting has the Exile track and defeat four Great Beasts.
sources: Atlas Masters: Hilda, a monster hunter
Quest Complete: 'You have tracked and defeated four Great Beasts.'

nodes.name: Hillock, the Blacksmith
nodes.summary: Act 1 boss Hillock resurrected by the Mastermind and joined the Syndicate. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

alt_summaries.summary: First boss of Act 1 (Twilight Strand); exiled criminal turned zombie; later resurrected as Hillock, the Blacksmith of the Syndicate.
First boss: an undead exile (Hillock of Slaugh) with a sword in his chest guarding the end of the Twilight Strand; killed in Enemy at the Gate.

nodes.name: Huck
nodes.summary: Former soldier who joined the Ring after his discharge and hunts a lost friend, Enoch, who died in Templar research on augmentations. Hireable in Heists; unlocked by a Karst contract, and his contract unlocks Niles.
sources: Lead; Personal Questline; "To unlock Huck, run a contract with Karst" (Niles page); "Took it out not long after joining the Ring"

nodes.name: Queen Hyrri Ngamaku
nodes.summary: Kaom's niece, archer, led Karui archers at Lioneye's Watch and the Karui at the Grain Gate; after Kaom's death guided the remaining 500 Karui families home, became queen, had a child with Victario (per wiki) and was succeeded by her daughter Ahuana; later vanished.
sources: Lore: 'She later became the queen and had a child with Victario ... succeeded by her daughter, Ahuana'

alt_summaries.summary: Niece of King Kaom; trained in archery at Thebrus and led Karui women archers in the ambush that defeated Marceus Lioneye at Lioneye's Watch (Purity Rebellion). After Kaom's corruption she led 500 Karui families home to Ngamakanui, became queen, had a child with Victario, then vanished leading an army against an unknown threat; succeeded by Ahuana. General of the Karui legion in Legion league (3.7.0).
Kaom's niece; led the bow-women whose arrows surprised Lioneye and succeeded Kaom as Karui queen after he left.

nodes.name: Icius Perandus
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire-era scholar and translator of Vaalish texts (name suggests the Perandus family, not verified); hid four Golden Pages in the Sarn Archives; friend of Siosa; also cited as author of the 'Chronicle of Atzoatl'.

alt_summaries.summary: Scholar to the Empire, translated Vaal artefacts for Malachai, hid the Golden Pages, joined the Order of the Djinn.

nodes.name: Ignagduk, the Bog Witch
nodes.summary: Azak tribe unique boss of The Azak Bog in Act 3, who holds stolen children; slain in the Tribal Vengeance quest, dropping Ignagduk's Ghastly Spear.
sources: Infobox (boss Ignagduk, the Bog Witch); lead: 'Find Ignagduk in the Azak village'

nodes.name: Ikiaho
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Arohongui tribe, loyal to Arohongui; vouched for Rakiata in the Halls of the Dead and tells that Ramako was impersonated.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: Iktab, the Deathlord
nodes.summary: Undead lord assisting Ekbab in the Bone Pits.
sources: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab'

nodes.name: Incarnation of Dread
nodes.summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Reverence: Valdo's promise of a brighter future.

nodes.name: Incarnation of Fear
nodes.summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Trauma: Valdo's fury at Zana.

nodes.name: Incarnation of Neglect
nodes.summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Loneliness: Zana asks Valdo to admire the Atlas; 'Not now, Zana!'. Interpretive: its Valdo/Zana 'Not now, Zana!' memory suggests it embodies Valdo's neglect; the wiki does not state this.

nodes.name: The Infinite Hunger
nodes.summary: Primary champion of the Tangle fought in the Seething Chyme.

nodes.name: Inya, the Unbearable Whispers
nodes.summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0 and removed in 3.17.0 per the wiki; in 3.0.0 the Pale Council was rebalanced and Inya became a drop source for Inya's Epiphany.
sources: Infobox: location = The Pale Court; Drops: 'guaranteed to drop Inya's Epiphany ... if she was the last one to be killed ... the sequence ... is random'; Version history 3.17.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: Irasha
nodes.summary: Maraketh akhara of Highgate and rival of Tasuni for rule after Oyun's disappearance. Her twin sister died of a scorpion's sting during the womanhood trial; she asks the exile to kill Shakari and may receive the Sekhema Feather.

nodes.name: Isla, the Engineer
nodes.summary: Engineer building Kingsmarch's map devices and the Recombinator; her letter ('I'm so happy you're alive!') hints at a past connection with the Exile and mentions Kalguuran runes' strange effect on portals.
sources: Lead and Lore: "a skillset she acquired working under Inquisitor Dominus"

alt_summaries.summary: Engineer rogue hireable for Heists; per the wiki she worked under Inquisitor Dominus ~20 years before the PoE1 campaign and designed The Unbreakable, the design of which was stolen by the Templar. Also operates the Recombinator and Kalguuran Map Devices in Kingsmarch.
Former Templar chosen by Venarius to maintain the Map Device; now in Kingsmarch corresponding with Zana and experimenting with Kalguuran runes in map devices.

nodes.name: Isolde of the White Shroud
nodes.summary: Isolde of the White Shroud is a Holten-linked foe the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands alongside Heldra of the Black Pyre during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.
sources: Quest log, 'Defeat Isolde and Heldra' ('Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.')

nodes.name: It That Fled
nodes.summary: Breach-realm creature that fled the Breachlords' rule and is listed among Immortal Syndicate members; most Syndicate members fear it. (Not in Keepers league.) Identity beyond that unclear.
sources: 13:26 "being from the breach realm who fled the rule of the Breachlords"; 17:53 most members terrified of it
restrictions: It That Fled cannot appear in the Immortal Syndicate

nodes.name: It That Was Esh
nodes.summary: Hive Colony boss fought together with It That Was Tul (PoE1 3.27/3.28, PoE2 0.5.0). Per Ailith it is not the original Esh but possibly Esh's leftover remains after the fusion into Xesht.

alt_summaries.summary: Former Breachlord boss in the Hive Colony (paired with Tul).

nodes.name: It That Was Tul
nodes.summary: Hive Colony boss fought together with It That Was Esh (PoE1 3.27/3.28, PoE2 0.5.0); drops the Breachlord Sac / Breach rings. Per Ailith it is not the original Tul but possibly Tul's leftover remains after the fusion into Xesht.

alt_summaries.summary: Former Breachlord boss in the Hive Colony.

nodes.name: Ixan Keita
nodes.summary: Founder of House Keita, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

nodes.name: Ixchel
nodes.summary: Vaal Order of the Djinn member ('Godstealer') who stole the sleeping body of Yaomac for the Order; captured while infiltrating the Temple of Chaos and became the Trialmaster.

nodes.name: Emperor Izaro
nodes.summary: The last Phrecian emperor, impotent from inbreeding, who built the Lord's Labyrinth in 1317 IC to choose a successor. Sealed inside by Chitus. The Exile can still meet him as an enemy in the Labyrinth.
sources: section 'Reign of Izaro'; section 'Reign of Chitus'

alt_summaries.summary: Last Phrecian Emperor; childless, he built the Lord's Labyrinth to choose a successor. Chitus won it, then sealed Izaro inside. The exile fights him in the Labyrinth.

nodes.name: Jado
nodes.summary: Member of the Order of the Djinn first met in Interlude 2; reveals Jun has been rebuilding the Order in secret for 20 years since Catarina's fall. Atlas Master in 0.5, unlocked via an anomaly map near the Atlas start.
sources: first mentioned by Jado, NPC introduced in Interlude 2
Atlas Masters: Jado of the Order of the Djinn
Jado questline unlocked by completing an anomaly map near the starting location

alt_summaries.summary: Order of the Djinn agent who infiltrated the Sel Khari to guard the First Barya; promises the Order will 'be there' in Oriath.

nodes.name: Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
nodes.summary: Vaal advisor to Atziri mentioned only on the flavour text of Atziri's Foible.

nodes.name: Jamanra, the Risen King
nodes.summary: Faridun leader resurrected by the Countess, who locks the Halani Gates, summons sandstorms, and is later executed by Sekhema Asala as Jamanra the Abomination.
sources: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Risen King' / 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'

alt_summaries.summary: Faridun revolutionary leader resurrected by corruption in PoE2 Act 2, given death by Asala.

nodes.name: Janus Perandus
nodes.summary: Great-grandson of Chitus Perandus; former Order of the Djinn member and gambling addict who betrayed the order to Catarina and joined the Syndicate.

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus' great-grandson; Immortal Syndicate member who betrayed the Order of the Djinn.

nodes.name: Johan, the King's Hand
nodes.summary: Kalguuran official sent to execute Kingsmarch's Charter as the King's Hand and Treasurer; admits loyalty to both the King and the Charter's law; tolerates 'less than upstanding' residents so long as he sees no sedition. He bears a scar given by Gwennen.

nodes.name: Julius Perandus
nodes.summary: Father of Chitus.

nodes.name: Jun Ortoi
nodes.summary: Master NPC, survivor and guardian of the Forbidden Vaults of the Order of the Djinn; hunts the Syndicate after its killing of her order. Introduced in Betrayal; Act 9 quest "The Immortal Syndicate".
sources: 1:05 Jun Ortoi, Order of the Djinn

alt_summaries.summary: Veteran Order of the Djinn member; in PoE2 mentioned as rebuilding the Order since Catarina's fall 20 years earlier.

nodes.name: Justicar Casticus
nodes.summary: Templar justicar in the Control Blocks whose Eyes of Zeal give entry to the Templar Courts.

nodes.name: Kadavrus the Defiler
nodes.summary: Necromancer boss of the Fetid Pool who was raising the dead rhoa.

nodes.name: Kahuturoa
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Rongokurai tribe per the Karui page (some history text files him with the Ramako tribe); recounts Ramako, Kitava's defeat and the Maraketh 'thousand years'.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: Kaimana
nodes.summary: Karui healer-alchemist at Ngakanu working on a Blood Fever cure; sends the Exile for the Great White shark's fin. Says 'If the ancestors see you... you can never truly die'.

nodes.name: K'aj A'alai
nodes.summary: Third demon of the Vaal Temple map boss trio, variants of the Atziri trio; all released with Sacrifice of the Vaal.

nodes.name: K'aj Q'ura
nodes.summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map, a variant of the Atziri trio; uses Demon Cleave (Corrupted Blood) and Cyclone.

nodes.name: K'aj Y'ara'az
nodes.summary: Unique demon boss in the Vaal Temple map; one of a trio that are variants of the Atziri trio of the Apex of Sacrifice. Uses Dual Strike and Fire Enrage.

nodes.name: Kalandra
nodes.summary: Ancient being with an owl's body and human head, trapped in the Lake of Kalandra since the primordial era; she observes the world, scorns gods as 'thieves of virtue', and plans escape. Visited by the Order of the Djinn and the Clayshaper among others. Namesake of the Mirror of Kalandra.

alt_summaries.summary: Ancient owl-bodied being trapped in her lake since the primordial era; disdains gods ('thieves of virtue') and is said to have counselled Sin on creating the Beast.

nodes.name: Kanu
nodes.summary: First Mate of the Aurora May, listed among Twilight Order members: he is courted by Benedictus ('Accept Utopia!'), betrays Makoru, then reveals the Beast is kept in Oriath and is attacked by Tavakai ('Let the ancestors judge him') - death is implied.
sources: Confront Kanu and the First Herald; Defeat Benedictus

nodes.name: King Kaom
nodes.summary: Karui king who took Lioneye's Watch, was lured to Highgate by Malachai's voice posing as Tukohama and slain; defeated in Act 4.

alt_summaries.summary: King of the Karui (chieftain of the Ngamahu tribe) who invaded Lioneye's Watch for Voll's Purity Rebellion; later deceived by a vision from the 'black spirit', entered the Highgate mines, was corrupted by Malachai and sealed in with the Beast by Deshret; boss in Kaom's Stronghold (Act 4) holding the Eye of Fury.

nodes.name: Karst
nodes.summary: Lockpicking rogue in the Rogue Harbour; a Ring member (Kurai: 'assist member Karst') who aids the exile on the Trial Run contract and whose hire unlocks Huck.
sources: Walkthrough: "Talk to Karst, the Lockpick, the rogue that aids you"
'The Ring' dialogue: 'assist member Karst on this job'

nodes.name: Kastov
nodes.summary: Governor of Stridevolf in the Eternal Empire who joined High Templar Voll's Purity Rebellion in 1333 IC against the gemling thaumatocracy. Per the Victario page, unlike Voll, Ondar, Geofri and Adus he did not turn undead or into a ghost in the in-game present.
sources: intro paragraph: 'Governor Kastov of Stridevolf' listed among Voll's allies with Lord Mayor Ondar, Victario, Archbishop Geofri and Commander Adus

paragraph 'In 1333 IC, Victario supported the Purity Rebellion ... along with Kastov, Lord Mayor Ondar, Archbishop Geofri and Commander Adus'; and 'neither Victario nor Kastov turned into the undead or a ghost'
section '==Members==' > Purity Rebellion rebels: '** [[Kastov]], Governor of [[Stridevolf]]'

nodes.name: Kelari
nodes.summary: The assassin Djinn bound to serve the Sekhema Varashta as penance; an invulnerable minion of the Disciple of Varashta ascendancy that stays inert in its barya until commanded.
sources: section 'Overview': 'The three Djinns are Ruzhan the fire Djinn, Navira the water Djinn, and Kelari the assassin Djinn.'
section 'Overview': 'Each the Djinn are invulnerable minions that remain inert in their Baryas until the Disciple commands them to unleash their powers.'

nodes.name: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
nodes.summary: Vaal High Priest of the Sun whose writings Alva cites about research in the Temple of Kopec (device/time gateway); boss in the Temple of Kopec defeated by the Exile in PoE2 Act 3.
sources: Quest 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun'

alt_summaries.summary: Vaal high priest of the Sun God in the Temple of Kopec whose research leads to the time gateway.

nodes.name: Kiloava
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Valako tribe, absorbed by Kaom's conquests; speaks on how tribes may change their gods.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: King Cadigan
nodes.summary: Mysterious tyrant-king of Kalguur whose name all kings share (possibly one person extending life by artifice); spies on subjects, instituted shipment taxes, has his eye on Wraeclast, and in PoE2 ordered Vaal artifacts brought home.
sources: Negative outcomes: 'The King decided to institute a one-time tax'

alt_summaries.summary: Current infamous ruler of Kalguur, always named Cadigan; rumoured to use artifice to extend life and spy on subjects; Kalguuran NPCs avoid speaking of him. In PoE2 he orders Vaal artifacts brought to Kalguur.

nodes.name: King Cadigan the Third
nodes.summary: Kalguuran king who, after reading the Vaal Cataclysm as an 'Omen', commissioned the first expedition to Wraeclast with the Triskelion Flame and banned gems after the Azmeri panicked at the sight of one.

chronology.relative: Shortly after the Vaal Cataclysm (first Kalguuran expedition)

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran king who commissioned the expedition and banned gems after Azmeri panic over gem drawings.
Ordered the first Kalguuran expedition to Wraeclast carrying the Triskelion Flame; banned collection of virtue gems after the Azmeri's fearful reaction.

nodes.name: Kira, Servant of Garukhan
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior who leads a dekhara (warband), obsessed with Garukhan, the 'Vulture of the Wastes'. She kidnaps Sekhema Oyun to sacrifice her, hoping to become a 'Red Sekhema' and wearing the Sekhema Feather; the exile kills her and Garukhan but fails to save Oyun.

alt_summaries.summary: Act 4 weapon and armour vendor in Highgate.

nodes.name: Commander Kirac
nodes.summary: Tracker and officer of Oriath's volunteer Citizen Vanguard, later Commander; younger brother of Baran. In legacy epilogue quests he asked the Exile to find Baran, who had fallen in with 'radical' Zana Caeserius. Sits in the Karui Shores War Room, issues maps, pinnacle invitations and Atlas Books of Skill, calls the Exile 'Godslayer' and backs the Maven as 'the best of our terrible options'. Took Sirus's blow meant for Zana. His dialogue says the Maven resurrects Baran for her games.
sources: Karui Shores: Helena directs the player to Commander Kirac in the War Room, who gives a Tier 1 map
quote: 'My younger brother, Baran, fell in with a radical by the name of Zana Caeserius'
KiracOnBaranResurrectionTwo; Introduction: 'tracker and officer in Oriath's new Citizen Vanguard'
Kirac: 'She's the best of our terrible options'

alt_summaries.summary: Oriath officer. In the older Epilogue (v3.9-3.16, 'Picking Up the Pieces', now removed) Officer Kirac sends the exile to the Templar Laboratory to find his brother Baran and learn about Zana; in the current Epilogue Commander Kirac waits in the War Room at Karui Shores and hands the exile the first Map (A Call to Arms).

nodes.name: Kishara
nodes.summary: Vaal explorer from Atziri's time who fell out of favour; Atziri seized her ship and sacrificed its crew. She hid Kishara's Star near the Causeway and her descendants formed the Brinerot clan.

nodes.name: Kole
nodes.summary: Unique demon monster in The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3), with a high-damage Ground Smash and a chain pull. Per the wiki's lore section (attributed to Grigor), Kole was an Oriathan rapist whom Piety used in her experiments. A stronger Carnage variant appeared in the Tower Map (2.4.0-3.1.0).

chronology.relative: Act 3 (c. Piety's experiments; relative date unknown)

sources: Infobox: location = The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3); Lore: 'According to Grigor, Kole was an Oriathan ... before Piety used him in her experiments'

nodes.name: Korell Goya
nodes.summary: Syndicate member from the Redblade warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Kraityn
nodes.summary: Bandit lord of the Broken Bridge, exiled from Theopolis in 1598 IC for avarice, larceny, murder and more (Letters of Exile).

nodes.name: Krutog, Lord of Kin
nodes.summary: Kin Tyrant boss of the Volcanic Warrens on the Isle of Kin, killed in Land of the Kin.

nodes.name: K'Tash, the Hate Shepherd
nodes.summary: Scourge boss (K'tash, the Hate Shepherd) that can spawn in the Nightmare realm depending on the monsters present; the wiki gives stats but no individual lore.

nodes.name: Kurai
nodes.summary: Administrator of the Rogue Harbour; starts the introductory Rogue Harbour quest in Act 6 and hands out the first contract.

nodes.name: Kurgal, the Blackblooded
nodes.summary: Abyssal Lich, commander of the Lightless and servant of Kulemak. Boss in the Lich's Tomb in Delve (depth 90+); born from a stone golem Kulemak created in his bargain with Aul.

alt_summaries.summary: Kurgal is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.
Lich Lord under Kulemak; a Delve boss in PoE1 (The Lich's Tomb, depth 90+) and named as a PoE2 Lich Lord by the Lurking Creature.

nodes.name: Kylian Cyaxan
nodes.summary: Founder of House Cyaxan, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

nodes.name: Lachlann of Endless Lament
nodes.summary: Lachlann the Lost, a Count of the Cemetery of the Eternals seeking to reunite with his family; the Exile puts him to rest after the Memorial Gate opens.

nodes.name: Lani
nodes.summary: Leader of the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower (Act 5) and hub NPC of the Oriath Docks in Act 10; she tells how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon, is fond of Bannon, and rewards the exile after Kitava's fall.

alt_summaries.summary: Karui slave rebel at Overseer's Tower who rewards the Exile; knows of Kitava's Torments; says she 'helped bring this curse down upon Oriath'.

nodes.name: Lavianga
nodes.summary: Karui scholar-advisor to Kaom.

nodes.name: Lazhwar
nodes.summary: Archbishop of the Eternal Faith whose thaumaturgy and Eternal Laboratory work preceded Malachai's.

nodes.name: Leitis
nodes.summary: Ogham prisoner held by the Executioner; freed by the Exile, and sends the Exile after Count Geonor.

nodes.name: Leo, Master of the Arena
nodes.summary: Pit master of the Sarn arena; forsaken master of PvP missions. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Lilly Roth
nodes.summary: Pirate captain and granddaughter of Weylam Roth; her ship brings the exile to Lioneye's Watch (Act 6) and back to Oriath (Act 10). She is the gem vendor, asks the exile to clear the Twilight Strand, to retrieve The Teardrop (map to Tsoatha) and, after Kitava's death, offers to sail the exile away.
sources: Lilly offers to ferry exile to Oriath
Lilly: drowned Oriathans washing ashore after cultists plunder refugee ships
Lilly: Templar privateers took the Teardrop; she and her grandfather plan to sail to Tsoatha

alt_summaries.summary: Ship captain who ferries survivors from Oriath to Wraeclast.

nodes.name: Missionary Lorandis
nodes.summary: Twilight Order preacher in Kingsmarch who sends the Exile to Arastas to take an oath to the Saviour and later leads them to the Herald; cries 'We were trying to... save you' when the ambush turns.
sources: Follow the Preacher; Survive the ambush
Follow the Preacher / Survive the ambush

alt_summaries.summary: Twilight Order preacher in Kingsmarch/Arastas who lures the Exile to take an oath to the Saviour and is dismayed when Torvian ambushes them.

nodes.name: Lorrata
nodes.summary: Giant tree over the Vaal Ruins in the Wetlands, said to be the oldest tree in the area and planted by ancient Azmeri travellers (per Eramir); its roots held the Vaal doors shut until poisoned by the Exile with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem.

nodes.name: Lucan Octavius
nodes.summary: Wealthy Oriathan alchemist, Tane's master; publicly genial but violent and lustful in private; killed by Tane, who was exiled for it.

nodes.name: Lumerius
nodes.summary: Son of the Countess; datamine lists him as an Act 5 boss in Oriath. Role unverified.
sources: paragraph 2: 'She also has a son named Lumerius'

alt_summaries.summary: Son of the Countess whom she 'seeks to use to fulfill her agenda'. His role in the Order is not clarified in any source read.

nodes.name: Lundara
nodes.summary: Twin sister Sekhema; possibly Lunaris.

nodes.name: Lycia, Herald of the Scourge
nodes.summary: Former Templar scholar and keeper of forbidden knowledge who, disillusioned by the truth of Innocence's origins and the Templars' unmarked ossuary bones, made a pact with the Scourge demon Beidat for immortality; imprisoned in the Sanctum she is its fourth-floor boss and league antagonist.

chronology.relative: lived sometime after the Eternal Empire's founding; exact date unknown (video guesses c. 1000-1300 IC)

sources: page summary: former Templar, necromancy and lithomancy, immortality in pact with Beidat

alt_summaries.summary: Former Templar who uncovered the real story of Sin and Innocence.

nodes.name: Maata
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Tawhoa tribe; her text discusses the Vaal.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: Makoru
nodes.summary: Captain of the Aurora May under the Meridian Free Traders; ferries the Exile around Ngamakanui and gives the logbook.
sources: Makoru: Captain of the Aurora May
Talk to Makoru; Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon

alt_summaries.summary: Captain of the Aurora May who ferries the Exile around the Karui islands under the Meridian Free Traders.
Captain of the Aurora May, Karui, daughter of Tavakai; betrayed by Kanu and taken by her father when he flees with the Weapon.

nodes.name: Malachai
nodes.summary: Laureate Thaumaturge to Chitus, creator of the gemling legions and Rapture Device. Spared by Voll, he entered the Beast and caused the Cataclysm. Defeated by the exile in Act 4.
sources: intro paragraph 5 and section 'The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)'; 'Reign of Voll'

alt_summaries.summary: Chitus's Laureate Thaumaturge. He persuaded Voll to spare him, built the Rapture Device, and used it at Highgate to breach the Belly of the Beast, triggering the Cataclysm (c. 1339 IC).

Chitus's master thaumaturge, spared by Emperor Voll after promising 'the end to thaumaturgy'; built the Rapture Device, entered the Beast to take its power, and brought on the Cataclysm; final boss of Act 4 in the Black Core.
Act 4 boss whose lieutenants Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre are revived and harvested in Part Two.
Thaumaturge following in Doryani's footsteps.

nodes.name: Maligaro
nodes.summary: Inquisitor Maligaro, flesh artist of the Godless Three; burned by Voll, his spirit lived on in Maligaro's Sanctum; killed in Act 7.

alt_summaries.summary: Thaumaturge of Malachai's Godless Three; worked in the Chamber of Sins; burned by Voll; returns in Act 4 as the Inquisitor boss.
Thaumaturgist and Malachai disciple who worked flesh in the Chamber of Sins; his spirit is killed in Act 7.

nodes.name: Maramoa
nodes.summary: Karui exile from Ngamakanui (sentenced 1597 IC) who survives in the Sarn Encampment; he appears in Acts 3 and 8. In Act 8 he warns of the Gemling Legion and of the awakened Solaris and Lunaris, and sends the exile to take the Sun and Moon Orbs from their devotees.

alt_summaries.summary: Exile at the Sarn Encampment who gives Lost in Love and Sever the Right Hand; uses Karui terms (makoru, waikoama) so is probably Karui (inferred). The 'leader' role in the earlier draft was not supported.

nodes.name: General Marceus Lioneye
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire general and leader of the Gemling Legion; archer with a virtue gem in one eye; defeated by Hyrri's ambush at Lioneye's Watch during the Purity Rebellion. (General of the Eternal Empire legion in Legion league, 3.7.0.)
sources: Purity Rebellion: Kaom wore his head on his belt

alt_summaries.summary: Gem-eyed archer general at Lioneye's Watch, killed by Kaom.
Eternal Empire general and leader of the Gemling Legion, a one-eyed (virtue gem) archer; sent to drive off Kaom during the Purity Rebellion and killed at Lioneye's Watch, which is named for him.

nodes.name: Marylene
nodes.summary: Victario's lover, died shielding him at the Grain Gate.

nodes.name: Matiki
nodes.summary: Karui held on one of the Act 4 islands (rotating location) whose rescue unlocks the Eye of Hinekora and Trial of the Ancestors.

alt_summaries.summary: Karui figure freed in PoE2 Act 4 who leads the Exile to the Eye of Hinekora and the Trial of the Ancestors.

nodes.name: The Maven
nodes.summary: Primordial claimant of the Atlas who is 'bored with the realm she has given', serving only her own amusement; not the Elder but to be feared. She witnesses map bosses and traps challengers in her Memory Game. Her origin is unresolved.
sources: Envoy: 'She is not The Elder, but you are right to fear her.'

nodes.name: Maxarius
nodes.summary: Per the Sanctum relic texts (as recounted in the wiki and video), Maxarius, the first High Templar, was in truth Innocence himself - a charlatan who stole the Descry symbol from fire-terrified newcomers, used their fear, and vilified his brother Sin to ascend.

chronology.relative: ancient, when the Azmeri still lived in the Azmerian mountains

sources: [28:00]-[30:30] relics reveal Maxarius = Innocence; quote 'a charlatan, a liar and a power seeker'
===Templar history (line ~188): "The very first High Templar, Maxarius, was not Innocence's chosen, as was told, but Innocence himself."
Lore: "He posed himself as Maxarius, the first High Templar, and vilified his own brother as the Original Evil."

nodes.name: Medici Perandus
nodes.summary: Member of the Perandus family styled 'Prefect to the Treasury'. The corpus knows him only from the flavour text of the Perandus Signet; no dated action is recorded, so his era is unknown.
sources: section '===Medici Perandus===': 'Medici Perandus, "Prefect to the Treasury", is a member of the Perandus family only referred to by the flavour text of Perandus Signet.'
section '==Members==' > Perandus family: 'Medici Perandus, Prefect to the Treasury'

nodes.name: Medved
nodes.summary: Leader of the Druids of the Broken Circle who claimed to peer into the past. He pioneered culling a horror species, challenged the horrors' leader alone and vanished. He returns as a horror boss in PoE1 (Medved, Feller of Heroes).

chronology.relative: Expedition era, thousands of years before PoE1

sources: section 'The Kalguur' (Broken Circle, Priesthood, Medved's challenge)

alt_summaries.summary: Druid of the Broken Circle who discovered soul vapour leaving corpses toward gems; became a horror champion, Medved, Feller of Heroes.
Leader of the Druids of the Broken Circle of Kalguur, rumoured to see the future by peering into the past; experiments with virtue gems.
Ancient Kalguuran whose tomb opens the Expedition storyline; not as dead as expected.

nodes.name: Meginord
nodes.summary: Figure referred to only in flavour text and names of unique belts (e.g. Meginord's Girdle, Meginord's Vise). The wiki says he ruled a northern part of Wraeclast, but it is unclear whether he is a person or a naming pun.
sources: Intro: 'a figure only mentioned in the flavour text and names of unique items'; Lore: 'it is unclear whether the character was intended to be called north-north'

nodes.name: Mektul, the Forgemaster
nodes.summary: Boss of The Molten Vault in Act 3, defeated in the Treasures of Utzaal quest; drops The Hammer of Kamasa.
sources: Quest log '===Defeat Mektul, the Forgemaster===' and '===Pick up The Hammer of Kamasa==='

nodes.name: Merveil, the Siren
nodes.summary: Former court beauty of Sarn who married the swordsman Daresso; the cursed Star of Wraeclast he gave her transformed her into a siren-like monster who bore monstrous children; Act 1 final boss (Cavern of Anger / Merveil's Lair).

alt_summaries.summary: Daresso's wife transformed into a siren by the Star of Wraeclast.

nodes.name: Mortimer
nodes.summary: Clearfell Encampment resident who warns the Exile about ancient creatures beneath the surface and asks the Exile to cave in the cracks and whatever they find (PoE2 Act 1, Cracks in the Earth, removed quest).
sources: Walkthrough: Mortimer dialogue, '===Return to Mortimer===' and '===Quest Complete===' section

nodes.name: Mother Gull
nodes.summary: Figure who pitied Great Fire survivors and gave them grain and water that was tainted, causing cannibalism.

nodes.name: Nashta, the Usurper
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior and sister of Adiyah who tried to start a civil war in the Maraketh by stealing Solerai's Spear and attacking caravans; the exile and Adiyah kill her in the final contract.
sources: Lore: sister Nashta, Solerai's Spear, Contract: Heart of Glory

nodes.name: Nasima
nodes.summary: Listed among the Maraketh's notable members (the list gives the name without a Sekhema title); one of the three akhara named on the Brutal Restraint Timeless Jewel. The corpus holds only list-level mentions, so details are limited.
sources: Notable members list: '* [[Nasima]]' under the Maraketh section
Variant table: 'Nasima' with 'Denoted service of # dekhara in the akhara of Nasima'

nodes.name: Navali, Speaker of Hinekora
nodes.summary: Karui seer who guides the Exile through the Halls of the Dead and presents them to the Mother of Death. Also appeared in PoE1 (Prophecy, Ancestor).

alt_summaries.summary: NPC seer of Prophecy league who sells prophecies for silver coins.

nodes.name: Navira
nodes.summary: The water Djinn bound to serve the Sekhema Varashta as penance; an invulnerable minion of the Disciple of Varashta ascendancy that stays inert in its barya until commanded.
sources: section 'Overview': 'The three Djinns are Ruzhan the fire Djinn, Navira the water Djinn, and Kelari the assassin Djinn.'
section 'Overview': 'Each the Djinn are invulnerable minions that remain inert in their Baryas until the Disciple commands them to unleash their powers.'

nodes.name: The Neglected Flame
nodes.summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Neglect; Eagon siphons its kernel.

nodes.name: Nenet
nodes.summary: Faridun rogue (the Scout) hireable for Perception jobs. Unlocked by a Tullina contract. Her questline was never released in-game: it would have had the exile seek the Book of Jamanra to prove the Jamanra existed.
sources: Lead; "To unlock Nenet, run a contract with Tullina"; questline note
'Jamanra' section: 'Nenet, a Faridun, tasked the exile with finding the Book of Jamanra'

nodes.name: Nessa
nodes.summary: Healer and vendor at Lioneye's Watch, taught Brutus's tale in Theopolis schools; gives Mercy Mission, Siren's Cadence.
sources: NPCs; Mercy Mission, Caged Brute dialogue

alt_summaries.summary: Oriathan refugee at Lioneye's Watch transformed by the Brine King into a mermaid bride.

nodes.name: Niko the Mad
nodes.summary: Master-NPC miner who guides the Exile into the Azurite Mine; collects Voltaxic Sulphite to power his Crawler (a repurposed Eternal torture device) and generator.

alt_summaries.summary: Act 4 master who introduces Delve content in Highgate.

nodes.name: Niles
nodes.summary: Former Templar interrogator, hireable rogue in the Rogue Harbour (Counter-thaumaturgy). Unlocked by a Huck contract; his contract unlocks Vinderi.
sources: Lead and Lore: "He is the former interrogator of the Templar"; "To unlock Niles, run a contract with Huck")

nodes.name: Oak
nodes.summary: Bandit lord of the Wetlands; preaches peace ('To spare the lives of many, you need take only one'), fights Alira's thralls; wears Oak's Amulet, one of three pieces of the Apex.

nodes.name: Olroth
nodes.summary: Leader of the Knights of the Sun, called the Gallant and later the Grim. Recorded the Empty-Eyed Fiend's killing of a young woman, fought the Fiend with a gem, was stabbed by priests, and returned as the undying horror the exile fights as the Expedition league boss.

chronology.relative: Expedition era, thousands of years before PoE1

sources: section 'The Kalguur' (Broken Circle, Priesthood, Medved's challenge)
Olroth, Origin of the Fall: excavate a Kalguuran Tomb in an Expedition Logbook at area level 79+

alt_summaries.summary: Knights of the Sun leader, 'the Gallant' then 'the Grim'; staked the Triskelion Flame, defeated the Empty-Eyed Fiend with a gem, was stabbed by priests; now boss Olroth, Origin of the Fall.

Leader of the Knights of the Sun (Origin of the Fall / the Gallant / the Grim); stole the Triskelion Flame, doomed the expedition and villages, and was found by Dannig and the Exile sustained by it. Motive unknown.

Expedition faction leader sought in the last stage of The Grand Expedition; a Kalguuran Tomb excavation at area level 79+ opens the pinnacle 'Olroth, Origin of the Fall' (guide). Guide claims he leads the Knights of the Sun and guards the Triskelion Flame (low).

nodes.name: Lord Mayor Ondar
nodes.summary: Mayor of Sarn who, with gems implanted for the occasion, betrayed and killed Emperor Chitus during the Night of a Thousand Ribbons celebration, during the Purity Rebellion (1334 IC).
sources: section 'Assassination of Chitus' and 'Night of a Thousand Ribbons'

alt_summaries.summary: Sarn's Lord Mayor, betrayed and killed Chitus with a Black Elixir weapon, then was cut down by Chitus.

nodes.name: Orbala
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior, known as the Sekhema of Sekhemas, who fought the 'bandit king of Stridevolf'; PoE2 shows she was the mortal identity of Garukhan before her ascension. That she was also the traveller who freed Sin from Innocence's worshippers is only suggested by relic lore (inferred).
sources: Lore: former human Sekhema Orbala (revealed in PoE2)

alt_summaries.summary: Maraketh warrior who fought the 'bandit king of Stridevolf'; PoE2 states she was the mortal identity of Garukhan before ascension, known as the Sekhema of Sekhemas. PoE1 3.22 relics (a traveller freeing Sin from Innocence's worshippers) are suggested, not confirmed, to be her.

nodes.name: Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove
nodes.summary: Boss form of Oshabi. It is triggered in a Map Device by a Sacred Blossom map fragment; the Heart of the Grove, grown from a harvested Tier 4 seed, is the separate challenge that leads to the Avatar of the Grove.
sources: lead; Dialogue: Introduction, The Grove, Lifeforce, Exile from the Azmeri
League mechanic: Heart of the Grove

alt_summaries.summary: Azmeri outcast, exiled by her tribe after she offered a child to the earth when she alone still heard the land's whispers. Tends the Sacred Grove, names the energy Lifeforce and asks the exile to harvest seeds. After the tutorial quest she turns into the Heart of the Grove; she returns as Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove, a boss.

nodes.name: Oswald
nodes.summary: Treasure-hunter Quartermaster of the Ziggurat Encampment who buys salvage and shipping for Kingsmarch.

alt_summaries.summary: Quartermaster of the treasure hunters at the Ziggurat Encampment.

nodes.name: Overseer Krow
nodes.summary: Slave Pens overseer boss blocking access to Overseer's Tower.

nodes.name: Oyun
nodes.summary: Maraketh akhara leader at Highgate; recounts Deshret's sealing of the Beast.

alt_summaries.summary: Maraketh Sekhema (ruler) of Highgate kidnapped by Kira to be sacrificed to Garukhan; the exile fails to save her.

nodes.name: Petarus and Vanja
nodes.summary: Relic-hunter duo of Highgate who seek Garukhan's Storm Blade and bottle its storm.

alt_summaries.summary: Act 4 jewellery, flask and gem vendors in Highgate.

nodes.name: Phanos, Last Disciple of Auria
nodes.summary: Named in Act 5 datamine as a boss/text-audio entry. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle
nodes.summary: Guardian boss of the Matriarch Halls in the Precursor Fortress; yields the Origin Cradle.
sources: step 120 'Defeat Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle'

nodes.name: Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark
nodes.summary: Guardian boss of the Patriarch Halls in the Precursor Fortress; yields the Origin Spark.
sources: step 114 'Defeat Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark'

nodes.name: Piety of Theopolis
nodes.summary: Former Vinia of Oriath, pardoned by Dominus; thaumaturge making miscreations in Sarn; saved by Malachai; becomes an Abomination in Act 4; eventually killed by Malachai.
sources: Lore: Background and In Path of Exile
Lore: Background and In Path of Exile

nodes.name: Putembo
nodes.summary: Tyrant of the primeval civilisation who forced subjects to quarry stone for his fortress; overthrown by Aul.

nodes.name: Qianga
nodes.summary: Named on a Gilded Shaper Scarab as the 'Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers'; probably an Order of the Djinn member (wiki says unclear).

nodes.name: Queen in the Mists
nodes.summary: New Ritual boss in 0.5, unlocked by an Atlas Tree node.

nodes.name: Queen of Filth
nodes.summary: Boss in the Apex of Filth in Aggorat, Utzaal (present); the Exile defeats her to obtain the Temple Door Idol that opens the Temple of Kopec.

alt_summaries.summary: Boss of Aggorat (Apex of Filth) who drops the Temple Door Idol needed for the Temple of Kopec.

nodes.name: Quilon Bardiya
nodes.summary: Founder of House Bardiya, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

nodes.name: Rakiata
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Tasalio tribe; after her father the chieftain was felled by invaders she took up arms, entrusted a fragment of a fabled spear to the sea, and fights in a dance-like style emulating Tasalio's tide; Ikiaho vouched for her in the Halls.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon
nodes.summary: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon is a boss the Exile defeats in the Glacial Tarn on the way up Mount Kriar during the Recruit the Vaal interlude.
sources: Quest log, 'Defeat Rakkar, the Frozen Talon.'

nodes.name: Ratha Azadi
nodes.summary: Founder of House Azadi, one of the four Great Founders who rebelled against Emperor Tyndarus Phrecius.

nodes.name: Rathbreaker
nodes.summary: Sun Clan leader of the hyenic raiders harassing the trade route that blocks the Ardura caravan; the Exile's first Act 2 boss.

nodes.name: Raulf, the Recruiter
nodes.summary: Meridian Free Traders agent who recruits labourers and specialists for Kingsmarch; refuses to be anyone's spy.

nodes.name: Raulo (Fidelitas)
nodes.summary: Maligaro's slave and lover, injected with Calibric Extantia and renamed Fidelitas.

nodes.name: Renly
nodes.summary: Clearfell blacksmith who rewards the Exile for slaying the Bloated Miller and forges the Rune Spikes from the Red Vale runes.

alt_summaries.summary: Ezomyte leader in Ogham (Warrior's father figure); asks the Exile to stop Holten's abductions before the Ezomytes join the war.

nodes.name: Ridan, Afarud Commander
nodes.summary: Afarud boss in mirages; drops The Black Barya.

nodes.name: Rigwald, the Wolven King
nodes.summary: Ezomyte thane of Ezomyr who received Victario's letters seeking aid for the Purity Rebellion; possessed by the Greatwolf during the Rebellion. Boss of the Talisman league; his memoirs are the Inscription lore found at Stone Altars. NOT a member of the Immortal Syndicate (the Betrayal video only notes Thane Jorgin shares the title 'thane' with him).
sources: Rigwald, the Wolven King: boss of the Talisman league
The Greatwolf: Rigwald possessed during the Purity Rebellion
Victario wrote letters to Thane Rigwald of Ezomyr

alt_summaries.summary: Ezomyte thane who killed King Skothe and led the Bloody Flowers Rebellion.

nodes.name: Riker Maloney
nodes.summary: Syndicate member without established background. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Rin Yuushu
nodes.summary: Syndicate member from the Mutewind warband. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Risu
nodes.summary: Faridun defector freed at Mawdun Quarry who reveals Jamanra's plans, the Halani Gates closure, and Traitor's Passage.
sources: Quest log 'Question the Faridun Defector' / 'Talk to Risu'

nodes.name: Rog, the Disenchanter
nodes.summary: Kalguuran dealer who runs the Kingsmarch disenchanting apothecary and dreams of his own shop; manages the group's tabletop game; former rebel.
sources: Rog searches for his missing wife, Gwennen

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran dealer and Expedition NPC who sells identified rare equipment and takes Order artifacts; he manages the tabletop-style game the Kalguuran NPCs play.
Kalguuran trader, Alva's contact in Kingsmarch, who sells the Boat Charter; returning from PoE1's Settlers of Kalguur.
Kalguuran trader at Kingsmarch who arranged the charter in Act 4; searches for his wife Gwennen in 0.5.

nodes.name: Romira Phrecian
nodes.summary: Emperor who fed his wife's sons (fathered by his brother) back to her; deposed in the Night of a Thousand Ribbons.

nodes.name: Royal Blood Priest
nodes.summary: Unique monster (variant of Zolin, Blood Priest) found in a Sacrificial Chamber room of Atziri's Temple. The page gives no lore text. Introduced in 0.4.0.
sources: infobox (location 'Atziri's Temple'); lead 'found in Atziri's Temple in a Sacrificial Chamber room... a variant of Zolin, Blood Priest'

nodes.name: Royal Colossus
nodes.summary: Unique monster (full name 'X, Royal Colossus') that can be randomly summoned by an Ancient Beacon. Known abilities: Slam Combo and Charged Slam (lightning). Introduced in 0.4.0. The page gives no lore text.
sources: infobox (location 'Spawned by an Ancient Beacon'); Abilities list; Version history 0.4.0

nodes.name: Royal Commander
nodes.summary: Unique monster (variant of Blackjaw, the Remnant) found in a Commander room of Atziri's Temple. The page lists no abilities and gives no lore text. Introduced in 0.4.0.
sources: infobox (location 'Atziri's Temple'); lead 'found in Atziri's Temple in a Commander room... a variant of Blackjaw, the Remnant'

nodes.name: Royal Sentinel
nodes.summary: Unique monster (variant of Stone Sentinel) that can be randomly summoned by an Ancient Beacon. Known abilities: Fist Slam, Charged Fist Slam and Charged Foot Slam, the last two converting physical damage to lightning. Introduced in 0.4.0. The page gives no lore text.
sources: infobox (location 'Spawned by an Ancient Beacon'); lead 'It is a variant of Stone Sentinel'; Abilities list

nodes.name: Royal Spy Master
nodes.summary: Unique monster found in a Spymaster room of Atziri's Temple. The page lists no abilities and gives no lore text. Introduced in 0.4.0.
sources: infobox (location 'Atziri's Temple'); lead 'found in Atziri's Temple in a Spymaster room'

nodes.name: Rudja, the Dread Engineer
nodes.summary: Faridun engineer guarding Mawdun Mine's abandoned foundry.

nodes.name: Ruzhan
nodes.summary: The fire Djinn bound to serve the Sekhema Varashta as penance; an invulnerable minion of the Disciple of Varashta ascendancy that stays inert in its barya until commanded.
sources: section 'Overview': 'The three Djinns are Ruzhan the fire Djinn, Navira the water Djinn, and Kelari the assassin Djinn.'
section 'Overview': 'Each the Djinn are invulnerable minions that remain inert in their Baryas until the Disciple commands them to unleash their powers.'

nodes.name: Cardinal Sanctus Vox
nodes.summary: Oriathan noble, ancestor of the Vox family; general of the Templar legion.

nodes.name: Saresh
aliases: Saresh, Necromancer of the Weeping Black
nodes.summary: Faridun reject and necromancer of Weeping Black, former Order of the Djinn member; defeated by Garukhan (Orbala) with the Horn of the Vastiri.
sources: Vanja: 'ancient battle against the necromancer Saresh'

alt_summaries.summary: Historical Faridun necromancer and Order of the Djinn member slain by Garukhan; endgame boss in The Black Barya.
Historical Faridun reject and Order of the Djinn member who explored intrinsic darkness and raised undead until killed by Garukhan; his name is on Metamorph Scarabs.

Necromancer (with an undead horde) whom Garukhan fought in the eastern desert, when she lost the Storm Blade - according to the relic hunters Petarus and Vanja's research; nothing else is said about him, and his date is unknown.

nodes.name: Sasan, the Bandit Lord
nodes.summary: Bandit Lord who takes Atlas Runners hostage while they map; defeat him or pay 50,000 Gold; drops The Living Blade and The Bandit Lord's Band.

nodes.name: Scourge of the Skies
nodes.summary: Unique boss of Shrike Island in Act 4, killed to complete the Shrike Island quest.
sources: Infobox completion and quest log '===Kill the Scourge of the Skies==='

nodes.name: Servi
nodes.summary: Tribal guide who warns the Exile of a forsaken ruin in the dark where Soul Cores may be found; the Azmeri-descent and Azak/Orok politics claims are not supported by the corpus and were removed.

alt_summaries.summary: Local guide whose tribe knows of the Vaal ruin in the Chimeral Wetlands.

nodes.name: Servitor Marius
nodes.summary: Twilight Order servitor on Arastas who offers the Exile membership in the Utopia or a donation; refusal completes the Utopia quest.

alt_summaries.summary: Twilight Order member on Arastas who invites the player to join their Utopia or donate; refused.

nodes.name: Shambrin
nodes.summary: Maraketh dekhara who asks the Exile to search Deshar for the corpse of a woman she cared about, Lailuma.
sources: Quest log 'Use the Desert Map to travel to Traitor's Passage'

nodes.name: The Shaper
nodes.summary: Valdo Caeserius reduced by the Elder's memory-feeding to a shell who 'shapes' worlds in the Atlas and no longer recognises Zana. Guarded by four Guardians of the Void; pinnacle boss in the Shaper's Realm.
sources: Memory of Awakening: 'I will forge a world anew'
Zana: 'the Shaper was in reality Zana's father, Valdo'

nodes.name: Shavronne of Umbra
nodes.summary: One of Malachai's 'Godless Three'; her returned spirit is killed in Shavronne's Tower so Sin can harvest her soul.

alt_summaries.summary: Vain thaumaturge of the Godless Three who experimented on Brutus at Axiom Prison.
Thaumaturge of the Godless Three who created Brutus; Act 4 boss guarding Malachai's heart.

nodes.name: Silk
nodes.summary: Storyteller/artist of the Forest Encampment (Sin notes many Azmeri-descended artists worship Arakaali) who falls for Arakaali in Act 7, calls her his bride and is lost when the exile kills her. Earlier he asks the exile for Black Venom from Maligaro's pet spider (Web of Secrets).
sources: Silk asks for venom from Black Death, Maligaro's pet spider

alt_summaries.summary: Forest Encampment hero-storyteller who lost his spear in the Weaver's eye; shares word of the stone seal near Prisoner's Gate.

nodes.name: Siora, Blade of the Mists
nodes.summary: Siora, Blade of the Mists is a boss the Exile defeats at the altar during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.
sources: Quest log, 'Defeat Siora, Blade of the Mists.' (Siora: 'Darkness descends... and with it, your end!')

nodes.name: Siosa
nodes.summary: Ghost in the Library, friend of Icius Perandus, gem vendor after A Fixture of Fate.

nodes.name: Sirus, Awakener of Worlds
nodes.summary: Smuggler and leader of the Elderslayers who loved Zana; sacrificed himself into the Arcana trap and returned empty and mad. He burned Oriath and is a pinnacle boss; journals narrate his fall.

nodes.name: Sister Cassia
nodes.summary: Former Templar-circle mechanical artisan and Blight NPC who runs the Purification Pump encounters and the Anoint bench; exiled by High Templar Dominus for subverting his virtue-gem projects, and replaced by Piety. Believes Blighted maps lead to the Blight's source.
sources: lead; Dialogue: Exile, Replacement, Devices, Fungi, Blighted Maps

nodes.name: Solerai
nodes.summary: Legendary Maraketh Sekhema who with Lundara ended the Winter of the World; possibly Solaris.

nodes.name: Sonja, the Farmer
nodes.summary: Kingsmarch farmer puzzled by the thriving plants on supposedly barren soil.

nodes.name: Stormgore
nodes.summary: Stormgore is a boss the Exile defeats in the Etched Ravine on Mount Kriar during the Recruit the Vaal interlude.

nodes.name: Sumei
nodes.summary: Historical Maraketh Order of the Djinn 'Master Lorekeeper' who investigated artefact duplication caused by Kalandra's influence.

nodes.name: Tacati, Architect of Toxins
nodes.summary: Unique Architect found in the Poison Garden, Cultivar Chamber and Toxic Grove rooms of the Temple of Atzoatl; his name gives the legacy Tacati item mods.

nodes.name: Tane Octavius
nodes.summary: Freed slave and alchemist exiled for killing his abusive master Lucan Octavius; works from an underground laboratory (Karui Shores) to isolate 'intrinsic darkness' from the flesh of monsters via Metamorphs, hoping to purify a cruel soul.
sources: lead; Dialogue: Tane's Master, Exile, Vision, Goals

nodes.name: Tangmazu, the Raven Trickster
nodes.summary: Trickster god, brother of Ralakesh, who tricked Solaris into believing Lunaris had betrayed her (PoE1 lore: Strange Voice in Delirium). In PoE2 0.5 he is the Raven Trickster whose defeat completes Strange Reflection and the Delirium storyline.
sources: Tangmazu: trickster god, Ralakesh's brother, Delirium NPC, also Tekaru / the Black Crow

nodes.name: Tarcus Veruso
nodes.summary: Azmeri leader and first Emperor (Prima Imperialus) who led 80,000 Azmeri to found Sarn in 1 IC. A ruthless despot, he outlawed thaumaturgy, buried the gems under Highgate, and created the legion system.

nodes.name: Tarkleigh
nodes.summary: Veteran exile and smuggler at Lioneye's Watch; weapon and armour vendor who gives out quests and skill gems; mentions Dominus took the exiles' history.
sources: Enemy at the Gate quest dialogue
Enemy at the Gate quest dialogue

alt_summaries.summary: Lioneye's Watch veteran who vendors and gives quests in Act 6, and mourns Nessa.

nodes.name: Tasgul, Swallower of Light
nodes.summary: Abyssal boss said by guides to drop Kulemak's Invitation (shared with Vandroth); the unlock path to the Vessel of Kulemak.
sources: Abyssal Commanders Tasgul and Vandroth drop Kulemak Invitation

nodes.name: Tasuni
nodes.summary: Maraketh seer at Highgate who hears Deshret's spirit.

alt_summaries.summary: Maraketh man of Highgate, brother of Kira, who contends with Irasha for rule of Highgate; he asks the exile to put his sister down, recover the Sekhema Feather and, if possible, return Oyun.

nodes.name: Tavakai, the Chieftain
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Karui Tukohama Tribe and Act 4 boss. After the weapon is reforged he steals it and flees to Ngakanu with his daughter Makoru, falls to Blood Fever, claims to be the true 'Ngakuramakoi', is rejected by Tukohama, is defeated, then cured by Sin and pledges the Karui to the war against Oriana.
sources: Defeat Tavakai; Witness the Hooded One

nodes.name: Tawhanuku
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Hinekora tribe in the Karui Ancestor roster.

chronology.relative: deceased Karui chieftain, resides in the Halls of the Dead

nodes.name: Tecrod
nodes.summary: 'The Hated Slave': Abyssal Lich Lord who, unlike Amanamu, Kurgal and Ulaman, acts independently of Kulemak (PoE1 wiki: forsaken by Kulemak for unclear reasons). In PoE2 (Legacy of the Precursors) he steals the Flame Seed on his wyrm, seeks Kulemak's favour, hunts for the Edicts and is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity.
sources: Lore: independent of Kulemak; steals Flame Seed; destroyed by Arbiter of Divinity
Lich Lords: Tecrod, the disgraced Abyssal Lich, forsaken by Kulemak; freed from a Precursor sarcophagus, seeks to win back Kulemak favour

alt_summaries.summary: White-haloed Abyssal Lich Lord ('the Hated Slave'). The PoE2 wiki says that, unlike Amanamu, Kurgal and Ulaman, he acts independently of Kulemak's other lords and is active in the Epilogue hunting the Edicts; the PoE wiki adds he was forsaken by Kulemak, is freed from a Precursor sarcophagus and seeks to win back Kulemak's favour. He steals the Flame Seed, incapacitates the Exile at the Origin Tower claiming the First Edict's power for 'the Master' (probably Kulemak, inferred), and is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity.

Abyssal Lich Lord ('the Hated Slave') with a white halo; unlike Amanamu, Kurgal and Ulaman he acts independently of Kulemak and hunts the Edicts. Appears as a wyrm rider who steals the Flame Seed after the Arbiter of Ash falls; when the Exile places the Origin Core in the Origin Tower his wyrm incapacitates the Exile and he claims the power for 'the Master', but the Arbiter of Divinity destroys his body.

nodes.name: Queen Tetzlapokal
nodes.summary: Pre-Atziri Vaal queen, devotee of Arakaali with a fascination with death and corpses; the Vaal City rose to prominence in her reign.

nodes.name: Thane Jorgin
nodes.summary: Syndicate member (Betrayal, 3.5.0) who left as a mere after being accused of killing his brother; believes Rin or another Brotherhood of Silence member responsible (per video). Video notes he shares the title 'thane' with Rigwald; Jun mocks his 'first ones' (Ezomyte) background.

nodes.name: Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth
nodes.summary: Ezomyte rulers of Holten driven mad into bloodletting and torture; killed by the Exile. Cause attributed to a 'Nameless' darkness far older than Corruption (Hooded One).
sources: Renly; Hooded One; Defeat the Thane and Lady

nodes.name: The Arbiter of Ash
nodes.summary: Guardian of the Flame Seed, created by the Precursors (PoE wiki, History of Wraeclast; the PoE2 wiki says the Unblinking Eye most likely subjugated it originally, which is speculative). Sealed at the Burning Monolith; fought by the Exile as PoE2's first Atlas pinnacle (0.1-0.4) and as a Fortress quest boss in 0.5, after which a wyrm-rider (Tecrod) steals the Flame Seed. Little else is known.
sources: most likely the original subjugation of the Arbiter of Ash
Precursors: 'They also created the Arbiter of Ash (PoE 2) to guard the Flame Seed (PoE 2)'; 'Little is known about the Arbiter and the Flame Seed'
Precursors section: 'created the Arbiter of Ash (PoE 2) to guard the Flame Seed (PoE 2)'; 'Little is known about the Arbiter and the Flame Seed'
step 101 Defeat the Arbiter of Ash

alt_summaries.summary: Guardian created by the Precursors to guard the Flame Seed; PoE2 endgame boss.

Precursor-created guardian of the Flame Seed and pinnacle boss of the Burning Monolith. After he falls a wyrm-riding figure (Tecrod) takes the Flame Seed; the Fourth Edict is investigated next. Little is known about him.

nodes.name: The Arbiter of Divinity
nodes.summary: Boss atop the Origin Tower, fought after the Origin Core is placed; it destroys Tecrod's body ('Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!') and ends the threat of the First Edict. The wiki does not say what it is (the 'apex of the Origins of Divinity storyline' framing comes from guides); 0.5.4 patches later adjusted the fight.
sources: 'Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!'
boss guide: final boss of the Origins of Divinity storyline
steps 139-141 Ascend the Tower / Place the Origin Core / Defeat the Arbiter of Divinity
0.5 pinnacle boss guide (new pinnacle boss, Return of the Ancients)

alt_summaries.summary: Pinnacle boss of the Origin Tower in the Epilogue (0.5.0); destroys Tecrod's body with 'Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!'. Nature/identity not established in sources read; fighting it ends the threat of the First Edict.

nodes.name: The Black Knight
nodes.summary: Boss guarding Verisium Outcrops in the Starfall Crater (reached via map ore deposits); drops Svalinn.

nodes.name: The Bloated Miller
nodes.summary: Diseased former human who terrorises the logging camp; the Exile's first boss.

nodes.name: The Boss of the Ring
nodes.summary: The unnamed 'Boss' who leads the Ring, per Kurai's dialogue ('the Boss has no tolerance for guests who do not obey his rules'). Identity is not established in the wiki; any name is fan theory.
sources: 'The Ring' dialogue: 'The Boss would like to offer you the opportunity'

nodes.name: The Countess (Oriana)
nodes.summary: Leader of the Twilight Order and antagonist of PoE2, who took the Seed of Corruption to create a new Beast. Escapes the Exile repeatedly during Acts 1-2; her son Lumerius is named in the wiki.
sources: Confront Kanu and the First Herald

alt_summaries.summary: Datamine lists 'Orianna, The Countess' among Act 5 bosses; consistent with the wiki's account that Kanu revealed the Beast is kept in Oriath. Unreleased.

Major PoE2 antagonist and leader of the Twilight Order. Manipulates Count Geonor and Jamanra to obtain and feed the Beast, abandoning them when useless; has a son, Lumerius, whom she intends to use in her agenda.

nodes.name: The Dreamer
nodes.summary: Keepers-league NPC (full name: Chayula, the Benevolent Dreamer / the One Who Dreamt) found hidden in the Monastery of the Keepers. After the failed fusion of the five Breachlords he was torn asunder and cast into the void; he gave Ailith visions and the Genesis Tree as weapon against the Hiveborn, calls the Exile an ally 'for now', and destroys Ailith's body when she learns the truth (she is a preserved Hiveborn copy).
sources: Dialogue ("Who are you?", "Who is our enemy?", Enter Back Room) and Lore
Visions V: the Four have become One; Genesis Tree is his gift
Lore: Chayula spoke to humans through dreams, founding the Keepers

nodes.name: The Executioner
nodes.summary: Ogham executioner who tried to hang the Exile in the opening; killed by the Exile at Ogham Village, freeing Leitis.

nodes.name: The High Priest
nodes.summary: Act 5 boss in datamine; identity unknown. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: The Hooded One
nodes.summary: Unnamed Hooded One bound by a runed sword in the Grelwood's Tree of Souls, later revealed as Sin (Thief of Virtue) who created the Beast; guides the Exile through Acts 1-3.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest'
Quote 'I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.'
Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine: 'I am... a god. I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.'

alt_summaries.summary: Dark hooded god-like figure, likely Sin (PoE2 wiki inference), impaled by Count Geonor who takes the Seed of Corruption from him in PoE2's opening cinematic; in the endgame quest Legacy of the Precursors he sleeps in thrall to the Beast's corruption and is the intended wielder of the Precursor Weapon. A YouTube lore creator says Act 4 hints he was once a Precursor (community theory, unconfirmed).

The god Sin in disguise (identity confessed in Act 2: 'I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin'). In Act 4 he reforges the Weapon, recognises Precursor writing from a faded mortal childhood, cures Tavakai and organises the alliance; in the endgame he sleeps under the Beast's Corruption.

Mysterious guide of the PoE2 Exile, revealed in Act 2 to be the god Sin, the Thief of Virtue and creator of the Beast. Recognises Precursor writing from a mortal childhood memory, forges the Weapon, and in the Epilogue lies in corruption-induced sleep.
Guide figure in PoE2 who directs the Exile to the Vaal and the weapon.

nodes.name: The King in the Mists
nodes.summary: Chief of the Nameless shadow creatures in the Viridian Wildwood and enemy of the Maji. Boss of Affliction (PoE1, 3.23) and, in PoE2 Act 1 (Freythorn), the cult 'king' guarding the final Ritual altar. In Legacy of the Maji, Aoife recalls being drawn to him, believing him one of the Maji of old.
sources: unique items 'the King in the Mists'
'The King in the Mists encounter added to Ritual'
Unique items: drops from the King in the Mists
Aoife dialogue about the King in the Mists
Aoife: 'You killed him in your domain... but now he returns from his'; step 17 Defeat the King in the Mists; step 20 Pick up the Head of the King
Killing the King drops The Head of the King, which starts the Rite of the Nameless in Caer Tarth

alt_summaries.summary: Major antagonist of Affliction league, a shadowy Nameless force within the Viridian Wildwood against whom the Maji wage a long war; later added to Ritual in 3.25.

Boss who killed Aoife and whose effigies tether him to the world; killed once in the campaign (Ogham) yet returns in the endgame Ritual quest, where he is fought at the Crux of Nothingness; his Head starts the Rite of the Nameless. Drawing power from the Bodach is a guide claim.

nodes.name: The Last to Die
nodes.summary: Last of the Vaal High Priest bloodline bound by Chaos's pact to the Blood Crucible; appears from the Coast in Scourge, asking the exile to continue in her place; Kalandra says she 'wanders still, forever fleeing, forever burdened by guilt'.

nodes.name: Lurking Creature
nodes.summary: Abyssal being at the Well of Souls who calls the Exile 'Thief of Virtue! Stealer of Kulemak's spark!', serves whoever holds Kulemak's dominion (Amanamu, Ulaman, Kurgal) but never Tecrod.

nodes.name: The Perennial King
nodes.summary: Boss of the removed Epilogue quest Ezomyte Infiltration.

nodes.name: The Preacher
nodes.summary: Act 5 boss in datamine; possibly linked to the Order's preachers like Lorandis (speculation). Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: The Prisoner
nodes.summary: Being held 'beyond death' in Solitary Confinement by the Eternal Empire; boss and weapon-piece holder. Identity unknown.

nodes.name: The Rust King
nodes.summary: Guardian of the final Rune of Power in the Red Vale.

nodes.name: The Saviour
nodes.summary: Figure the Twilight Order's followers swear oaths to and invoke ('For the Saviourrr!', 'Embrace the saviour! Pledge now'); listed first among Order members. Identity/nature not revealed in sources read.

nodes.name: The Shade
nodes.summary: Name Valdo gave the Elder's free-roaming spirit in his dreams; it taught him thaumaturgy and said the Map Device would link the dreamlands to Wraeclast, then asked him to pull the sword (Starforge) from its body.

nodes.name: The Trialmaster
nodes.summary: Servant of Chaos who runs the Trials of Chaos. Introduced in PoE1's Ultimatum league and encountered in PoE2 Act 3 and the endgame Trialmaster arena.

chronology.relative: Captured in the Vaal era; active in PoE1 3.14+ and PoE2 Act 3

sources: Lead: "the Trialmaster offers the Trials of Chaos"
Lead: "He will offer the Trials of Chaos ... as directed by his master, Chaos"
Lead: Chaos is the Trialmaster's master
Ixchel entry: captured infiltrating the Temple of Chaos, became the Trialmaster

alt_summaries.summary: Minimal node (owned by PoE2 domain): per the Order of the Djinn page, the Trialmaster is the former Order member Ixchel, 'Godstealer'.
The servant of Chaos who oversees the Trials of Chaos and tests challengers for Chaos's amusement. At least several thousand years old.
Servant of Chaos who runs the Trial: 'My master, Chaos, has charged me with this task.'

nodes.name: The Weaver
nodes.summary: Giant spider ('mother of all eight-legs') in the Weaver's Chambers, in whose eye Silk's spear (Maligaro's Spike) is lodged; killed by the Exile.

nodes.name: Tibbs
nodes.summary: Brute-force and demolition rogue hireable in the Rogue Harbour. Running a contract with him unlocks Tullina.
sources: Lead; "To unlock Tullina, run a contract with Tibbs" (Tullina page)
Lead: "To unlock Tullina, run a contract with Tibbs, the Giant"

nodes.name: Tolman
nodes.summary: Clarissa's lover, captured with her in the Slums and tortured to death by Piety of Theopolis in the Crematorium (Act 3); in Act 8 his zombie returns, and the failed resurrection at the Quay forces the exile to kill him.
sources: Walkthrough: Tolman attacks after the ritual fails

alt_summaries.summary: Clarissa's boyfriend, tortured to death by Piety in the Crematorium; reappears as a zombie in Act 8.

nodes.name: Tor Gul, the Defiler
nodes.summary: Faridun boss of the Spires of Deshar, defeated before the Dreadnought assault.
sources: Progression table, The Spires of Deshar

nodes.name: Tora, Master of the Hunt
nodes.summary: Forsaken master (ranged weapons); studied corruption in beasts. Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Torvian, Hand of the Saviour
nodes.summary: Twilight Order champion and boss of Arastas in Act 4, defeated while the Exile searches for a way to reforge the Weapon.
sources: Arastas boss: Torvian, Hand of the Saviour
Defeat Torvian, Hand of the Saviour

nodes.name: Tujen, the Haggler / Harbourmaster
nodes.summary: Kalguuran haggler turned Kingsmarch harbourmaster who crews ships; former rebel who lost friends (Tolis, Oskar, Naja, Thea, Sven) and vows revenge; in PoE2 asks the Exile to clear the fog at Kedge Bay.
sources: Tujen: 'Kingsmarch trade has seen better days'

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran haggler and Expedition NPC who sells non-equipment items and takes Black Scythe artifacts; Harbourmaster of Kingsmarch.
Kalguuran haggler/harbourmaster of Kingsmarch; gives Dark Mists and recalls the town's founding.

nodes.name: Tullina
nodes.summary: Agility rogue (the Catburglar). Her heist target is Merveil's Wedding Dress, which the History page ties to the Oriath wedding of Daresso and Merveil. Unlocked by a Tibbs contract; her contract unlocks Nenet.
sources: Lead: "To unlock Tullina, run a contract with Tibbs, the Giant"
'Daresso and Merveil' section: Merveil's wedding dress as a Heist target

nodes.name: Tyndarus Phrecius
nodes.summary: Emperor c. 870-892 IC, backed by High Templar Andronicus; lost the Trarthan war of independence.

alt_summaries.summary: Eternal Empire emperor who in 870 IC sent Phrecian legions to Trarthus to suppress the warlords' rebellion and capitulated after two years.

nodes.name: Uhtred
nodes.summary: High Priest of the Order of the Chalice who declared the Vaal gems unclean, admitted responsibility for the attack on Olroth, and fled to an ancient shrine. Returns as the PoE1 boss Uhtred, Covetous Traitor.

chronology.relative: Expedition era, thousands of years before PoE1

sources: section 'The Kalguur' (Broken Circle, Priesthood, Medved's challenge)

alt_summaries.summary: Kalguuran expedition member who declared virtue gems unclean and succumbed to corruption-driven madness before discovering a dark mirror.
High Priest of the Order of the Chalice who disliked gems, plotted against Olroth and fled to the Precursor Shrine; now Uhtred, Covetous Traitor.
Expedition faction leader, 'Uhtred, the Stardrinker', fought in a tomb in The Grand Expedition; link to the Verisium meteor is suggested only by the 'Stardrinker' title and guides (low).

nodes.name: Ulaman, Sovereign of the Well
nodes.summary: Abyssal Lich, commander of the Lightless and servant of Kulemak. Boss of the Abyssal Depths (Abyss league 3.1.0).

alt_summaries.summary: Ulaman is an Abyssal Lich and one of Kulemak's three most powerful servants commanding the Lightless.
Lich Lord under Kulemak; Abyssal Depths boss.

nodes.name: Una
nodes.summary: Ezomyte Clearfell leader who helps the Exile free the Hooded One and sends them to recover Count Lachlann's ring.
sources: Quest 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'

alt_summaries.summary: Ezomyte ally who guides the Exile through the Blackwood using freed fey spirits.

nodes.name: Undertaker Arimor
nodes.summary: Undertaker who gathers the haunted dead of Wraeclast, gives the Exile the Lantern of Arimor and runs the Necropolis; invokes a god named Thruldana during his chants.
sources: ===Thruldana=== "A god whose name is invoked by Undertaker Arimor during one of his chants."

nodes.name: Uromoti, Architect of Expansion
nodes.summary: Vaal Architect of Atziri who, per a carving in the Howling Caves, secretly built a vault in a remote mountain, hiding the 'treason' from the Queen and sending his children into it; his name is on a Temple Console medallion. Thought the Queen mad.

nodes.name: Ursea, The Matron
nodes.summary: Named in Act 5 datamine as a boss/text-audio entry. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: Utula
nodes.summary: Karui slave-rebellion leader and high priest of Kitava in Oriath; has Casticus's eyes taken to enter the Templar Courts, then uses Innocence's fall to complete the King's Feast and summon Kitava; killed by the Exile.

alt_summaries.summary: Chieftain of the Kitava tribe; his text covers High Templar Avarius.

nodes.name: Uzaza, the First King
nodes.summary: Founder of the primeval civilisation who led his people on a migration in a cold winter; named on Uzaza's rings.

nodes.name: The Vaal Omnitect
nodes.summary: Vaal construct, boss of the present-day Temple of Atzoatl during the Incursion leagues; its exclusive currency drops come from it.
sources: 'Currency' / 'Unique items': 'The Vaal Omnitect, the boss of The Temple of Atzoatl'

nodes.name: Vagan, Weaponmaster
nodes.summary: Duelist forsaken master (weapons). Immortal Syndicate member in Betrayal league (3.5.0).

nodes.name: Valdo Caeserius
nodes.summary: Chief Arkhon of the Oriath academy and father of Zana; dreamed of the Elder's dreamlands, was pulled into the Atlas, and fought the Elder until it ate his memories, becoming the Shaper. Aberration quotes show him grieving his Templar-killed wife.

nodes.name: Valerie, the Corsair
nodes.summary: Pondium-born corsair captain who borrowed the Sovereign from its masked, Templar-linked builders and freed Vesper's soul; recruits Exiles as first mates.
