edges.description: Avarius is slain in the Chamber of Innocence, after the Templar Courts are opened.
sources: Quest log quote: 'in the Chamber of Innocence'

edges.description: The Templar Courts must be entered with Casticus's Eyes before Avarius is reached.
sources: Quest log quote: 'gain access to the Templar Courts and from there, slay Avarius'

edges.description: Utula, high priest of Kitava, is the boss the Exile must kill to stop the ritual.
sources: Quest walkthrough: 'Kill Utula to prevent him from completing the King's Feast ritual'

edges.description: Bannon asks the Exile to stop Utula.
sources: Walkthrough Bannon dialogue: 'Please, find Utula and stop him'

edges.description: Utula's ritual summons Kitava, the Ravenous God.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Utula has used the fall of Innocence to summon Kitava'

edges.description: Utula is found in the Ruined Square, which is Oriath Square.
sources: Lead: Utula is on 'the Ruined Square' (Oriath Square)

edges.description: Kitava, the Ravenous God, reawakens and cannot be defeated in this act.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Kitava has awakened and is destroying Oriath ... to defeat Kitava'

edges.description: Captain Lilly Roth takes the Exile on board the ship back to Wraeclast.
sources: Quest walkthrough: 'Captain Lilly Roth ... we sail... for Wraeclast'

edges.description: The Sign of Purity is found inside the Ossuary.
sources: Walkthrough: 'find the entrance to the Ossuary ... find the Sign of Purity and use it to defeat Kitava'

edges.description: The Exile travels back through the Templar Courts to Oriath Square on the way to Kitava.
The exile arrives back in Wraeclast at Lioneye's Watch, the Act 6 town.
sources: Intro: 'its town is Lioneye's Watch'; Progression table starts at Lioneye's Watch

edges.description: Lilly Roth, first met on the Cathedral Rooftop at the end of Act 5, offers the exile a lift to Lioneye's Watch at the start of Act 6.
sources: Intro: 'She then offers a lift to Lioneye's Watch in Act 6'

edges.description: Sin, the exile's divine guide, sets the task of harvesting souls for the Dark Ember at the start of Act 6.
sources: Walkthrough, opening Sin dialogue: 'How do we obtain this Dark Ember? ... All I need are three fine souls'

edges.description: The exile enters the Karui Fortress and Tukohama's Keep to reach and kill Tukohama.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Find the exit to the the Karui Fortress... Tukohama's Keep, in the middle of the map'

edges.description: Tarkleigh points the exile to the Karui Fortress through the Eye of Conquest and rewards the kill of Tukohama.
sources: Walkthrough, Tarkleigh: 'I'd see about putting that eye back where it belongs' and 'You've killed the Karui war god?'

edges.description: The exile enters Axiom Prison and kills Shavronne's spirit in her tower there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Sin wants you to find the spirit of Shavronne of Umbra in her tower in the Prison and kill her.'

edges.description: Sin harvests Shavronne's soul for the Dark Ember once she is killed.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have killed Shavronne and Sin has harvested her soul.'

edges.description: The exile fights Abberath, the Cloven One, at Prisoner's Gate.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bestel has asked you to defeat Abberath, the Cloven God, at Prisoner's Gate.'

edges.description: Bestel asks the exile to kill Abberath and rewards the kill with a passive skill point.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Bestel'; Walkthrough: 'Bestel has asked you to defeat Abberath'

edges.description: The exile reaches the Brine King's Reef on the Black Crest and fights the Brine King there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'After arriving at the Brine King's Reef, search for Nessa... After finding Nessa in The Brine King's Reef you have to defeat the boss.'

edges.description: Nessa, cursed into a mermaid by the Brine King, is freed at the reef and calls the exile her new sister.
sources: Walkthrough, Nessa at the reef: 'So courageous, such a fine example of womanhood... Thank you, my new sister.'

edges.description: Weylam Roth summons from the Black Flag and sails the exile on the Black Crest to the Brine King's reef.
sources: Walkthrough, Weylam Roth at the Beacon: 'Of course I'll ferry you to the Brine King's blood reef.'

edges.description: Tarkleigh starts the quest by sending the exile to find the missing Nessa.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Speak to Tarkleigh'; Walkthrough: 'Nessa... Please, find Nessa. Bring her back to us.'

edges.description: Sin appears after the Brine King is defeated.
sources: Walkthrough: 'After defeating The Brine King Sin will appear'

edges.description: The exile enters Maligaro's Sanctum through portals opened with his Map and kills him there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have opened the portals using his Map, now enter Maligaro's Sanctum.'

edges.description: Sin harvests Maligaro's soul after he is killed.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have killed Maligaro and Sin has harvested his soul.'

edges.description: The exile kills Black Death and Maligaro in the Sanctum to take the Black Venom.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search for it in Maligaro's Sanctum' / 'Kill it and Maligaro to obtain some Black Venom.'

edges.description: The Black Venom is delivered to Silk in the Chamber of Sins Level 1.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Deliver the Black Venom to Silk in the The Chamber of Sins Level 1 (Act 7)'

edges.description: Silk asks the exile to take the Black Venom and rewards the delivery with the Obsidian key.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Silk in Act 7'; Silk: 'Please, will you find him, kill this Black Death, take the eight-leg's venom for me?'

edges.description: Maligaro is killed together with his pet spider Black Death in the Web of Secrets quest.
sources: Quest infobox: 'boss1=Maligaro, the Artist', 'boss2=Black Death, Pain Unending'

edges.description: The exile kills the possessed Greust in the Forest Encampment to drive Ralakesh back into the relic.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh is located in The Forest Encampment which connects The Ashen Fields and The Northern Forest.'

edges.description: Greust, possessed by Ralakesh as its avatar, is the enemy the exile must kill.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh ... has possessed Greust... You must kill Greust to defeat Ralakesh.'

edges.description: Eramir starts the quest, translating the relic's inscriptions and urging the exile to destroy the god.
sources: Quest infobox start 'Talk to Eramir in the The Bridge Encampment'; Eramir: 'Please, I urge you to destroy this god'

edges.description: The exile gathers the seven Fireflies in the Dread Thicket.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search for the Firefly in the The Dread Thicket (Act 7)'

edges.description: The Fireflies are delivered to Yeena in the Vaal City, at the entrance to Arakaali's temple.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Getting to Yeena from the The Dread Thicket... Yeena is located inside The Vaal City'

edges.description: Yeena asks for seven Fireflies to brew Fire Dew and burn open Arakaali's temple.
sources: Walkthrough, Yeena: 'Yeena needs seven Firefly to burn open the entrance to Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows temple.'

edges.description: The exile burns through the webs and kills Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay, failing to save Silk.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay to save Silk.'

edges.description: Silk is consorting with Arakaali and is lost when she is killed.
sources: Silk: 'My bride has arrived, exile!'; log: 'You have killed Arakaali and gained access to Act 8, but failed to save Silk.'

edges.description: Yeena, who brewed the Fire Dew, accompanies the exile to Arakaali's temple.
sources: Yeena: 'Now I must return to Broken Bridge... We will speak more of Silk and sorrow then.' and Walkthrough: Yeena's warning about Silk and Arakaali

edges.description: The exile kills Doedre in the Cauldron boss arena of Doedre's Cesspool.
sources: Walkthrough: 'In the Toxic Conduits, you will find an area called Doedre's Cesspool... This is the boss arena.'

edges.description: Sin wants Doedre killed so he can harvest her soul and does so after her death.
sources: Walkthrough: 'After defeating Doedre the Vile, Sin harvests her soul.'

edges.description: Hargan tells the exile where Doedre hides in the Toxic Conduits and gives the reward.
sources: Walkthrough: 'If you speak with Hargan, he tells you that Doedre can be found somewhere in the Toxic Conduits.'

edges.description: The exile searches the Lunaris Temple for the Moon Orb carried by Dusk.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search the The Lunaris Temple Level 2 (Act 8) for the Moon Orb'

edges.description: Maramoa sends the exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Moon Orb.
Dusk, an exile devotee of Lunaris, carried the Moon Orb into the Lunaris Temple and keeps it from the exile.
sources: Quest infobox: 'boss=Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris'; objective: 'KIll Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris and take the Moon Orb'

edges.description: The exile searches the Solaris Temple for the Sun Orb guarded by Dawn.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search the The Solaris Temple Level 1 for the Sun Orb'

edges.description: Maramoa sends the exile through the Sarn sewers to recover the Sun Orb.
Dawn, an exile devotee of Solaris, guards the Sun Orb in her temple.
sources: Quest infobox: 'boss=Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris'; Maramoa: 'The Sun Orb lies within her temple, guarded by her most ardent devotee... 'The Dawn'.'

edges.description: With both orbs, the exile summons Solaris and Lunaris in the Sky Shrine on the Harbour Bridge and kills them.
sources: Intro: 'They can be found in the Sky Shrine in the center of The Harbour Bridge once the Moon Orb and Sun Orb have been retrieved'

edges.description: Sin speaks after the twin goddesses fall, declaring the sun and moon back in their rightful places.
sources: Completion dialogue, Sin: 'Sun and Moon return to their rightful places, leaving our path now clear.'

edges.description: The exile meets Sin at the Quarry, where he burns open the way into the Beast.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at the The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance into the The Belly of the Beast (Act 9).'

edges.description: The quest's boss fight against the Depraved Trinity takes place in the Rotting Core inside the Beast.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin to manifest the Depraved Trinity' inside the Black Core

edges.description: Sin, in Highgate, sends the exile for the ingredients and then brews and opens the Beast with them.
sources: Walkthrough, Sin in Highgate: 'Sin needs you to find some Trarthan Powder and Basilisk Acid'

edges.description: Lilly Roth offers to ferry the exile to Oriath after the Trinity dies.
sources: Walkthrough, Lilly Roth: 'Say the words and we'll set the sails.'

edges.description: Sin burns the new entrance into the Beast's corpse at the Quarry.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance'

edges.description: The entrance leads into the Belly of the Beast (Act 9).
sources: Walkthrough: 'Sin has burned open a new entrance into the The Belly of the Beast (Act 9).'

edges.description: Sin burns the Beast's flank with the basilisk acid and powder mixture to open the way in.
sources: Walkthrough: 'I shall apply this fermentation to the weakened membrane'

edges.description: The Depraved Trinity is fought and destroyed in the Rotting Core.
sources: Infobox: 'location = The Rotting Core'; intro: 'the final boss of Act 9, located in The Rotting Core'

edges.description: Sin manifests the Depraved Trinity from the three harvested souls and urges its destruction.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Talk to Sin to manifest the Depraved Trinity'; Sin: 'Destroy that creature of darkness'

edges.description: Shavronne of Umbra is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.
sources: Intro: 'The Trinity is the combined power of the three lieutenants of Malachai... Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: Maligaro is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.
sources: Intro: 'Doedre Stamatis, Maligaro, and Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: Doedre is one of the three lieutenants whose combined power forms the Depraved Trinity.
sources: Intro: 'the three lieutenants of Malachai... Doedre Stamatis, Maligaro, and Shavronne of Umbra.'

edges.description: The exile lands at Oriath Docks, where Lani greets them.
sources: Intro: 'its town is Oriath Docks'; Lani: 'Landing on the docks, the exile is greeted by Lani' (NPC list)

edges.description: Lilly Roth ferries the exile back to Oriath.
sources: Intro: 'the exile returns to Oriath, courtesy of Lilly Roth'

edges.description: Lani describes how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon and led Kitava's cultists to the Overseer's Tower.
sources: Walkthrough, Lani: 'That witch, Vilenta, is to blame. She lowered a secret ladder'
Intro: 'Landing on the docks, the exile is greeted by Lani'

edges.description: The exile saves Bannon from Kitava's cultists on the Cathedral Rooftop.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bannon is trapped on the The Cathedral Rooftop (Act 10) by the cultists of Kitava.'

edges.description: Lani asks the exile to find Bannon and return him to her.
sources: Walkthrough, Lani: 'If you are going that way, perhaps you can find him and return him to me.'

edges.description: Kitava's cultists surround Bannon and Lani and are the enemies the exile fights on the rooftop.
sources: Walkthrough, Bannon: 'Kitava's cultists surrounded Lani and I a while back'

edges.description: Bannon meets the exile at the docks with the Staff of Purity and sacrifices himself there to resurrect Innocence.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bring it to him at the Oriath Docks.'

edges.description: Bannon uses the Staff of Purity and sacrifices himself to host the reborn Innocence.
sources: Walkthrough, Bannon: 'In this act, I will become his host in the fullest sense'; log: 'Bannon has used the Staff of Purity ... and sacrificed himself'

edges.description: Innocence destroys Kitava's Horns at the Ravaged Square.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Meet Innocence at the Horns in the The Ravaged Square'

edges.description: Innocence destroys the black gates blocking the Canals with his power.
sources: Walkthrough, Innocence: 'Innocence will use his power to destroy Kitava's Horns'

edges.description: The exile finds Kitava at his Feeding Trough and kills him there.
sources: Walkthrough: 'You have found Kitava at his Feeding Trough. Talk to Sin to begin the final battle.'

edges.description: Kitava is searched for and destroyed in the Canals.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Search The Canals for Kitava and destroy Kitava, the Insatiable once and for all.'

edges.description: Sin begins the final battle and congratulates the exile after Kitava falls.
sources: Walkthrough, Sin: 'This is it... Go Exile, together we will save humankind!'

edges.description: Innocence, reborn, fights alongside the exile against Kitava.
sources: Walkthrough, Innocence: 'Though my brother and I will aid you, I sense the universe conspires'

edges.description: Lilly Roth offers to sail the exile away from Oriath, with a line tailored to the exile's class.
sources: Walkthrough, Lilly Roth: 'Whaddya say, Marauder? ... Just say the word, and we'll set sail.'

edges.description: The exile reaches Karui Shores and begins the Atlas of Worlds tutorial.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time, talk to Helena.'

edges.description: Helena directs the exile to the War Room on Karui Shores.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time, talk to Helena. She will direct the player to the War Room'

edges.description: Commander Kirac gives the exile the first Tier 1 map to use on the Map Device.
sources: Walkthrough: 'talk to Commander Kirac. He will give the player a Tier 1 map.'

edges.description: Commander Kirac, in the Karui Shores War Room, gives the Exile the Tier 1 map that starts the Atlas quest.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores ... War Room ... Commander Kirac ... give the player a Tier 1 map'

edges.description: The commissioning takes place in the Karui Shores War Room.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Upon entering Karui Shores for the first time'

edges.description: The map boss the Exile kills to complete the quest is fought in a Tier 1 Atlas map.
sources: objective: entering the Atlas maps via portals; 'Defeat the Map Boss and return to Commander Kirac'

edges.description: The Shaper, Valdo reduced to a shell, is the subject of the seven memory fragments in this legacy quest.
sources: Assignments: memory fragments of the Shaper

edges.description: The hunt takes place in Shaper-influenced Atlas maps (Tier 2 to 6).
The Shaper is the boss the Exile and Zana defeat in his Realm after the four Guardians are broken.
sources: Walkthrough: 'enter the Shaper's Realm and defeat The Shaper'

edges.description: Zana fights alongside the Exile against the Shaper in his Realm.
sources: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' > 'Zana': 'Encountering the Shaper in the Shaper's Realm, Zana and the exile were attacked by the Shaper ... he was defeated by the exile and Zana.'

edges.description: The Shaper is defeated in the Shaper's Realm at the centre of the Atlas.
sources: objective: 'access the Shaper's Realm in the centre of the Atlas'

edges.description: The Elder is the boss expelled from the Atlas after being lured to its centre.
sources: Walkthrough: 'To spawn the Elder at the Shaper's Realm ... defeat the other Shaper Guardian'

edges.description: Zana uses the Cosmic Arcana to expel the Elder from the Atlas.
sources: section 'Defeat of the Elder' and 'Zana section'

edges.description: The Elder is lured to the centre of the Atlas, where the Shaper's Realm is.
sources: Walkthrough: 'To spawn the Elder at the Shaper's Realm'

edges.description: The Elder is fought in the Absence of Value and Meaning Atlas realm.
sources: Walkthrough, 'The Elder': 'Use these fragments to defeat The Elder in Absence of Value and Meaning.'

edges.description: Sirus returns with a storm, builds his own device and burns Oriath before the Exile defeats him.
sources: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' > 'The Elderslayers' > 'Sirus': 'Sirus returned with a great storm ... created his own map device and used it to enter Oriath ... Oriath was burned to the ground.'

edges.description: Zana is present for Sirus's return and then leaves the Atlas.
Sirus burns Oriath during his return.
The Envoy introduces the Maven while the Exile kills map bosses in the Atlas.
sources: Walkthrough: map bosses killed under the Maven's witness

edges.description: After the Maven is defeated and the Ceremonial Voidstone unlocked, Commander Kirac gives the Exile a reward.
The quest starts on entering Absence of Mercy and Empathy and culminates in the Maven fight there.
sources: intro paragraph: 'after entering Absence of Mercy and Empathy using a The Maven's Writ'

edges.description: The Eldritch Horrors approach the Atlas and the Exile defeats their champions there.
The Searing Exarch is fought in Absence of Patience and Wisdom.
sources: Walkthrough: 'defeat The Searing Exarch' in 'Absence of Patience and Wisdom'

edges.description: The Eater of Worlds is fought in Absence of Symmetry and Harmony.
sources: Walkthrough: 'defeat the The Eater of Worlds' in 'Absence of Symmetry and Harmony'

edges.description: The Exarch boss is fought in Absence of Patience and Wisdom.
The Envoy finds the Exarch's influence in yellow (T6+) Atlas maps.
sources: Walkthrough: 'While the player is exploring yellow maps (T6+) ... The Envoy'

edges.description: The Eater of Worlds is fought in Absence of Symmetry and Harmony.
The Envoy finds the Eater's influence in yellow (T6+) Atlas maps.
sources: Walkthrough: 'While the player is mapping yellow maps (T6+) ... The Envoy'

edges.description: Zana tells Eagon that she must destroy the Atlas.
sources: Walkthrough, final section (Zana and Eagon dialogue)

edges.description: Zana fractures the Atlas itself.
Helena directs the Exile from Karui Shores to the War Room to find Commander Kirac.
sources: Walkthrough: 'talk to Helena. She will direct the player to the War Room'

edges.description: The Exile is commissioned by Commander Kirac to aid the Citizen Vanguard.
sources: completion text: 'commissioned by Commander Kirac to aid the Citizen Vanguard'

edges.description: Zana, as quest giver, sends the Exile into Shaper-influenced maps.
sources: Background: 'a quest given to the player by Zana'; Walkthrough start 'Talk to Zana'

edges.description: The arrival beat takes place in Kingsmarch, where the Exile reaches Doryani.
sources: Talk to Doryani (quest log: 'You have arrived in Kingsmarch')

edges.description: Doryani is present in Kingsmarch on arrival and laments the state of the city.
sources: Talk to Doryani: Doryani: 'This is it? This... is Kingsmarch? Science and civilisation must have never recovered.'

edges.description: The Hooded One is with the Exile and Doryani on arrival and comments on the Kalguurans.
sources: Talk to Doryani: The Hooded One: 'Your time was different, yes, but don't discount the Kalguurans just yet. They have potential.'

edges.description: The charter deal with Alva, Rog and Makoru takes place in Kingsmarch.
sources: Talk to Alva / Take the Boat Charter (Alva, Rog and Makoru all speak in Kingsmarch; Makoru: 'we only operate under the Meridian Free Traders of Kingsmarch')

edges.description: Alva introduces the Exile to Rog, the charter seller.
sources: Talk to Alva: Alva: 'Ah, there you are! This is my contact Rog, a trader with a keen eye for valuable artefacts!'

edges.description: Rog sells the Boat Charter in exchange for Vaal treasure.
sources: Talk to Alva: Rog, the Dealer: 'Kalguuran merchant vessels don't intentionally seek out danger... Take it to her.'

edges.description: Makoru, captain of the Aurora May, is the ship's captain the charter secures.
sources: Talk to Makoru: Makoru: 'Welcome aboard. I'm Makoru. Captain of the Aurora May.'

edges.description: Kanu, first mate of the Aurora May, is part of the crew hired in this beat.
sources: Talk to Makoru: Kanu: 'If you're lookin' for a ship, best speak to the boss, Makoru.'

edges.description: One of the rotating islands where a Weapon piece may be found is Isle of Kin.
sources: Progression: island map and 'Precursor weapon pieces & Matiki locations' table (Isle of Kin, Volcanic Warrens)

edges.description: Shrike Island is one of the rotating islands holding a Weapon piece.
sources: Progression: island map (Shrike Island, Boss: Scourge of the Skies) and piece-location table

edges.description: Whakapanu Island is one of the rotating islands holding a Weapon piece.
sources: Progression: island map (Whakapanu Island, Singing Caverns, Boss: Diamora, Song of Death)

edges.description: Krutog, Lord of Kin is a boss the Exile fights while searching the islands for Weapon pieces.
sources: Progression: island map (Volcanic Warrens, Isle of Kin, Boss: Krutog, Lord of Kin)

edges.description: The Scourge of the Skies is a boss the Exile fights on Shrike Island during the piece search.
sources: Progression: island map (Shrike Island, Boss: Scourge of the Skies)

edges.description: Diamora, Song of Death is a boss the Exile fights in Singing Caverns during the piece search.
sources: Progression: island map (Singing Caverns, Whakapanu Island, Boss: Diamora, Song of Death)

edges.description: The Prisoner is a boss in Solitary Confinement, reached while searching for Weapon pieces; that area is not one of the three listed occurs_in locations.
sources: Progression: island map (Solitary Confinement, Abandoned Prison, Boss: The Prisoner)

edges.description: Makoru's ship carries the Exile between the islands during the piece search.
sources: Explore the Islands: 'You have obtained a weapon piece. Speak to Makoru to travel to a new island.'

edges.description: Doryani is present and works to translate the Precursor script the Hooded One recognises.
sources: Witness The Hooded One: Doryani: 'The first example of Precursor writing I've ever seen!'

edges.description: The Utopia quest starts with Missionary Lorandis in Kingsmarch.
sources: Quest description: 'It is begun by speaking with Missionary Lorandis in Kingsmarch'

edges.description: The oath to the Saviour and the offer of Utopia both happen on Arastas.
sources: Quest description: 'encourages you to journey to Arastas take an oath to The Saviour'

edges.description: Missionary Lorandis sends the Exile to Arastas to swear the oath.
sources: Quest description: Missionary Lorandis begins the quest in Kingsmarch and sends the Exile to Arastas

edges.description: Servitor Marius offers the Exile membership in Utopia, and the refusal completes the quest.
sources: Quest description: 'He proposes to join their Utopia or donate to their cause'; completion 'Speak with Servitor Marius'

edges.description: The fight against Torvian takes place on Arastas.
sources: Progression: island map (Arastas, Boss: Torvian, Hand of the Saviour)

edges.description: The fight against Benedictus takes place in the Excavation.
sources: Progression: island map (The Excavation, Boss: Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia)

edges.description: The Countess leaves Benedictus to hold the Exile and retreats.
sources: Confront Kanu and the First Herald: The Countess: 'First Herald... deal with them.'

edges.description: Kanu begs to be taken along and reveals the Beast is in Oriath.
sources: Defeat Benedictus: Kanu: 'Please, please, please! Take me with you, please!'

edges.description: Tavakai strikes Kanu down after Kanu's confession.
sources: Defeat Benedictus: Tavukai: 'Hyaaahhh!' ... 'Let the ancestors judge him.'

edges.description: Makoru witnesses Kanu's treachery during the Benedictus fight.
The reforging and seizure take place in the Excavated Site, which is within the Excavation.
sources: Enter the Excavated Site: Makoru: 'These murals... They appear to depict the Weapon... and the Beast.' (wiki names 'Excavated Site'; treated as the Excavation)

edges.description: Tavakai takes the reforged Weapon for the Karui.
sources: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: Tavakai: 'Taking what is rightfully ours. The Karui will now be stronger than ever before!'

edges.description: Makoru is taken along by Tavakai when he flees.
sources: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: 'Tavakai flees, taking Makoru with him.'

edges.description: The Hooded One performs the reforging and then warns of the Weapon's Corruption.
sources: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: The Hooded One: 'This will take most of my strength... Stand back.'

edges.description: The inscription is read back in Kingsmarch.
sources: Return to Kingsmarch: The Hooded One: 'There is no doubt now in my mind... The symbols declare it The instrument of the Third Edict.'

edges.description: The Weapon is reforged in the Excavated Site before the inscription is read in Kingsmarch.
sources: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon (after 'Enter the Excavated Site'): The Hooded One: 'you've done well... Stand back.' (wiki names 'Excavated Site'; treated as the Excavation)

edges.description: Doryani reacts to the inscription and asks about the Edicts.
sources: Return to Kingsmarch: Doryani: 'The Third Edict? What is the meaning... of these Edicts?'

edges.description: Makoru is present for the reforging and seizure.
sources: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: Makoru: 'You fool! They need the Weapon! The world is at stake!'

edges.description: Tavakai is present for the reforging and seizes the Weapon.
sources: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: Tavakai: 'Behold! The might of the Karui!'

edges.description: Tavakai's three-phase fight takes place at the Heart of the Tribe.
sources: Progression: island map (Heart of the Tribe, Act Boss: Tavakai, the Chieftain)

edges.description: The Heart of the Tribe lies within the Ngakanu area.
sources: Progression: island map (Ngakanu, with Heart of the Tribe below it)

edges.description: Tavakai is the boss the Exile defeats in this beat.
sources: Defeat Tavakai: Tavakai: 'I must be stronger... For the Karui!'; Phase 3: 'The power of the Ancestors is mine!'

edges.description: Tukohama, the Karui god of war, rejects Tavakai's appeal during the fight.
sources: Defeat Tavakai: Tukohama: 'This... is not the Way.'

edges.description: The cure follows Tavakai's defeat, and the location is inferred from that fight.
sources: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru (the quest log does not name a place; placed where Tavakai was defeated)

edges.description: The Hooded One, called Sin in the quest log, uses the Weapon to cure Tavakai and Makoru.
sources: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru: The Hooded One: 'I believe so... But we have to move quickly. You must relinquish the Weapon.'

edges.description: Tavakai is cured of Blood Fever and pledges the Karui to the coming war.
sources: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru: Tavakai: 'Forgive me... daughter. The fever took hold, and I... I lost my way.'

edges.description: Makoru is cured of Blood Fever alongside Tavakai.
sources: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru: Makoru: 'Father!'

edges.description: The alliance plan is made in Kingsmarch.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One (after Return to Kingsmarch): 'Now, we need allies... before we assault Oriath.'

edges.description: The Hooded One decides to call the allies to war before the assault on Oriath.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'Now, we need allies... We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'

edges.description: Doryani offers his reserve forces to the alliance.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: Doryani: 'As it so happens, I may... also have some forces in reserve.'

edges.description: The Karui are already part of the alliance when the plan is made.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'The Karui are already with us.'

edges.description: The Ezomytes are named as the first allies the Hooded One plans to call.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'

edges.description: The Maraketh are named as allies the Hooded One plans to call.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'

edges.description: The Ezomyte recruitment begins and Renly is met in Ogham.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'To Ogham, then.'; Speak to Renly

edges.description: The bosses Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth are fought in Holten.
sources: Speak to Renly: Renly: 'Our neighbours... in Holten. Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth have lost their bloody minds.'

edges.description: The Hooded One starts the quest by sending the Exile to Ogham.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'To Ogham, then. Hopefully, they've had time to rebuild.'

edges.description: Renly asks for the Ezomytes' help and later pledges them to the war.
sources: Speak to Renly: Renly: 'It's good you're here. Our will to survive is being tested, yet again.'

edges.description: Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth are the Holten bosses the Exile defeats in this quest.
sources: Completion: 'Defeat Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth'; Defeat the Thane and Lady

edges.description: Isolde of the White Shroud is one of the bosses the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands.
sources: Quest log: 'Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.'

edges.description: Heldra of the Black Pyre is defeated alongside Isolde in Scorched Farmlands.
sources: Quest log: 'Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.'

edges.description: Siora, Blade of the Mists, is a boss the Exile defeats at the altar.
sources: Quest log: 'Defeat Siora, Blade of the Mists.' Siora: 'Darkness descends... and with it, your end!'

edges.description: The Ezomyte clans are pledged to the war once Holten is cleared.
sources: Return to Renly in Ogham: Renly: 'The Thanes will answer the call. The clans will all join this war.'

edges.description: The Maraketh recruitment starts with a trip to the Bazaar where Asala is found.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One to travel to the Bazaar; Speak to Asala

edges.description: The Exile searches the Khari Crossing for the tower and the Galai Gates.
sources: Travel to The Khari Crossing and locate the tower of Ab Binayi; Find the Galai Gates

edges.description: The Gifting of Water is disrupted by Azmadi in Qimah and its reservoir.
sources: Explore Qimah in search of the Ceremony Site; Explore Qimah Reservoir

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile to the Maraketh.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'At this time of year, I know where to find the Ardura akhara.'

edges.description: Asala is the Sekhema who needs the First Barya returned for the Gifting of Water and later joins the war.
sources: Speak to Asala: Sekhema Asala: 'Yes. We have learned this as well... The sel khari... have not arrived.'

edges.description: Zarka reveals the location of the sel khari to the Exile.
sources: Speak to Zarka: Zarka: 'Ascend the tower of Ab Binayi. At its height you will find a guiding seal.'

edges.description: Jado, of the Order of the Djinn, helps the Exile recover the First Barya.
sources: Speak to Asala: Jado: 'I infiltrated the sel khari to protect the First Barya.'

edges.description: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord, is a boss the Exile defeats in the sel khari sanctuary.
sources: Quest log: 'Defeat Elzarah, the Cobra Lord.'

edges.description: Vornas, the Fell Flame, is a boss the Exile defeats after the Galai Gates.
sources: Quest log: 'Defeat Vornas, the Fell Flame.'

edges.description: Azmadi, the Faridun Prince, is a boss the Exile defeats in Qimah Reservoir.
sources: Defeat Azmadi, the Faridun Prince: Azmadi: 'The Faridun shall rise!'

edges.description: The Maraketh join the alliance on completion of the quest.
sources: Quest Complete: 'The Maraketh will join you in your journey to Oriath.'

edges.description: The Vaal recruitment takes place on Mount Kriar.
sources: Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'Before us stands Mount Kriar, the most isolated peak in the Azmeri Ranges.'

edges.description: The final confrontation with Zolin and Zelina takes place in the Cuachic Vault.
sources: Enter the Cuachic Vault; Defeat Zolin and Zelina

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile to Mount Kriar.
sources: Speak to the Hooded One: 'Let us seek out Doryani's reserves... whatever they may be.'

edges.description: Doryani gives the code phrase and later appears to command the Cuachic.
sources: Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'If their discipline and loyalty endure... they will know us by a certain phrase.'

edges.description: Zolin and Zelina are bosses the Exile defeats in the Cuachic Vault.
Rakkar, the Frozen Talon, is a boss the Exile defeats on the way up Mount Kriar.
sources: Quest log: 'Defeat Rakkar, the Frozen Talon.'

edges.description: Stormgore is a boss the Exile defeats in the Etched Ravine on Mount Kriar.
The Cuachic join the alliance once the Vaal are convinced.
sources: Quest Complete: 'You have convinced the Vaal to aid you.'; Doryani: 'The Cuachic shall join our cause.'

edges.description: The assault on Oriath is planned in Kingsmarch.
sources: Speak to Hooded One: 'Speak to Hooded One in Kingsmarch.'

edges.description: The siege ends at the Ziggurat Refuge instead of Oriath.
sources: Quest Complete: 'have ended up in the Ziggurat Refuge despite your attempts to travel to Oriath'; infobox completion 'End up at the Ziggurat Refuge'

edges.description: The Hooded One proposes and plans the assault on Oriath.
sources: Speak to Hooded One: 'Wraeclast has finally united... Come, let us plan our assault on Oriath.'

edges.description: Doryani presents the strategy for the assault on Oriath.
sources: Speak to Hooded One: Doryani: 'I've been working on a strategy of sorts.'

edges.description: The Exile ends up at the Ziggurat Refuge, where Doryani later explains the Hooded One's condition.
sources: Siege of Oriath Quest Complete: 'have ended up in the Ziggurat Refuge despite your attempts to travel to Oriath'; Legacy of the Precursors: 'Speak to Doryani'

edges.description: Doryani explains that the Beast's Corruption holds the Hooded One in thrall.
sources: Legacy of the Precursors, Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'As we feared, the Beast's Corruption holds the Hooded One in thrall.'

edges.description: The Hooded One is found asleep and cannot be woken, held by the Beast's Corruption.
sources: Check on the Hooded One (quest log) and Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'Nothing we do can wake him.'

edges.description: Count Geonor sentences the Exile to death during his reign of terror in Ogham.
The Executioner attempts to hang the Exile, who escapes by jumping into the ocean.
The Bloated Miller is the diseased boss the Exile must slay on The Riverbank.
sources: Quest infobox boss = The Bloated Miller / Walkthrough 'Slay the Bloated Miller'

edges.description: Renly, the Clearfell blacksmith, rewards the Exile with an Uncut Skill Gem for slaying the Miller.
sources: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Blacksmith' / 'Take Renly's reward'

edges.description: Una advises that only ancient runes can break the Count's binding on the Hooded One and later speaks to the Exile after his release.
sources: Walkthrough 'Ask Una for help' / 'Speak to Una'

edges.description: Renly forges the three Runes of Power into Rune Spikes.
sources: Walkthrough 'Bring the Runes to Renly' / 'Take the Rune Spikes from Renly'

edges.description: The Rust King guards the final Rune of Power in the Red Vale and is defeated for it.
The Hooded One is released from the Tree of Souls when the Rune Spikes are stabbed into the runes.
sources: Walkthrough 'Use the Rune Spikes' / 'Speak to Una' (Una: 'He's unconscious, but he's breathing')

edges.description: Una revives the Hooded One at Clearfell Encampment after the Exile brings Count Lachlann's Ring.
sources: Walkthrough 'Bring Count Lachlann's Ring to Una' / 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'

edges.description: Una uses Count Lachlann's ring to heal the Hooded One and learns the Seed of Corruption is the cause of Ogham's affliction.
sources: Walkthrough 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One' (Una: 'You found the ring!')

edges.description: The Hooded One is revived and warns that the Seed of Corruption must be put back.
sources: Walkthrough 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One' (The Hooded One quote)

edges.description: Lachlann of Endless Lament asks the Exile for the Memorial Gate keys and is put to rest at the end of the quest.
sources: Quest header 'start = Talk to Lachlann the Lost' / 'End Lachlann's Suffering'

edges.description: Asinia, the Praetor's Consort, is destroyed in the Tomb of the Consort for her Memorial Key piece.
Praetor Draven is destroyed in the Mausoleum for his Memorial Key piece.
The Executioner is the boss the Exile kills at Ogham Village.
sources: Quest infobox boss = The Executioner / Walkthrough 'Kill the Executioner'

edges.description: Leitis, the Executioner's prisoner, is freed and asks the Exile to depose Count Geonor.
sources: Walkthrough 'Free the Prisoner' / 'Talk to Leitis' (Leitis: 'He killed Eamon.')

edges.description: Count Geonor, the Mad Wolf, is the boss the Exile slays in Ogham Manor.
sources: Quest infobox boss = Count Geonor / Walkthrough 'Kill the Mad Wolf'

edges.description: Oriana, The Countess, escapes Ogham Manor with the Beast.
sources: Walkthrough 'Return to Town' ('Oriana has escaped with the Beast')

edges.description: The fledgling Beast escapes Ogham Manor with Oriana, leaving corruption in its wake.
sources: Walkthrough 'Return to Town' / Hooded One quote ('The fledgling Beast is leaving Corruption in its wake')

edges.description: Leitis sends the Exile into the Manor to find a way in and depose Count Geonor.
sources: Quest header 'start = Talk to Leitis' / Walkthrough 'Infiltrate the Manor'

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile east in pursuit of Oriana and the Beast.
Zarka grants the Exile passage as a jingakh and the quest ends on entering the Ardura Caravan.
sources: Walkthrough 'Enter the Ardura Caravan' / Quest Complete

edges.description: Zarka, leader of the Ardura caravan, asks the Exile to clear the raiders and then admits them as a jingakh.
sources: Walkthrough 'Earn passage on the caravan' / 'Speak to Zarka'

edges.description: Rathbreaker, leader of the Sun Clan hyenas, is the boss the Exile defeats.
sources: Quest infobox boss = Rathbreaker / Walkthrough 'Defeat Rathbreaker'

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile to find a Maraketh caravan to aid the pursuit of the Seed of Corruption.
sources: Walkthrough 'Speak to the Hooded One' (Hooded One quote on the Maraketh caravan)

edges.description: Rudja, the Dread Engineer, is defeated in Mawdun Mine.
Risu, a Faridun defector, is found in Mawdun Mine and taken back to the caravan, where she reveals Jamanra's plan to feed the Beast Deshar's honoured dead.
sources: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Defector' / 'Return to the Caravan's lead cart' (Risu quote)

edges.description: The Faridun run a foundry in Mawdun Mine, where Rudja is defeated.
sources: Walkthrough 'Investigate Mawdun Mine' ('a foundry run by the Faridun')

edges.description: Sekhema Asala fights alongside the Exile to open the Halani Gates.
sources: Walkthrough 'Assist Asala in opening the Gates' / 'Open the third Gate'

edges.description: Jamanra, the Risen King, leads the Faridun defending the Gates and is fought there.
The Exile enters the sand-buried city of Keth and reaches its Sanctum for the Essence of Water.
sources: Walkthrough 'Search for the Buried Shrines' / 'Find the Sanctum at the heart of Keth'

edges.description: Azarian, the Forsaken Son, is the unique boss the Exile must defeat to reach the Essence of Water.
sources: Quest infobox / Walkthrough 'Defeat Azarian, the Forsaken Son'

edges.description: The Water Goddess Halani asks the Exile to burn her with the Everburning Cinders to end her suffering.
sources: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Water Goddess' / 'End the Water Goddess' suffering'

edges.description: Asala sends the Exile after the sandstorm to recover the Essence of Water for the Horn.
sources: Quest header 'start = Speak to Sekhema Asala after encountering the sandstorm at the Halani Gates'

edges.description: Ekbab, Ancient Steed, guards the Mastodon Tusks in the Bone Pits and is defeated.
sources: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab, the Deathlord'

edges.description: Iktab, the Deathlord, assists Ekbab in the Bone Pits and is defeated.
sources: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab, the Deathlord'

edges.description: Zarka receives the Mastodon Tusks for safekeeping at the Ardura Caravan and gives the reward.
Zalmarath, the Colossus, is defeated at the Rite of Flame in the Titan Grotto and drops the Flame Ruby.
sources: Quest infobox boss = Zalmarath, the Colossus / Walkthrough 'Defeat Zalmarath, the Colossus and retrieve the Flame Ruby'

edges.description: Zarka receives the Flame Ruby at the Ardura Caravan and rewards the Exile.
sources: Walkthrough 'Take the Flame Ruby to town' / 'Take the reward from Zarka'

edges.description: Asala starts the quest after the sandstorm encounter at the Halani Gates.
sources: Quest header 'start = Speak to Sekhema Asala after encountering the sandstorm at the Halani Gates'

edges.description: Zarka reforges the Horn of the Vastiri with the Exile from the Flame Ruby, Essence of Water and Mastodon Tusks.
sources: Quest log 'Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri' / 'Take the Horn of the Vastiri' (Zarka quote)

edges.description: Asala explains Orbala's footsteps and that the Horn can be recreated by retracing them in any order.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Asala' ('We can retrace Orbala's steps in any order.')

edges.description: Asala speaks to the Exile after the Horn dispels the sandstorm and grants access to Deshar.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Asala' ('I am hesitant to allow you access to sacred Deshar')

edges.description: Tor Gul, the Defiler, is the boss defeated on the way to the Spires of Deshar.
Tor Gul, the Defiler, is met on the way to the Spires of Deshar, after the Exile travels the Path of Mourning.
sources: Walkthrough 'Travel through the Path of Mourning' / 'Defeat Tor Gul, the Defiler' (page does not state the fight location)

edges.description: The Faridun, having escaped with the Beast, are defended by Tor Gul.
sources: Walkthrough 'Defeat Tor Gul, the Defiler' ('The Faridun have escaped with the Beast.')

edges.description: Jamanra, the Abomination, is the boss fought on the Dreadnought.
sources: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' (phase 1 and phase 2)

edges.description: Asala beheads Jamanra in phase 2 after he is reduced to 1 life, ending the fight.
sources: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' ('In Phase 2 ... interact with Sekhema Asala to have her behead him.')

edges.description: The Countess escapes the Dreadnought with the Beast after Jamanra severs the section holding it.
sources: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' ('allowing the Countess to escape')

edges.description: The Beast is held in the Dreadnought and escapes once more with the Countess.
sources: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' ('The Beast escapes with the Countess once more' / Jamanra severs the section holding the Beast)

edges.description: The Hooded One confesses to the Exile that he is Sin, the Thief of Virtue, and that he created the Beast.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest' (quote 'I am... a god. I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.')

edges.description: The Hooded One's revealed identity is Sin, the Thief of Virtue.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest' (quote 'I am Sin.')

edges.description: Oswald, the treasure hunters' Quartermaster, greets the Exile at the Ziggurat camp.
Alva Valai introduces herself to the Exile at the Ziggurat Encampment.
After the Chimera is defeated the Exile enters Jiquani's Machinarium.
Xyclucian, the Chimera, is the guardian boss blocking the entrance to the Machinarium.
sources: Quest log 'Defeat Xyclucian, the Chimera' ('A massive beast seems to be guarding the entrance')

edges.description: Alva asks the Exile to find a small Soul Core to power the stone door's mechanism.
sources: Quest log 'Ask Alva for advice' / 'Search for a small Soul Core' (Alva quote)

edges.description: Zicoatl, Warden of the Core, is defeated to take the large Soul Core from the construct.
sources: Quest log 'Defeat Zicoatl' / 'Pick up the Large Soul Core'

edges.description: Alva identifies the large Soul Core and advises which generators to activate.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' (Alva quote: 'This is the largest Soul Core I've ever seen!')

edges.description: The Exile powers the stone altar in the Infested Barrens with the large Soul Core.
sources: Quest log 'Return to Infested Barrens and activate the Stone Altar'

edges.description: The Hooded One proposes lowering the lake using the Vaal canals.
sources: Quest log 'Talk to the Hooded One' ('Ask the Hooded One about lowering the water level')

edges.description: Alva confirms the revealed city and sends the Exile to the Temple of Kopec's locked door.
sources: Quest log 'Talk to Alva' (Alva quote about Kopec)

edges.description: The Queen of Filth is defeated in Aggorat and drops the Temple Door Idol.
sources: Quest log 'Defeat the Queen of Filth' / 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'

edges.description: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun, is defeated in the Temple of Kopec.
sources: Quest log 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun'

edges.description: Alva deciphers the runes in the Temple and activates the elevator and gateway.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' (Alva quote: 'It.. worked!?')

edges.description: Alva accompanies the Exile through the time gateway and is seen as a threat by the Vaal.
sources: Quest log 'Enter Utzaal in the past' (Alva quote: 'Are these... living Vaal?')

edges.description: Doryani is present as the gateway activates ('It begins...').
sources: Quest log 'Enter Utzaal in the past' (Doryani quote)

edges.description: The Exile fights the Vaal forces of Utzaal's past.
sources: Quest log 'Explore Utzaal in the past' ('Halt! Your rampage ends here!')

edges.description: Viper Napuatzi, the Vaal general, has Alva taken to Doryani and is defeated.
sources: Quest log 'Explore Utzaal in the past' / 'Defeat Viper Napuatzi'

edges.description: Alva is seized by Viper Napuatzi's forces and must be rescued.
sources: Quest log 'Defeat Viper Napuatzi' ('Take her! Bring her to Doryani!')

edges.description: The Exile fights through Aggorat to reach the Black Chambers.
sources: Quest log 'Fight through Aggorat and search for the Black Chambers'

edges.description: Doryani, the Vaal expert on the Beast, is captured in the Black Chambers and agrees to help contain the Beast.
sources: Quest log 'Capture Doryani for his knowledge of the Beast'

edges.description: Alva is rescued from the Black Chambers and persuades Doryani to come to the present.
The Exile and Alva survive the Cataclysm striking Utzaal in its past.
Doryani returns through the gateway and laments that his people are long dead.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Doryani' (Doryani quote: 'Utzaal... my people... they're all long dead.')

edges.description: Alva survives the Cataclysm and returns through the gateway with the Exile.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' ('Oh good, you're alive!')

edges.description: Doryani confirms he holds one piece of the Precursor weapon and points the group to Ngamakanui.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Doryani' ('We must travel to the archipelago the Karui call Ngamakanui.')

edges.description: Alva proposes Kingsmarch as a base and offers a ship charter from her contact.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' / 'Travel to Kingsmarch'

edges.description: The Hooded One decides the group should travel south to Ngamakanui.
sources: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' ('If he thinks we should travel south to Ngamakanui, then so we shall.')

edges.description: The quest's Doryani briefing takes place at the Ziggurat, where he explains his Waygate plan.
sources: 'Take a Waystone from Doryani': 'Take a Waystone reward from Doryani in The Ziggurat Refuge.'

edges.description: Doryani is the quest giver, proposing to recover Precursor knowledge through the Waygate.
sources: 'Speak to Doryani': 'I have already been working on a plan... The machine you see here... I call it... a Waygate.'

edges.description: Doryani presents the Waygate built over the leylines beneath the Ziggurat.
sources: 'Speak to Doryani: leylines, Waygate': 'This Ziggurat was built over what my ancestors called leylines.'

edges.description: Doryani introduces the Waygate built over the leylines and gives the Exile the Waystone.
sources: 'Speak to Doryani: leylines, Waygate': Doryani introduces the Waygate and gives the Waystone.

edges.description: The Exile takes the Waystone from Doryani at the Ziggurat Refuge and enters the first Map through the Waygate.
sources: 'Take a Waystone from Doryani' / 'Select and enter a Map': 'Take a Waystone reward from Doryani in The Ziggurat Refuge.'

edges.description: Doryani sends the Exile through the untested Waygate and then declares it a success ('Science is a process').
sources: 'Speak to Doryani': 'Our first step is a success! The Waygate does indeed work.' / 'Science is a process.'

edges.description: The Exile travels to a Precursor Tower and activates its beacon.
sources: 'Travel to the Precursor Tower': 'Travel to the Precursor Tower.'

edges.description: Doryani identifies the tower as Precursor and orders the beacon activated ('I'm making... a judgement call. Do it.').
sources: 'Speak to Doryani' (Travel to the Precursor Tower): 'This tower is indeed Precursor. We should activate it'

edges.description: The Exile explores the Ancient Gateway, uses its levers and activates a Precursor Beacon there.
sources: 'Travel to the Ancient Gateway', 'Explore the Ancient Gateway', 'Activate the Precursor Beacon'

edges.description: Doryani is summoned at the Ancient Gateway's central platform and speaks with the Exile there.
sources: 'Reach the central platform', 'Summon Doryani', 'Speak to Doryani' (quest log steps after 'Explore the Ancient Gateway')

edges.description: The Exile reaches and explores the Burning Monolith, the endgame site where the Arbiter of Ash waits.
sources: 'Reach the Burning Monolith', 'Explore the Burning Monolith'
Lead: 'The Burning Monolith is a special area in the Precursor Fortress.'

edges.description: The Burning Monolith is a special area inside the Precursor Fortress in the 0.5 layout.
sources: Lead: 'The Burning Monolith is a special area in the Precursor Fortress.'; Version history 0.5.0: 'moved into the Fortress'

edges.description: Doryani is spoken to during the Burning Monolith sequence of the quest ('Speak to Doryani' after 'Explore the Burning Monolith').
sources: 'Explore the Burning Monolith' / 'Speak to Doryani' (quest log after 'Reach the Burning Monolith')

edges.description: The Exile fights in the Western and Eastern Enigma Chambers behind the Gateways.
sources: 'Travel to the Western Enigma Chamber', 'Explore the Eastern Enigma Chamber'

edges.description: Count Geonor is defeated in the Western Enigma Chamber, which yields the Ancient Crisis Fragment.
sources: 'Defeat Count Geonor' (Western Enigma Chamber) / 'Pick up the Ancient Crisis Fragment'

edges.description: Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge, is fought in the Eastern Enigma Chamber, which yields the Weathered Crisis Fragment.
sources: 'Defeat Doryani' (Eastern Enigma Chamber) / 'Pick up the Weathered Crisis Fragment'
Keys table: 'Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge | Weathered Crisis Fragment'

edges.description: The Arbiter of Ash is the pinnacle boss of the Burning Monolith and is defeated in quest step 101.
sources: MonsterBox location: 'The Burning Monolith'; lead: 'the pinnacle boss of The Burning Monolith'

edges.description: After the Arbiter falls, Tecrod's mysterious entity riding a wyrm steals the Flame Seed.
sources: Lore: 'A Mysterious Entity riding a wyrm that steals the Flame Seed after the Arbiter of Ash is defeated... This figure is revealed to be Tecrod'
Lore: 'The Mysterious Entity that steals the Flame Seed after the Arbiter of Ash is defeated is Tecrod.'

edges.description: The Exile explores the Patriarch and Matriarch Halls to take the Origin Spark and Origin Cradle.
sources: steps 112-128: 'Travel to the Patriarch Halls', 'Explore Matriarch Halls', 'Pick up the Origin Cradle'

edges.description: Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark, is defeated in the Patriarch Halls to recover the Origin Spark.
sources: steps 114 and 126: 'Defeat Phyx, Sentinel of the Spark' / 'Pick up the Origin Spark'

edges.description: Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle, is defeated in the Matriarch Halls to recover the Origin Cradle.
sources: steps 120-122: 'Defeat Phya, Sentinel of the Cradle' / 'Pick up the Origin Cradle'

edges.description: The Origin Core is made in the Precursor Reactor inside the Origin Tower, and the Exile places it at the tower's top.
sources: Layout: 'a room called the Precursor Reactor'; 'The Origin Core can be placed at the center to fight The Arbiter of Divinity.'
'Travel to the Origin Tower', 'Place the Origin Spark in the Precursor Reactor', 'Ascend the Tower'

edges.description: Tecrod's wyrm incapacitates the Exile when the Origin Core is placed, and Tecrod exults that the Master shall know unending power.
sources: Lore: 'when the player character places the Origin Core into the Origin Tower, Tecrod's wyrm incapacitates the character'

edges.description: Doryani directs the Origin Core ritual at the Origin Tower (steps 131-134).
sources: steps 131-134: 'Speak to Doryani', 'Return to Doryani at the Origin Tower', 'Place the Origin Spark in the Precursor Reactor'

edges.description: The Arbiter of Divinity destroys Tecrod's body and is then fought by the Exile in the Origin Tower.
sources: MonsterBox location: 'The Origin Tower'; lead: 'the pinnacle boss of The Origin Tower'

edges.description: Tecrod is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity, which declares 'Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!'
sources: Lore: 'his body is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity: Your kind shall never ordain the First Edict!'
Lore: 'The Mysterious Entity that is destroyed by the Arbiter of Divinity is Tecrod.'

edges.description: Primordial age precedes the Precursor era (order uncertain; wiki says prehistory is unclear).
precursor precedes azmeri_ezomyte_ancient (the bucket order from the schema).
Precursors built the Tower system for terraforming.
Precursors created the Arbiter of Ash to guard the Flame Seed.
Guardian of the Flame Seed; Flame Seed is taken by Tecrod after his defeat.
Precursors built the anti-corruption weapon.
Edicts murals depicting the Beast.
Their delving into world secrets triggered cataclysmic events.
Edicts depict the Beast.
The Beast's origins date back to the Precursor civilisation (Seed in Precursor ruin).
Seed of Corruption found in a Precursor ruin.
PoE2 Atlas hosts Precursor towers; 'Atlas-builders' is inference from this.
Memories of Precursor script and a pre-Azmeri life 'somewhere else' suggest Sin may have been of Precursor descent rather than Azmeri; the wiki says 'may', so this is an inference.
In Act 4 the Exile hunts the weapon pieces in the Karui archipelago.
Doryani sends Exile to find the pieces and translates the writing.
Doryani studied Precursor towers.
Act 4 takes place in Ngamakanui.
Kalandra is trapped in the lake.
Her etchings record her entrapment.
Etchings were written by Kalandra.
Kalandra's entrapment takes place in the lake.
Item named after her; tied to mirrored items.
League introduces the Lake as endgame experience.
Exile opens portals to the Lake via Mirrored Tablet.
Kalandra comments and offers encounters to the Exile in the Lake.
Evil reflection of Kalandra.

edges.description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Do you think you are savage enough to face the land of the damned, Marauder?' The Marauder's legacy text names Oriath's chains ('Oriath chained me, made me its slave') but gives no specific crime.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You have betrayed the Grand Arena. Now Wraeclast shall be your audience.. and your foe.' The Duelist's legacy text says he killed a high-born lord in a duel ('That lord sang a different tune with six inches of steel in his guts') and was then called a criminal.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Swift and silent you stole the bounty of others.' The Ranger's legacy text says Oriath called her a 'poacher' and 'thief' and hauled her 'like cargo into exile' (the stated grievance is poaching).

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Yours is a predatory profession. The business of butchery.' The Shadow's legacy text describes a contract killing ('Silence a big mouth'); the employers toasted the job and the Shadow was shipped into exile.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'When a Daughter strays away from the Light, she makes herself an Orphan.' The Witch's legacy text: 'Had they not taken my home with fire, I would not have taken their children.' The stated act is taking children; no formal charge is named.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You were once the chosen of God. A Templar. You are now the chosen of Wraeclast. An exile.' The Templar's legacy text: 'They exile me to the land of the damned.' The crime is only hinted at ('only to smite it asunder with one sinful blow'); no specific act is named.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'But you only gave us Murder and Darkness... Now you will earn your redemption in Wraeclast.' The wiki's own prose (not an in-game quote) says the Scion was exiled for killing her husband on their wedding night.
sources: section 'Character creation' (Dominus speech); intro paragraph (wiki prose)

sources: section 'Available trials' / 'Trial of Chaos': 'designed by the Vaal priests who worshipped the primordial entity, Chaos.'

edges.description: The third Ascension Trial is confirmed to be the Trial of the Ancestors (Karui spirits' competition in the Halls of the Dead). The wiki says the third trial is not officially announced and the Trial is not currently held.
sources: section 'Available trials' / 'Third trial': 'it is confirmed to be the Trial of the Ancestors, a competition held by Karui spirits in honor of the ancestors in the Halls of the Dead.'

edges.description: The Exile places Balbala's Barya (the barya holding Balbala's soul) into the Relic Altar of the Trial of the Sekhemas, per the Ascent to Power quest.
sources: Quest 'Place your Barya into the Relic Altar'

edges.description: Shambrin: 'Her barya contains her soul'; the barya is the vessel of Balbala's soul.
sources: Shambrin dialogue: 'Her barya contains her soul. She will tell you what to do next.'

edges.description: Ascent to Power is unlocked by picking up Balbala's Barya; the wiki says that if Balbala is not defeated in Traitor's Passage and the quest barya picked up, she grants Balbala's Barya at the Trial instead.
sources: Quest note: 'if you have not defeated Balbala, the Traitor in Traitor's Passage and picked up the quest barya, Balbala will grant Balbala's Barya here'

edges.description: The Exile is asked to bring Count Lachlann's Ring to Una in Clearfell Encampment to heal the Hooded One's runic wound; the wiki notes this is optional (defeating Count Geonor also completes the quest).
sources: Quest 'Bring Count Lachlann's Ring to Una'

edges.description: The ring is the key item of the quest that revives the Hooded One through Una.
sources: Quest infobox key_item = Count Lachlann's Ring

edges.description: In Keth the Exile puts the Water Goddess to rest and picks up the Essence of Water in the Keth Sanctum, after defeating Azarian, the Forsaken Son.
sources: Quest 'Pick up the Essence of Water'

edges.description: One of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri, which must be recreated to dispel Jamanra's sandstorm.
sources: Act 2 summary: 'recreate the Horn of the Vastiri by finishing three sub quests: A Theft of Ivory, The City of Seven Waters and A Crown of Stone'

edges.description: The item is obtained in the City of Seven Waters quest.
The Exile takes the Flame Ruby that Zalmarath, the Colossus drops in the Titan Grotto and brings it to Zarka at the Ardura Caravan.
One of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.
sources: Act 2 summary: three sub quests incl. A Crown of Stone

edges.description: Zarka receives the Flame Ruby at the Ardura Caravan.
sources: Quest 'Take the Flame Ruby to town': 'Give the Flame Ruby to Zarka'

edges.description: Jamanra seeks the Mastodon Tusks to gain lightning abilities for himself and his minions.
sources: Quest intro: 'Jamanra, the Risen King seeks to retrieve powerful Mastodon Tusks'

edges.description: One of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.
sources: Act 2 summary: three sub quests incl. A Theft of Ivory

edges.description: The Exile defeats Ekbab, Ancient Steed (with Iktab) in the Bone Pits and retrieves the Mastodon Tusks, which are handed to Zarka for safekeeping.
The Exile retrieves the Large Soul Core needed to power the Matlan Waterways mechanism.
sources: Quest 'Retrieve the Large Soul Core' / 'Enter The Matlan Waterways'

edges.description: Taken from Zicoatl at Jiquani's Sanctum.
sources: Quest objective: defeat Zicoatl and take the large Soul Core

edges.description: The soul core powers the Matlan Waterways controls that drain the lake to reveal Utzaal.
The Exile receives the Temple Door Idol from the Queen of Filth.
sources: Quest 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'

edges.description: The idol opens the Temple of Kopec door.
sources: Quest 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol' (door of the Temple of Kopec)

edges.description: Relics placed on the Sanctum altar strengthen the Exile across runs.
sources: 'League Mechanic' section: relics placed on the altar

edges.description: Templar relics are a mechanic of the Sanctum league.
Lycia's account of Innocence's origin is conveyed through unique Sanctum relics (per the video, auto-captions).
The Exile collects Voidstones by defeating pinnacle bosses on the Atlas.
sources: Endgame content list: Voidstones from pinnacle bosses

edges.description: Voidstones are unlocked by defeating pinnacle bosses (Searing Exarch and Eater of Worlds, the Shaper and Elder, the Maven) and form part of Atlas progression.
sources: Endgame content list: Voidstones / Atlas progression

edges.description: Watchstones are crystallised memories of the Elder's past victims, expelled when the Elder was defeated by the Cosmic Arcana.
sources: Conquerors of the Atlas section: 'When Baran fled, he left a watchstone. The stones were the crystallised memories of the Elder's past victims, expelled when it was defeated by the Cosmic Arcana.'

edges.description: Watchstones are socketed into Citadels on the Atlas (Scourge league challenge: 'Socket each of the following Watchstone types into a Citadel on your Atlas').
sources: Scourge league challenges, 'Socket Watchstones': 'Socket each of the following Watchstone types into a Citadel on your Atlas.'

edges.description: Jaetai is named only in the flavour text of Atziri's Foible; the name suggests an advisory role to Atziri, which is inferred.
Helena has the Exile poison the tree Lorrata with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem, injecting the gem's calibric extantia into the roots before Piety can reach the ruin.
Shambrin is presented as a Maraketh figure: Sekhema Asala's reaction to Shambrin's letter refers to 'my dekhara'. Membership is inferred, not stated.
sources: Sekhema Asala (on the final letter): 'I value each and every one of my dekhara.'

edges.description: Shambrin asks the Exile, after the Horn of the Vastiri, to search Deshar for the body of Lailuma, a woman she cared about, and bring back something of hers.
sources: Shambrin: 'If you happen to find Lailuma's body in the dunes below the spires... And if you bring me something of hers, then I will know.'

edges.description: Queen of the pre-Atziri Vaal, under whom the Vaal City rose to prominence.
Tetzlapokal is described as a devotee of Arakaali with a fascination for death and corpses.
The Vaal City rose to prominence in her reign.
Azurite is the currency mined and used in the Delve league's infinitely scaling Azurite Mine (Delves) to upgrade equipment.
Delves in the Azurite Mine contain Azurite, which is used to upgrade equipment.
sources: lead paragraph: Azurite mined in Delve

edges.description: Izaro Phrecius worshipped a deity known only as the Goddess of Justice.
Harbinger uniques foretell the God of Domination's gaze falling over Wraeclast.
The Twilight Order's promised god-free world, which the Countess says the Order will remake the world into.
sources: Countess (The Search): 'The Twilight Order will see to it that the world is remade. A world without gods... without suffering... without the disease of Divinity.'

edges.description: The Utopia Act 4 storyline on Arastas: Missionary Lorandis encourages the Exile to journey to Arastas and take an oath to The Saviour; Servitor Marius offers Utopia and the Exile refuses.
sources: Utopia quest: 'It is begun by speaking with Missionary Lorandis in Kingsmarch, who encourages you to journey to Arastas take an oath to The Saviour.'

edges.description: Sekhema is the Maraketh leader title, always a woman chosen by merit.
The Day Zero rule frames each league narrative around the Exile in the sand of the Twilight Strand.
sources: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' (Day Zero rule)

edges.description: Dominus exiles the Exile at the start of each league narrative (Day Zero).
sources: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' (Day Zero rule)

edges.description: Uber Elder is a pinnacle boss reached through map fragments from influenced Atlas maps; the source describes only the Uber Elder.
sources: The Elder intro: defeating bosses in influenced map variants drops map fragments 'which when combined allow access to pinnacle boss fights'

edges.description: The Elder epilogue quest culminates in the Uber Elder boss fight.
sources: Intro: 'It culminates in the Uber Elder boss fight.'

edges.description: Keepers of the Flame (3.27.0) expands the content and lore first introduced in Breach league.
sources: Lead paragraph: 'expands upon content and lore first introduced in Breach league'

sources: Lead: 'It launched on March 6, 2026 ... in version 3.28.0'

edges.description: Allflame (3.29.0) is one of the 2025-26 challenge leagues in this release run.
sources: Lead: 'It launched on July 24, 2026 ... in version 3.29.0'

sources: 'Axiom Prison' end: Kaom slays his 500 warriors deceived by the Beast

edges.description: The Exile retrieves the Mortinomicon for Divinia from the Ossuary and is taken to the Forbidden Sanctum.
sources: Walkthrough: Travel to the Ossuary; Return the Mortinomicon to Divinia

edges.description: The quest leads to the Forbidden Sanctum.
sources: Objective: 'Speak to Divinia to travel to the Forbidden Sanctum'

edges.description: Optional Act 10 fight in which the Exile kills Vilenta in the Control Blocks.

sources: lead: society mentioned in Heist contracts as client

edges.description: Crimson Scribe research proposes that the sisters Solaris and Lunaris of Azmeri legend may be the twin sekhema Solerai and Lunerai.
sources: Solaris, Lunaris, and Viridi section: 'According to the research of the Crimson Scribe, the sisters Solaris and Lunaris of Azmeri legend and the twin sekhema Solerai and Lunerai may be one and the same.'

edges.description: Crimson Scribe research links Lunaris to the Solaris-Lunaris twin legend and the twin sekhema.
sources: Solaris, Lunaris, and Viridi section: 'According to the research of the Crimson Scribe, the sisters Solaris and Lunaris ... may be one and the same.'

edges.description: Una is met at Clearfell Encampment (the Exile returns there to speak to her about the Hooded One).
sources: Meet Una in Clearfell: 'Return to Clearfell Encampment and speak to Una'

edges.description: Clearfell, the logging encampment that serves as the Act 1 town hub, lies in the Ogham region.
sources: Intro: Act One takes place 'in the region of Ogham' and the Exile finds their way to the Clearfell Encampment; table lists Clearfell as an Act 1 area

edges.description: The Drowned City is the submerged section of Utzaal revealed after the lake is drained.
sources: Quest log 'Talk to Alva': 'lowered the water and revealed the Sunken City of Utzaal'; 'Enter The Drowned City'

edges.description: The stone altar in the Infested Barrens needs a large Soul Core to open the Matlan Waterways.
The Sandswept Marsh is crossed in the search for the Ziggurat.
The Hunting Grounds lie beyond the clan graves and are crossed on the Act 1 route to Ogham Village, in the Ogham region.
sources: Una: 'Beyond our clan graves is the Hunting Grounds. Cut through those to reach the village.'
Intro: Act One 'taking place in the region of Ogham'

edges.description: The Countess asked the Faridun to rally at Mawdun Quarry, where they would prepare weapons and the Dreadnought caravan.
sources: Events in Path of Exile 2: 'She has asked them to rally at Mawdun Quarry where they would prepare weapons and a caravan known as The Dreadnought'

edges.description: Mawdun Mine and Mawdun Quarry are adjacent Act 2 areas linked on the Act 2 map.
sources: Act 2 area table: 'Mawdun Mine ... ↔ Mawdun Quarry'

edges.description: Doryani's reserves are said to be in the Cuachic Vault at the summit of Mount Kriar.
Virtue gems were discovered beneath Mount Veruso by the Vaal.
sources: Overview: 'Virtue gems were soon discovered under Mount Veruso by the Vaal'

edges.description: The Path of Mourning is travelled on the way to Deshar, where the Faridun are found atop the burial spires.
sources: Quest log 'Travel through the Path of Mourning'

edges.description: Qimah is a Maraketh city where the Gifting of Water is held.
The Exile searches the Red Vale for the three Obelisks of Rust containing Runes of Power.
The Abyss place is reached through Abyss pits in the Abyss league.
Bannon is trapped on the Cathedral Rooftop by Kitava's cultists.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Bannon is trapped on the Cathedral Rooftop by the cultists of Kitava'

edges.description: The rooftop is where Kitava's cultists besiege Bannon.
Avarius, Reassembled is fought in the Desecrated Chambers.
Arakaali's Temple of Decay (Act 7) lies in the Vaal City area, near the Arakaali temple entrance Yeena burns open.
sources: Getting to Yeena: 'Yeena is located inside The Vaal City near the Waypoint and Arakaali's temple'

edges.description: Yeena burns open the entrance to the Temple of Decay in the Vaal City.
sources: Quest complete: 'She has burned open the entrance to the Temple of Decay'; 'Yeena is located inside The Vaal City'

edges.description: Lazhwar, an archbishop of the Eternal Faith, experimented with thaumaturgy and discovered the maps used to create the Eternal Laboratory.
sources: Eternal Empire section: 'Malachai drew upon the work of Lazhwar, an old archbishop of the Eternal Faith, who had experimented with thaumaturgy and discovered maps to create the Eternal Laboratory.'

edges.description: A crumpled note in the Kingsmarch letter collection is headed by Dannig (a love-struck draft).
sources: full page (letters by Johan, Raulf, Sonja, Dannig, Rog, Tujen, Gwennen, Faustus, Isla)

edges.description: The 'Ideas List' letter in the collection is headed by Rog and lists names for Rog and Gwennen's emporium.
The 'Drunken Scrawl' letter in the collection is by Tujen, listing names and a vow to make 'those bastards remember'.
The note is titled 'Tavakai's Declaration' on the wiki, which attributes it to Tavakai; the text itself is unsigned, so the link is inferred.
sources: Section heading "Tavakai's Declaration" (text unsigned: 'The End of Time has come!')

edges.description: The note is found in Ngakanu after the area becomes hostile.
sources: Tavakai's Declaration: 'Found in Ngakanu after the area becomes hostile.'

edges.description: Sin carries the Seed of Corruption (what remains of the Beast) into hiding.
sources: PoE2 section: 'he took what remains of the Beast, the Seed of Corruption'

sources: Events in PoE2: the Countess plans to 'feed the Seed of Corruption' to the Beast
Hooded One: 'We must put the Seed back...'; Una: 'this Seed ... is that the source of Ogham's affliction?'

edges.description: The Exile completes the Trial Run contract: takes the job from Kurai, works with the rogue Karst, and sells the Heist target to Faustus.
sources: Walkthrough: 'Take the Contract: Trial Run from Kurai' to 'Sell the Heist target to Faustus'

edges.description: The Exile completes Hyrri's Gift by stealing O' Eternal from an Oriathan nobleman's vault for Kurai's client.
sources: 'Hyrri's Gift' section: 'I'd like you to bring it home'; 'You got the book.'

edges.description: The Exile travels with Kurai to meet the Vox twins over the stolen book.
sources: 'The Negotiation' section: 'I'm going to travel with you to meet the client'

edges.description: The Exile accompanies Kurai to the second Vox meeting, which ends in hostility.
The Exile and Kurai strike the Vox twins at the Mansion in the final contract.
sources: infobox: location Mansion; quest Contract: The Twins

edges.description: Kurai confronts the Vox twins in the final contract alongside the Exile.
Vic Vox declares war on Kurai after the book theft and kidnaps her cat Hana.
sources: 'The Negotiation' ('it appears we are now at war')

edges.description: Vic Vox is the aggressor in the Kurai-Vox feud (declares war on Kurai).
The Exile and Kurai kill Vic Vox in the final contract "The Twins".
sources: lead: Contract: The Twins; 'Lore': 'Kurai and the player kill both'

edges.description: The Exile and Kurai kill Vinny Vox in the final contract "The Twins".
sources: 'Lore': 'Kurai and the player kill both Vic Vox and Vinny Vox'

edges.description: Vic and Vinny Vox are twin brothers (the Heist "Twins").
Vic Vox is a descendant of Cardinal Sanctus Vox.
Vinny Vox is a member of the Vox family descended from Cardinal Sanctus Vox.
Vic Vox is a member of the Vox family, Oriathan nobility turned criminal enterprise.
Vinny Vox is a member of the Vox family.
Victario wrote the book "O' Eternal".
Victario gifted a signed copy of O' Eternal to Queen Hyrri after the battle against Lioneye.
The book is the target of Hyrri's Gift.
Kurai is the administrator of The Ring for its Boss.
sources: 'The Boss' section ('I am, for all intents and purposes, his administrator')

edges.description: Kurai is one of the Rogues in The Rogue Harbour.
sources: walkthrough: 'Talk to Kurai in The Rogue Harbour'

edges.description: The introductory contract starts from the Rogue Harbour.
Ambush and Invasion ran concurrently from March 5 to July 5, 2014; Ambush used standard death rules and Invasion hardcore.
The wiki says Ambush league introduced Strongboxes.
Domination and Nemesis ran concurrently from October 23, 2013 to February 23, 2014; Nemesis was hardcore.
The wiki says Domination league introduced shrines.
Onslaught and Anarchy ran concurrently from June 7 to October 7, 2013 (Onslaught hardcore, Anarchy standard).
The wiki says Anarchy league introduced rogue exiles.
Rampage and Beyond ran concurrently from August 20 to November 20, 2014; Rampage was standard, Beyond hardcore.
Abaxoth was introduced to the game in 1.2.0, the release that launched Rampage and Beyond.
Abaxoth was removed in 3.19.0, the version that replaced the original Beyond demons with Scourge monsters.
sources: Historical banner: 3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with monsters from Scourge

edges.description: Bloodlines and Torment ran concurrently from December 13, 2014 to March 24, 2015 (Bloodlines hardcore, Torment standard).
The wiki says Tempest league introduced Tempests.
Essence league: zones contain frozen packs holding Essences that grant guaranteed-affix item modifications.
sources: lead paragraph and Essence mechanic section

edges.description: Archnemesis league: players apply Archnemesis modifiers to petrified monsters to build boss fights.
Sentinels were the league mechanic of Sentinel league (3.18.0); the mechanic returned to the core game in 3.25.0.
Prophecies were the mechanic of Prophecy league (2.3.0, 2016); removed in 3.17.0.
Navali exchanges one silver coin for one prophecy during Prophecy league.
sources: lead: silver coins traded with Navali

edges.description: Navali is the trader of Silver Coins in Prophecy league.
Warbands league introduced the three Warbands (Redblades, Brinerot, Mutewind).
sources: intro: warring clans, three Warbands with exclusive uniques

edges.description: Mutewind is one of the three Warbands of Warbands league.
sources: Warbands item list (Mutewind Wildrunner / Mutewind Seal)

edges.description: Brinerot is one of the three Warbands of Warbands league (Brinerot Raider, Soothsayer, Stormhand).
sources: Warbands item list (Brinerot Raider / Brinerot Soothsayer / Brinerot Stormhand)

sources: Warbands item list (Redblade Band / Redblade Tramplers)

edges.description: Warbands clans fight the Exile and react to the Exile hunting them.
sources: intro: 'The presence of the warbands ... responds to the Exiles' efforts to hunt them'

edges.description: The Harbinger league (3.0.0) introduced Harbingers; the wiki says Harbingers were introduced as a feature of that league.
sources: lead: 'introduced to the game as a feature of the Harbinger league'

edges.description: Harbinger Portal appears after the final King Harbinger is defeated in a Beachhead map.
