Maramoa describes "The Dusk" as an exile-turned-sycophant who carried the Moon Orb into the Lunaris Temple.
Maramoa describes "The Dawn" as a former exile turned devotee of Solaris.
Ritual league introduced the Ritual mechanic (3.13.0).
sources: 'League mechanic': 'The Ritual league introduced the Ritual mechanic'

edges.description: The King in the Mists is a boss associated with Rituals; his arena is opened by An Audience With The King, a fragment that can appear as a Ritual reward.
sources: lead: 'a boss associated with Rituals'; 'Entry' section

edges.description: The King in the Mists is the major antagonist of Affliction league and the Viridian Wildwood.
The map fragment can appear as a reward from Ritual encounters.
The Exile fights the King in the Mists in the Crux of Nothingness, in three phases; he becomes a treant in phase 3.
The Sacred Blossom opens a portal to The Sacred Grove where Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove, is encountered.
sources: lead: grants access to The Sacred Grove, where Oshabi can be encountered

edges.description: Using a Sacred Blossom opens a portal to The Sacred Grove.
Oshabi, Avatar of the Grove is the final boss of the Harvest mechanic.
sources: lead: final boss of the Harvest mechanic

edges.description: Oshabi is encountered as the Avatar of the Grove in the Heart of the Grove encounter.
Einhar Frey, the beastmaster, teaches the Exile to capture beasts.
The Exile completes the Bestiary league quest in Act 1.
The Exile hunts beasts in the Riverways with Einhar.
The Exile performs beastcrafting with Einhar in The Menagerie.
The Einhar quest was exclusive to the Bestiary league (3.2.0).
sources: lead: optional quest exclusive to Bestiary league; Version history 3.2.0

edges.description: Completing Einhar's Hunt unlocks The Menagerie.
sources: Quest Complete - You have unlocked the Menagerie

edges.description: Einhar's Menagerie is in The Menagerie.
sources: Quest infobox (start: Speak with Einhar in The Menagerie)

edges.description: The Necro Settlers event ran inside the extended Settlers of Kalguur league (Nov 2024 to Feb 2025).
sources: intro: 'the Necro Settlers event was held from November 2024 to February 2025'

edges.description: The Legacy of Phrecia event was held immediately after Necro Settlers, until April 23, 2025.
sources: intro: 'the Legacy of Phrecia event was held immediately after until April 23'
lead and 'Race history': first event Feb 20 to Apr 23 2025

edges.description: Runes of Aldur league is part of the 0.5.0 expansion Return of the Ancients (launched 2026-05-29). The master node league_poe2_return_of_the_ancients also conflates the expansion with the league.
sources: lead: launched May 29, 2026 as part of Return of the Ancients (0.5.0)

edges.description: Kurai is a member of The Ring ('Welcome, Exile, to the Ring. I am Kurai.').
Nemesis league gave every rare monster a Nemesis modifier.
Bloodlines league: each pack of magic monsters carried a shared Bloodline mod.
Tormented spirits haunt Wraeclast as the modifier of Torment league.
Qianga, a Mutewind warband outcast, delivered the Starforge to the Watchers of Decay for the Order of the Djinn.
sources: Qianga entry: 'a Mutewind warband outcast ... She delivered the Starforge to the Watchers of Decay'; 'Starforge and the sealing of the Elder'

edges.description: Sacred Blossom is tied to the Heart of the Grove atlas passive; the 3.19.0 change stopped it always dropping a Sacred Blossom.
sources: Version history 3.19.0 (Heart of the Grove passive change)

edges.description: The Brotherhood is based primarily in Sarn.
sources: lead paragraph: 'a faction of assassins-for-hire based primarily in Sarn'

edges.description: Hit squad for many of the Eternal Empire's elite.
sources: section 'Lore': 'acted as a hit squad for many of the elite of the Eternal Empire'

edges.description: Surrounded Drusus in the Bath House and pressured him into drowning himself.

sources: quest logs: 'You have found a mysterious Grove'; lead: 'Talk to Oshabi in the Sacred Grove'

edges.description: The Exile hunts Kira to save Oyun and decides who gets the Sekhema Feather.
sources: walkthrough: 'Travel to The Quarry, then to the Arena ... Kill Kira and save Oyun'

sources: completion text: 'You have killed Kira and Garukhan but failed to save Oyun'

sources: completion: 'You have killed Kira and Garukhan but failed to save Oyun'

sources: walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at the Quarry ... Enter, and meet Sin at the Black Core'

sources: walkthrough: 'Sin has burned open a new entrance into the Belly of the Beast. Enter, and meet Sin at the Black Core'

sources: walkthrough: 'Arakaali ... Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay to save Silk'

sources: infobox: boss 'Tukohama, Karui God of War'; 'Let me teach you the laws of war.'
